म: म The twenty-fifth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, corresponding to the letter M.

म m. (-मः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 ŚIVA. 3 VIṢṆU. 4 YAMA. 5 Time, season. 6 Poison, venom. 7 A magical or mystical verse or formula. 8 The moon. 9 The abbreviated name of the fourth note of the gamut. f. (मा) 1 A name of LAKṢMĪ. 2 A mother. 3 Measure. 4 Light, lustre. 5 Knowledge. 6 Binding, tying. 7 Death. 8 A woman's waist. n. (मं) 1 Good fortune, auspiciousness. 2 Water. E. मा to measure, or मन to worship, &c., aff. ड.
मक: मक (इ) मकि r. 1st cl. (मङ्कते) 1 To decorate, to grace or adorn. 2 To go, to move.
मकर: मकर m. (-रः) 1 A marine monster, confounded usually with the crocodile and shark, but properly a fabulous animal: as a fish; it might be conjectured to be the horned shark, or the unicorn fish; but it is often drawn, as in the pictured signs of the zodiac, with the head and forelegs of an antelope, and the body and tail of a fish: it is the emblem of the god of love. 2 One of the signs of zodiac, corresponding with CAPRICORN, and like the Greek representation of that sign, being an animal in the foreparts, and ending in the tail of a fish. 3 One of KUVERA'S treasures. E. म for मुख the mouth, कृ to scatter, aff. अच्; or माङ् prohibitive aff., कृ to do, अच् aff., form irr.; grammarians however, sometimes consider this word as a primitive.
मकरकेतन: मकरकेतन m. (-नः) KĀMA, the Hindu CUPID. E. मकर a marine monster, and केतन emblem; being painted on KĀMA'S banner.
मकरकेतु: मकरकेतु m. (-तुः) KĀMA: see the preceding. E. मकर, and केतु an emblem.
मकरध्वज: मकरध्वज m. (-जः) KĀMA: see the two last. E. मकर the Makara, and ध्वज emblem.
मकरन्द: मकरन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 The nectar or honey of a flower. 2 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 3 A bee. 4 A fragrant kind of mango. 5 A kind of jasmine, (Jasminum pubescens.) 6 The filament of a lotus. E. मकर the emblem of KĀMA, and दो to destroy, i. e. to surpass, as an incentive to love, aff. क, form irr.
मकरन्दवती: मकरन्दवती f. (-ती) The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. मकरन्द honey, and मतुप् aff., fem. form.
मकराकर: मकराकर m. (-रः) The ocean. E. मकर a marine monster, and आकर receptacle.
मकराकार: मकराकार m. (-रः) A plant, said to be a species of Karanja or Cæsalpinia. E. मकर a fish, आकार form.
मकराङ्क: मकराङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 KĀMADEVA. 2 The ocean. E. मकर a marine monster, and अङ्क mark, emblem.
मकरालय: मकरालय m. (-यः) The ocean. E. मकर a sort of fish, and आलय abode.
मकराश्व: मकराश्व m. (-श्वः) VARUṆA. E. मकर a marine monster, and अश्व a horse; riding on the Makara.
मकरिन्: मकरिन् m. (-री) The ocean. E. मकर a marine monster, and इनि aff.
मकुट: मकुट n. (-टं) A crest, a head-dress, a crown, a tiara. E. मकि to adorn, aff. उट, form irr.
मकुति: मकुति f. (-तिः) An edict or order of the government, addressed to the Śūdra tribe, or to a Śūdra.
मकुर: मकुर m. (-रः) 1 A mirror. 2 The stick of a potter's wheel. 3 An unblown flower. 4 A tree with light yellow, and fragrant flowers, (Mimusops elengi.) E. मकि to adorn, उरच् Uṇādi aff., and deriv. irr.; also मुकुर.
मकुल: मकुल m. (-लः) 1 An opening bud. 2 A kind of tree, (Mimusops elengi.) E. मकि to adorn, उलच् aff., deriv. irr.
मकुष्टक: मकुष्टक m. (-कः) A kind of kidney-bean, a wild variety perhaps of the Phaseolus mungo. E. मकु irr. deriv., from मक to adorn, ष्टक to impede, aff. अच्; also मकुष्ठक.
मकुष्ठ: मकुष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Going lazily, slowly, &c. m. (-ष्ठः) A sort of rice. E. मकि to adorn, aff. उ, deriv. irr. मकु, and स्था to stand, aff. क; also मुकुष्ठ.
मकुष्ठक: मकुष्ठक m. (-कः) A sort of kidney-bean. E. मकु ornament: (see the two last;) स्था to stay or be, aff. क्वुन्.
मकूलक: मकूलक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Danti. E. मक to adorn, ऊलच् aff., and कन् added.
मक्क: मक्क r. 1st cl. (-मक्कते) To go, to move.
मक्कल: मक्कल n. (-लं) A mineral substance, considered variously to be chalk or benzoin. E. मक्क to go, to be, aff. ऊलच.
मक्कोल: मक्कोल m. (-लः) Chalk: see the last. E. मल्ल to go, ओलच् aff.
मक्ष: मक्ष r. 1st cl. (मक्षति) 1 To fill. 2 To be angry. 3 To mix, to combine.
मक्ष m. (-क्षः) Hypocrisy, slyness, concealment of one's own defects. E. मक्ष to fill, aff. अच्.
मक्षिका: मक्षिका f. (-का) A fly. E. मक्ष to be angry, Uṇādi aff. सिकन्, or मक्ष the same, क्वुन् aff.
मक्षीका: मक्षीका f. (-का) A fly. E. see the last, the pen. vowel made long.
मख: मख r. 1st cl. (मखति) also (इ) मखि (मङ्खति) To go, to move.
मख m. (-खः) Sacrifice, oblation. E. मख to go, aff. घञ् or घ.
मखत्रातृ: मखत्रातृ m. (-ता) RĀMA, the son of DAŚARATHA, and second incarnation of VIṢṆU so named. E. मख sacrifice, and त्रातृ who preserves; his first exploit being the discomfiture of the Rākṣasas, who disturbed the sacrifices of VIŚVAMITRA.
मखवह्नि: मखवह्नि m. (-ह्निः) Sacrificial fire. E. मख sacrifice, and वह्नि fire; also similar compounds, as मखाग्नि, &c.
मखानल: मखानल m. (-लः) Sacrificial fire. E. मख, and अनल fire.
मखासुहृद्: मखासुहृद् m. (-ट्) ŚIVA. E. मख sacrifice, here meaning the sacrifice offered by DAKṢA, and असुहृद् unfriendly; having disturbed the ceremony, and slain the sacrificer.
मग: मग(इ) r. 1st cl. (मंगति) To go, to move.
मगध: मगध m. (-धः) 1 A country, South Behār. 2 An inhabitant of that country. 3 A bard, whose peculiar province is to sing the praises of a chief's ancestry in his presence, a family bard or minstrel. f. (-धा) Long pepper. E. मगध a Kaṇḍvādi verb, to ask, aff. अच् or मगध the country, अण् aff., with alteration of the vowel optional; hence also मागध.
मगधेश्वर: मगधेश्वर m. (-रः) A name of JARĀSANDHA. E. मगध South Behar, and ईश्वर king.
मग्न: मग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 1 Plunged, dived, immersed. 2 Sunk, drowned. E. मस्ज to plunge into water, aff. क, form irr.
मघ: मघ(इ)मघि r. 1st cl. (मंघते) 1 To go, to move. 2 To begin moving. 3 To begin. 4 To move swiftly. 5 To blame. 6 To game. 7 To cheat, to be addicted to dishonest practices. (मंघति) To decorate, to adorn.

मघ m. (-घः) 1 One of the Dvīpas or divisions of the universe. 2 A country, that of the modern Mugs, or Arrakan. 3 A drug. 4 Pleasure, happiness. n. (-घं) A kind of flower. f. (-घा) The tenth lunar asterism, containing five stars figured by a house, apparently α. γ. ζ. η. and ν. Leonis: it is sometimes considered to be confined to the plural number (मघाः). f. (-घा-घी) A sort of grain. E. मह to worship, aff. कन्, and ह changed to घ.
मघवत्: मघवत् m. (-वान्) A name of INDRA. E. मघ happiness, (of paradise or Svarga,) मतुप् aff.
मघवन्: मघवन् m. (-बा) 1 INDRA. 2 One of the twelve Cakravartīs, or universal monarchs of the Jainas. E. मह to sacrifice, कनिन् Uṇādi aff., and वुक् augment, form irr.; before the vowel affs. of the second case plural, and the last five cases, the व of this word is changed to उ, and thence becomes ओ as usual, as मघोनः, मघोना, मघोने, &c.; also with ङीष् aff. the fem. form is मघोनी f. (-नी) The wife of INDRA.
मघाभव: मघाभव m. (-वः) The planet VENUS or ŚUKRA. E. मघा the asterism, and भव born.
मघाभू: मघाभू m. (-भू) ŚUKRA. E. मघा, and भु born: see the last.
मङ्किल: मङ्किल m. (-ल) A fire in a forest. E. मकि to adorn, aff. इलच्.
मङ्कुर: मङ्कुर m. (-रः) A mirror. E. मकि to adorn, उरच् aff., and the nasal retained; also मकुर and मुकुर.
मङ्क्तृ: मङ्क्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) 1 Bathing or drowning; any thing, or person. 2 Cleaning any thing by immersion. E. मस्ज to bathe, aff. तृच्, and नुम् augment.
मङ्क्षण: मङ्क्षण n. (-णं) Cuisses or greaves, armour for the thighs or legs; it is sometimes read मङ्क्षण.
मङ्क्षु: मङ्क्षु ind. 1 Quickly, swiftly, instantly. 2 Much, exceedingly. E. मस्ज to purify, सु aff., and नुम् augment.
मङ्क्षुण: मङ्क्षुण n. (-णं) Cuisses or greaves, armour for the thighs or legs; in some parts of India a sort of iron chain-work petticoat, coming down to the knees, is still worn.
मङ्ख: मङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) A mendicant of a particular order. E. मखि to go, अच् aff.
मङ्ग: मङ्ग m. (-ङ्कः) The head of a boat. E. मगि to go, aff. अच्.
मङ्गल: मङ्गल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Lucky, fortunate, prosperous, faring well or happily. n. (-लं) 1 Happiness, good fortune. 2 Preserving property, taking care of what has been gained, prudence, carefulness. m. (-लः) 1 The planet MARS. 2 Burnt offering on various occasions of rejoicing. f. (-ला) 1 A name of UMĀ, the wife of ŚIVA. 2 A bent grass, (Panicum dactylon,) with white blossoms. 3 A virtuous and obedient wife. 4 The mother of the fifth Jina or Jaina teacher SUMATI. 5 A species of Cæsalpinia. E. मगि to go, अलच् Uṇādi aff.
मङ्गलच्छाय: मङ्गलच्छाय m. (-यः) Waved leaf fig tree, (Ficus infectoria.) E. मङ्गल prosperous, lucky, and च्छाया shade.
मङ्गलपाठक: मङ्गलपाठक m. (-कः) A bard, an encomiast. E. मङ्गल good fortune, and पाठक who reads or recites.
मङ्गलप्रदा: मङ्गलप्रदा f. (-दा) Turmeric. E. मङ्गल auspiciousness, and प्रदा bestowing.
मङ्गल्य: मङ्गल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 1 Auspicious, propitious, conferring happiness, prosperity, &c. 2 Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable. 3 Pure, pious. m. (-ल्यः) 1 A plant, commonly Trāyamāṇa. 2 The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) 3 The Vilva, (Ægle marmelos.) 4 A sort of pulse, (Cicer lens.) f. (-ल्या) 1 A fragrant sort of Agallochum or aloe wood. 2 A kind of Mimosa, (M. Suma, Rox.) 3 A herb, commonly Gojihva, (Hieracium, or according to Rox.'s Catalogue, a herb of the same class, Elephantopus scaber.) 4 A sort of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.) 5 A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa.) 6 A sort of perfume, commonly Rochana. 7 A kind of Orris root, (Acorus calamus.) n. (-ल्यं) 1 Sour curds. 2 Sandal. 3 Red lead. 4 Gold. E. मङ्गल prosperous, and यत् aff.
मङ्गल्यक: मङ्गल्यक m. (-कः) Lentils, (Cicer lens.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
मङ्गल्यनामधेया: मङ्गल्यनामधेया f. (-या) A plant, (Celtis orientalis.) E. मङ्गल्य auspicious, नामधेया appellation.
मङ्गिनी: मङ्गिनी f. (-नी) A boat. E. मङ्ग the head of a boat, aff. इनि.
मच: मच also (इ) मचि r. 1st cl. (मचते मञ्चते) 1 To be vain or proud. 2 To be wicked. 3 To speak. 4 To pound or grind. मचि r. 1st cl. (मञ्चते) 1 To hold or have. 2 To be high or tall. 3 To revere, to adore, to worship. 4 To shine.
मचर्चिका: मचर्च्चिका f. (-का) 1 Excellence, happiness. 2 (In apposition,) Best, excellent, (the gender is unchanged.) E. म ŚIVA, चर्च्च to worship, aff. ण्वुल् and टाप्.
मचर्च्चिका: मचर्च्चिका f. (-का) 1 Excellence, happiness. 2 (In apposition,) Best, excellent, (the gender is unchanged.) E. म ŚIVA, चर्च्च to worship, aff. ण्वुल् and टाप्.
मच्चित्त: मच्चित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Who or what has the mind fixed on me, (God.) E. मत् me, चित्त mind.
मच्छ: मच्छ m. (-च्छः) A fish in general. E. मद to delight, and श aff., form irr.: see मत्स्या.
मज्जकृत्: मज्जकृत् n. (-कृत्) A bone. E. मज्ज marrow, and कृत् what makes.
मज्जत्: मज्जत् mfn. (-ज्जन्-ज्जन्ती-ज्जती-ज्जत्) Plunging in or into, being immersed, dipping, drowning. E. मस्ज to be immersed, शतृ aff.
मज्जन्: मज्जन् m. (-ज्जा) 1 The marrow of the bones and flesh. 2 The pith or sap of trees, &c. E. मस्ज to be immersed, (in the centre of the bones, &c.) and कनिन् Uṇādi aff.
मज्जन: मज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Bathing, ablution. 2 Immersion. 3 Drowning. 4 Marrow. E. मस्ज to bathe, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
मज्जसमुद्भव: मज्जसमुद्भव n. (-वं) Semen genitale. E. मज्ज marrow, समुद्भव production.
मज्जा: मज्जा f. (-ज्जा) Marrow, pith, sap. E. मज्जन् marrow, and टाप् aff.: see मज्जन्.
मज्जिका: मज्जिका f. (-का) The female of the Indian crane.
मज्जूषा: मज्जूषा f. (-षा) A basket. E. see मञ्जूषा.
मञ्च: मञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) 1 A bed, a bedstead. 2 A platform, a scaffold. 3 An elevated shed raised on bambus in a cornfield, &c., where a watchman is stationed to protect the corn from cattle, birds, wild beasts, &c. 4 A sort of throne or chair of state, or the platform on which it is raised, the dais. E. मचि to be high or tall, aff. अच्.
मञ्चक: मञ्चक m. (-कः) 1 A bed, a bedstead. 2 A platform, a scaffold. E. कन् added to the preceding.
मञ्चकाश्रय: मञ्चकाश्रय m. (-यः) A bug. E. मञ्चक a bed, and आश्रय abode.
मञ्चमण्डप: मञ्चमण्डप m. (-पः) A sort of temporary open shed, a platform erected for particular ceremonies, as marriages, &c. E. मञ्च a scaffold, and मण्डप a temporary hall.
मञ्ज: मञ्ज r. 10th cl. (मञ्जयति) 1 To sound. 2 To clean, to purify.
मञ्जर: मञ्जर nf. (-रं-री) 1 A pearl. 2 A compound pedicle. 3 A sort of plant, commonly Tilaka. E. मञ्जु beautiful, ऋ to go or be, aff. अप्, deriv. irr: see the next.
मञ्जरि: मञ्जरि f. (-रिः-री) 1 A compound pedicle, a fruit or flower stalk. 2 A large pearl. 3 A plant, commonly Tilaka. mf. (-रिः-री) A shoot, a sprout. E. मञ्जु beautiful, ऋ to go or be, aff. इ, deriv. irr., ङीप् optionally added.
मञ्जरित: मञ्जरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Mounted on a stalk, (a bud, &c.) E. मञ्जर, and इतच् aff.
मञ्जा: मञ्जा f. (-ञ्जा) 1 A compound pedicle: see the last. 2 A she-goat. E. मजि to sound, aff. अच्.
मञ्जि: मञ्जि f. (-ञ्जिः-ञ्जी) A compound pedicle; also मञ्जरी.
मञ्जिका: मञ्जिका f. (-का) A harlot, a whore.
मञ्जिफला: मञ्जिफला f. (-ला) The plantain, (Musa sapientum.) E. मञ्जि a foot-stalk, and फल fruit.
मञ्जिमन्: मञ्जिमन् n. (-म) Beauty, elegance. E. मञ्जु handsome, इमनिच् aff.
मञ्जिष्ठा: मञ्जिष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) Bengal madder, a plant used in medicine, and in dying, (Rubia manjith, Rox.) E. मञ्जु beautiful, स्था to stay or be, क aff., deriv. irr.; or मञ्जि a compound pedicle, and स्थ aff.
मञ्जिष्ठाराग: मञ्जिष्ठाराग m. (-गः) 1 The dye of madder. 2 Permanent attachment. E. मञ्जिष्ठा, and राग colour.
मञ्जीर: मञ्जीर n. (-रं) An ornament for the feet or toes. m. (-रः) A post, round which passes the string that works the stick of a churn. E. मञ्ज to sound, aff. ईरन्; also with कन् added, मञ्जीरक.
मञ्जील: मञ्जील m. (-लः) A village, inhabited chiefly by washermen. E. मञ्ज to sound, ईरन् aff., and र changed to ल.
मञ्जु: मञ्जु mfn. (-ञ्जुः-ञ्जुः-ञ्जु) Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable. E. मजि to sound, aff. उ.
मञ्जुकेशिन्: मञ्जुकेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Beautiful-haired. m. (-शी) A name of KṚṢṆA, or VIṢṆU in that form. E. मञ्जु beautiful, केश hair, इनि aff.
मञ्जुगमना: मञ्जुगमना f. (-ना) A goose. E. मञ्जु beautiful, elegant, and गमन gait.
मञ्जुघोष: मञ्जुघोष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Having a sweet voice or cry. m. (-षः) One of the Bauddha teachers. f. (-षा) One of the Apsaras or courtezans of Svarga. E. मञ्जु agreeable, and घोष sound, voice.
मञ्जुनाशी: मञ्जुनाशी f. (-शी) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 The wife of INDRA. 3 A handsome woman. E. मञ्जु beautiful, and नाश destruction; putting every other beauty to shame by their superiority.
मञ्जुप्राण: मञ्जुप्राण m. (-णः) A name of BRAHMĀ. E. मञ्जु pleasing, and प्राण life.
मञ्जुभद्र: मञ्जुभद्र m. (-द्रः) A Bauddha; also called Mañjughoṣa.
मञ्जुभाषिन्: मञ्जुभाषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Speaking sweetly or pleasantly. f. (-णी) 1 A woman speaking kindly. 2 A species of Atijagatī metre. E. मञ्जु, and भाषिन् who speaks.
मञ्जुल: मञ्जुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Beautiful, agreeable, pleasing. m. (-लः) A gallinule n. (-लं) 1 A natural water-course or channel. 2 An arbor, a bower. 3 An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.) E. मञ्जु handsome, ला to be, aff. क.
मञ्जुवक्त्र: मञ्जुवक्त्र mfn. (-क्त्रः-क्त्रा-क्त्रं) Lovely, handsome. E. मञ्जु beautiful, वक्त्र the face.
मञ्जुश्री: मञ्जुश्री m. (-श्रीः) A Bauddha saint: see मञ्जुघोष.
मञ्जूषा: मञ्जूषा f. (-षा) 1 A basket, a large basket. 2 A stone. 3 Bengal madder. 4 The case in which the great bow that RĀMA broke, was kept. E. मस्ज to make pure or clean by ablution, Uṇādi aff. ऊषन्, and the nasal augment; also with a short vowel मञ्जुषा.
मट्टक: मट्टक m. (-कः) 1 The ridge of a thatch. 2 A sort of grain, (Eleusine corocana.)
मठ: मठ r. 1st cl. (मठति) 1 To be confused or disturbed in mind. 2 To dwell, to inhabit. (इ) मठि r. 1st cl. (मंठते) To bewail, to regret, to remember with sorrow or regret.

मठ m. (-ठः) 1 A school, a college, the residence of young Brahmans, prosecuting sacred studies. 2 A building inhabited by ascetics of the same order. 3 A temple. 4 A cart, a carriage. E. मठ to dwell, aff. अच्.
मठर: मठर m. (-रः) The name of a Muni or saint. E. मत to respect, Uṇādi aff. अरच्, and ठ substituted for the radical final.
मड: मड(इ)मडि r. 1st cl. (मण्डते) 1 To divide, to separate. 2 To surround, to encompass. r. 1st and 10th cls. (मण्डति मण्डयति) To adorn, to grace, to decorate. r. 10th cl. (मण्डयति) To gladden, to rejoice, to make happy.
मडक: मडक m. (-कः) A kind of grain, (Eleusine corocana.)
मड्डु: मड्डु m. (-ड्डुः) A sort of drum. E. मस्ज to purify, aff. उ, deriv. irr.; also with कन् added, मड्डुक.
मण: मण r. 1st cl. (मणति) To sound, to sound inarticulately.
मणि: मणि mf. (-णिः-णिः or -णी) 1 A gem, a jewel, a precious stone. 2 A pearl. 3 Fleshy processes pending from the neck of a goat. 4 A small water pot. 5 The glans penis. 6 The clitoris. 7 The wrist. 8 One of the Nāgas or serpent chiefs of Pātāla. E. मण to sound, aff. इन्.
मणिक: मणिक n. (-कं) A small water jar, a pitcher. E. मणि the same, aff. कन्.
मणिकण्ठ: मणिकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) The blue jay. E. मणि a jewel, and कण्ठ the throat.
मणिकर्ण: मणिकर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णी-र्णं) Jewel-eared. E. मणि, and कर्ण the ear.
मणिकर्णिका: मणिकर्णिका f. (-का) A holy pool at Benares, in which pilgrims are directed to bathe, and adjacent ghāt. E. मणि, and कर्ण the ear, aff. कन्, fem. form. Devi having dropped one of her earrings at this place.
मणिकाच: मणिकाच m. (-चः) The feathered part of an arrow.
मणिकानन: मणिकानन n. (-नं) The neck or throat. E. मणि a jewel, and कानन a wood; abounding with such ornaments.
मणिकार: मणिकार m. (-रः) A jeweller, a lapidary or worker in precious stones. E. मणि a gem, and कार who makes.
मणिग्रीव: मणिग्रीव m. (-वः) One of KUVERA'S sons. E. मणि a gem, and ग्रीवा the neck.
मणिच्छिद्रा: मणिछिद्रा f. (-द्रा) 1 Marrow. 2 A sort of drug.
मणिछिद्रा: मणिछिद्रा f. (-द्रा) 1 Marrow. 2 A sort of drug.
मणित: मणित n. (-तं) Low murmuring sound. E. मण to sound, aff. क्त.
मणितारक: मणितारक m. (-कः) The Indian crane. E. मणि a jewel, तॄ to pass over, aff. ण्वुल्.
मणिद्वीप: मणिद्वीप m. (-पः) The crest or hood of the great serpent ANANTA. E. मणि a jewel, and द्वीप a continent.
मणिधनुष्: मणिधनुष् m. (-नुः) The rainbow. E. मणि a jewel, and धनुष् a bow.
मणिपूर: मणिपूर m. (-रः) 1 The navel. 2 A sort of bodice worn by women, and often richly ornamented with jewels. n. (-रं) The pit of the stomach, as one of the mystical cakras of the body: see चक्र. E. मणि a jewel, and पूर filling, full.
मणिबन्ध: मणिबन्ध m. (-न्धः) The wrist. E. मणि a jewel, and बन्ध binding; where bracelets of precious stones are bound.
मणिभद्र: मणिभद्र m. (-द्रः) 1 One of the Jinas, or Jaina deified teachers. 2 A name of the king of the Yakṣas.
मणिभित्ति: मणिभित्ति f. (-त्तिः) The palace of the great serpent, ŚEṢA Nāga. E. मणि a jewel, and भित्ति a wall.
मणिभूमि: मणिभूमि f. (-मिः) A jewel mine, or a place where gems or precious stones are found. E. मणि a gem, and भूमि ground; also मणिभू f. (-भूः).
मणिमण्डप: मणिमण्डप m. (-पः) 1 The capital of Śeṣa. 2 The palace of NAIRṚTA, regent of the S. W. quarter. E. मणि a jewel, and मण्डप a building.
मणिमत्: मणिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Having jewels, possessed of or adorned with them. m. (-मान्) The sun. E. मणि, and मतुप् poss. aff.
मणिमध्य: मणिमध्य n. (-ध्यं) A species of the Vṛhatī metre.
मणिमन्थ: मणिमन्थ n. (-न्थं) 1 A mountain or range where salt is found 2 Rock salt. E. मणि a gem, and मन्थ what churns; also माणिमन्थ.
मणिमाला: मणिमाला f. (-ला) 1 A necklace, a zone, a fillet, &c. of precious stones. 2 An impression left by a bite. 3 The goddess LAKṢMĪ. 4 Light, lustre. 5 A species of the Jagatī metre. E. मणि a gem, and माला a necklace, &c.
मणिरत्न: मणिरत्न n. (-त्नं) A precious gem. E. मणि, and रत्न a jewel, or the best of any thing.
मणिव: मणिव m. (-वः) One of the Nāgas or serpents of Pātāla. E. मणि a gem, and व poss. aff.
मणिवीज: मणिवीज m. (-जः) The pomegranate. E. मणि a gem, and वीज seed.
मणिसर: मणिसर n. (-रं) A string of gems, a necklace, &c. E. मणि, and सर what goes.
मणिसौपान: मणिसौपान m. (-नः) A staff or stick set with jewels. E. मणि a jewel, सौपान a ladder.
मणीचक: मणीचक n. (-कं) The moon gem, probably a sort of crystal. m. (-कः) A kingfisher.
मणीवक: मणीवक n. (-कं) A flower. E. मण to sound, deriv. irr.
मण्ड: मण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) 1 Scum, skimmings, froth, foam, barm, &c., the upper part of any infusion in a state of boiling or ferment. 2 Pith, essence. 3 The head. m. (-ण्डः) 1 Ornament, decoration, 2 The castor oil tree, (Palma christi.) 3 A sort of potherb. f. (-ण्डा) 1 Spirituous or vinous liquor. 2 Emblic myrobalan. E. मडि to adorn, Uṇādi aff. ड.
मण्डन: मण्डन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Adorning, dressing, decorating, fond of or putting on ornaments. n. (-नं) Ornament, decoration, jewels, trinkets, &c. E. मडि to adorn, aff. युच्.
मण्डप: मण्डप mn. (-पः-पं) 1 A temporary building, an open shed or hall, adorned with flowers and erected on festival occasions, as at marriages, &c. 2 An open temple or building consecrated to a deity. E. मण्ड ornament, and पा to preserve, aff. क.
मण्डयन्त: मण्डयन्त m. (-न्तः) An ornament, a decoration of trinkets, jewels, &c. f. (-न्ती) A woman, a wife. E. मडि to adorn, Uṇādi aff. झच्. fem. aff. ङीप्.
मण्डल: मण्डल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) The disk of the sun or moon. n. (-लं) 1 The sun's disk. 2 An orb, a circumference in general or the circle bounding the view, the sensible horizon. 3 (In astronomy,) A great circle, as नाडीमण्डलं the equator, क्रान्तिमण्डलं the ecliptic. 4 A ball, a globe. 5 A wheel. 6 A province, a region, a district, extending twenty, or according to some authorities, forty Yojanas every way. 7 The country or empire, over which the twelve princes termed Cakravartīs are supposed to have ruled; perhaps the peninsula of India, where the term Maṇḍala or Mandel is of constant occurrence, to signify a province or district, as in Coromandet, &c. 8 Surrounding or contiguous countries. 9 A sort of leprosy with circular spots. 10 A heap, a quantity, a multitude or  assemblage. 11 An attitude in shooting, the fifth position, in which both knees are bent. 12 The impression or scratch of a finger nail. 13 A sort of perfume, resembling in appearance a dried shell fish. 14 A sort of mystical diagram. 15 A sweetmeat, a sugar-ball. 16 A form of array, an army drawn up in a circle. m. (-लः) 1 A kind of snake. 2 A dog. f. (-ली) Bent grass. E. मडि to adorn, aff. कलच्.
मण्डलक: मण्डलक n. (-कं) 1 An orb or disk. 2 A sort of leprosy, with large round spots. 3 A mirror. 4 A form of array, an army drawn up in a circle. 5 A circular figure or diagram. m. (-कः) A dog. E. कन् added to the preceding.
मण्डलनृत्य: मण्डलनृत्य n. (-त्यं) Dancing in a ring, especially a dance imitative of one, said to have been danced by the Gopīs round KṚṢṆA and his mistress RĀDHĀ. E. मण्डल a circle, and नृत्य dancing.
मण्डलाग्र: मण्डलाग्र m. (-ग्रः) A sword, a scimitar. E. मण्डल a circle, and अग्र top or point.
मण्डलायित: मण्डलायित n. (-तं) A ball, a globe. E. मण्डल a circle, क्यप् aff., and क्त added.
मण्डलाधीश: मण्डलाधीश m. (-शः) An emperor, a king of kings. E. मण्डल an extensive district or empire, and अधीश sovereign.
मण्डलिन्: मण्डलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 1 Being in a circle, made up into a coil or ball. 2 Surrounded by. m. (-ली) 1 A large species of snake. 2 A cat. 3 A polecat. 4 A dog. 5 The sun. 6 The ruler or governor of a Maṇḍala or district. E. मण्डल a circle, and इनि aff.
मण्डलीकरण: मण्डलीकरण n. (-णं) Rounding, gathering in a ball or a circle, coiling, &c. E. मण्डल, and करण making, च्चि augment.
मण्डलीकृत: मण्डलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rounded, made round or globular, gathered in a ball or circle. E. मण्डल, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
मण्डलेश: मण्डलेश m. (-शः) An emperor, a supreme monarch. E. मण्डल an empire, and ईश sovereign.
मण्डलेश्वर: मण्डलेश्वर m. (-रः) A sovereign, a monarch. E. मण्डल a district, and ईश्वर a sovereign; the power of this prince is limited by AMARA, and the Maṇḍaleśvara is considered as an emperor or supreme prince, only when in addition to his territorial sway, he has performed the Rājasūya sacrifice, or sacrifice in which he has been attended by all his tributary or subject princes: other authorities confound the sovereign of a Maṇḍala, with the Cakravartī or emperor, and with the Samrāj or lord paramount, and others confine him to the government of a district of twenty or forty Yojanas in each direction.
मण्डहारक: मण्डहारक m. (-कः) A distiller. E. मण्ड froth, ferment, and हृ to take, aff. अण्, and कन् added.
मण्डित: मण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ornamented, adorned. m. (-तः) One of the eleven persons called Gaṇādhipas by the Jainas. E. मडि to adorn, aff. क्त.
मण्डूक: मण्डूक m. (-कः) 1 A frog. 2 The name of a Muni. 3 A flower, (Bignonia Indica.) f. (-का-की) Madder, (Rubia Manjith.) f. (-की) 1 A female or small frog. 2 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica, or Hydrocotyle Asiatica.) 3 An unchaste or abandoned woman. E. मडि to ornament, Uṇādi aff. ऊकन्.
मण्डूकपर्ण: मण्डूकपर्ण mf. (-र्णः-र्णी) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) f. (-र्णी) 1 Bengal madder, (Rubia Manjith.) 2 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 3 A sort of creeper, (Hydrocotyle Asiatica.) E. मण्डूक a frog, and पर्ण a leaf, compared to the animal in shape or colour.
मण्डूर: मण्डूर mn. (-रः-रं) Rust of iron. E. मडि to adorn, ऊरच् aff.
मण्डोदक: मण्डोदक n. (-कं) 1 Painting figures or flowers, on the walls or floors of an apartment, &c. on festival occasions, with a white pigment made from ground rice. 2 Variegated colour. E. मण्ड scum, and उदक water.
मत्: मत् ind. Mine. E. irregular substitute for मम possessive case of अत्मट् I, and used in composition, as मत्पुत्त्र my son, मन्नाथ my lord.
मत: मत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, understood. 2 Admitted, believed, held or entertained, (as opinion, &c.) 3 Respected, reverenced, minded, regarded. n. (-तं) 1 Purpose, intention, wish, mind, (as to have a mind to any thing.) 2 Knowledge. 3 Doctrine, tenet, belief, opinion. E. मन to mind, aff. क्त.
मतङ्ग: मतङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The name of a Muni. 2 A cloud. 3 An elephant. E. मदि to please, to be pleased, अङ्गच् Uṇādi. aff., deriv. irr.
मतङ्गज: मतङ्गज m. (-जः) An elephant. E. मतङ्ग the saint MATAṄGA, and ज born.
मतल्लिका: मतल्लिका f. (-का) Excellence, happiness: (also attributively, but unvarying in gender,) excellent, best, happiest; there is no etymon of this word, according to the best authorities.
मति: मति f. (-तिः) 1 Understanding, intellect. 2 Wish, desire, inclination. 3 Memory, recollection. 4 Respect, reverence. 5 A potherb. E. मन to respect, &c., aff. क्तिन्.
मतिप्रकर्ष: मतिप्रकर्ष m. (-र्षः) Cleverness, talent. E. मति, and प्रकर्ष superiority.
मतिभ्रम: मतिभ्रम m. (-मः) Error, mistake. E. मति understanding, and भ्रम error.
मतिभ्रान्ति: मतिभ्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Error, mistake, misapprehension. E. मति mind, understanding, and भ्रान्ति error.
मतिमत्: मतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Sensible, clever, intelligent. E. मति, and मतुप् aff.
मतिविभ्रम: मतिविभ्रम m. (-मः) Error. E. मति, and विभ्रम error.
मतिहीन: मतिहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Stupid, ignorant. E. मति, and हीन devoid of.
मत्क: मत्क mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं) Mine, belonging to me, &c. m. (-त्कः) A bug: (see the next.) E. मत् for मम mine, and कन् poss. aff.
मत्कुण: मत्कुण m. (-णः) 1 A bug. 2 A flea. 3 An elephant without tusks. 4 A beardless man. 5 The cocoanut. 6 Armour for the thighs or legs. 7 A buffalo. f. (-णा) The pudendum muliebre, without hair on the pubis. E. मट् or मत् pleasure, क्वन to sound, aff. अच्, the deriv. irr.
मत्कुणारि: मत्कुणारि m. (-रिः) Hemp, (Cannabis sativa.) E. मत्कुण a bug, and अरि an enemy.
मत्त: मत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Pleased, glad, delighted. 2 Intoxicated, (drunk with liquor.) 3 Intoxicated, (with pride, passion, &c.) 4 Furious, mad, insane. m. (-त्तः) 1 A furious elephant, or one in rut. 2 A buffalo. 3 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 4 The thorn apple, (Datura.) f. (-त्ता) 1 Vinous liquor. 2 A species of the Paṅkti metre. E. मद to rejoice, &c. aff. क्त.
मत्तकाशिनी: मत्तकाशिनी f. (-नी) An excellent woman. E. मत्त intoxicated, and काश to shine, aff. इनि; also from काष or कास, मत्तकाषिणी, and मत्तकासिनी.
मत्तकीश: मत्तकीश m. (-शः) An elephant. E. मत्तक for मत्त furious, and ईश lord, the vowel unchanged.
मत्तदन्तिन्: मत्तदन्तिन् m. (-न्ती) A furious elephant. E. मत्त, and दन्तिन् an elephant.
मत्तमयूर: मत्तमयूर m. (-रः) 1 A wild peacock. 2 A species of the Atijagatī metre. E. मत्त, and मयूर a peacock.
मत्तर: मत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Better or more than mine. E. मत् for मम mine, and डतरच् aff. of comparison.
मत्तवारण: मत्तवारण m. (-णः) A furious elephant, or one in rut. n. (-णं) 1 A painted wooden turret or veranda, on the top of a large building or palace. 2 An enclosure of trees, &c. round the walls of a princely residence. 3 Pounded betle nut. E. मत्त wild, and वारण्ण an elephant, or fence.
मत्ताक्रीड: मत्ताक्रीड n. (-डं) A species of the Vikṛti metre. E. मत्त, and आक्रीड playing.
मत्तालम्ब: मत्तालम्ब m. (-म्बः) A fence or enclosure round the walls of a palace, either artificial as palisades, or natural as a grove of trees, &c. E. मत्त mad, wild, (enemies, &c.) आलम्ब delaying.
मत्तेभगमना: मत्तेभगमना f. (-ना) A woman with a lounging or rolling walk. E. मत्त intoxicated, इभ an elephant, गमना who goes.
मत्पर: मत्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Devoted to me, (GOD.) E. मत्, and पर attentive.
मत्य: मत्य n. (-त्यं) 1 The iron-bound handle of a sickle. 2 The exercise or application of knowledge. 3 The means of acquiring knowledge. E. मति knowledge, &c., aff. यत्.
मत्र: मत्र(इ,)मत्रि r. 1st and 10th cls. (मन्त्रति मन्त्रयति) To speak privately, to counsel or advise. With आङ्, To address or salute. With नि, To invite.
मत्स: मत्स m. (-त्सः) A fish. E. मदि to be pleased, स aff.
मत्सर: मत्सर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Envious. 2 Niggardly, covetous. mf. (-रः-रा) 1 Envy, impatience of another's success or prosperity. 2 Passion, anger. f. (-रा) A gnat, a musquito. E. मदि to rejoice, Uṇādi aff. सर.
मत्सरिन्: मत्सरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Wicked, depraved, bad. 2 Envious. E. मत्सर envy, इनि aff.
मत्स्य: मत्स्य mf. (-त्स्यः-त्स्यी) A fish in general. m. (-त्स्यः) 1 A particular fish, probably the Śapharī, or the fish in which VIṢṆU was incarnate in his fish Avatāra. 2 A name of VIṢṆU, from his incarnation as a fish. 3 A country, enumerated amongst the midland divisions of India, (Dinajpur and Rangpur.) 4 One of the Purāṇas. E. मदि to be pleased, Uṇādi aff. स्यत्.
मत्स्यकरण्डिका: मत्स्यकरण्डिका f. (-का) A fish basket. E. मत्स्य a fish, and करण्ड a basket, कन् added in the fem. form.
मत्स्यगन्धा: मत्स्यगन्धा f. (-न्धा) 1 A plant, commonly Lāṅgalīya; (the common name is applied to the Nama zeylanica, and the Commelina salicifolia.) 2 The mother of the sacred poet VYĀSA: see मत्स्योदरी. E. मत्स्य a fish, and गन्ध smell.
मत्स्यघात: मत्स्यघात m. (-तः) Catching fish. E. मत्स्य, and घात killing.
मत्स्यजाल: मत्स्यजाल n. (-लं) A fishing net. E. मत्स्य fish, and जाल net.
मत्स्यण्डी: मत्स्यण्डी f. (-ण्डी) Coarse or unrefined sugar, the juice of the sugar-cane, either after its first boiling, or after it is partially freed from impurities by straining. E. मन्द slowly, स्यन्द to trickle or ooze, अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीप्, deriv. irr.; also with कन् added, मत्स्यण्डीका.
मत्स्यधानी: मत्स्यधानी f. (-नी) A fish basket, a small basket used by fishermen, to put the fish into when caught; it is also sometimes, but less accurately, applied to a kind of snare of reeds or grass, which is left in the water, and entangles the fish that swim with the current. E. मत्स्य a fish, धा to have or hold, aff. ल्युट्; also with आङ् prefixed, मत्स्याधानी.
मत्स्यनाशक: मत्स्यनाशक m. (-कः) An osprey. E. मत्स्य a fish, and नाशक destroyer.
मत्स्यनाशन: मत्स्यनाशन m. (-नः) An osprey. E. मत्स्य a fish, and नाशन destroyer.
मत्स्यपित्ता: मत्स्यपित्ता f. (-त्ता) A medicinal plant, commonly Katuki. E. मत्स्य a fish, and पित्त bile; being as bitter.
मत्स्यबन्धिन्: मत्स्यबन्धिन् m. (-न्धी) A fisherman. f. (-नी) A fish basket. E. मत्स्य a fish, and बन्ध confining, aff. इनि.
मत्स्यरङ्ग: मत्स्यरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A king-fisher. E. मत्स्य a fish, and रङ्ग inclination; also with कन् added, मत्स्यरङ्गक; it is also read मत्स्यरङ्क.
मत्स्यराज: मत्स्यराज m. (-जः) 1 The Rohi, a sort of fish, (Cyprinus Rohita, HAM.) 2 The country called Matsya. E. मत्स्य a fish, and राज supreme.
मत्स्यवेधन: मत्स्यवेधन nf. (-नं-नी) A fish-hook. f. (-नी) A bird, the shag, E. मत्स्य a fish, विध to pierce, aff. ल्युट्.
मत्स्यसंघात: मत्स्यसंघात m. (-तः) A shoal of young or small fish. E. मत्स्य a fish, and संघात heap, quantity.
मत्स्यसन्तानिक: मत्स्यसन्तानिक m. (-कः) Fish baked in a crust of clay and straw, and eaten with condiments and oil. E. मत्स्य fish, सन्तान product, aff. ठक्.
मत्स्याक्षी: मत्स्याक्षी f. (-क्षी) The moon-plant, (Asclepias acida.) E. मत्स्य a fish, and अक्ष an eye, aff. ङीष्; to which the flowers are compared.
मत्स्याङ्गी: मत्स्याङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A plant, (Hingtsha repens, Rox.) E. मत्स्य a fish, अङ्ग the body or form, aff. ङीष्.
मत्स्याद: मत्स्याद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who or what feeds upon fish. E. मत्स्य, and अद who eats.
मत्स्यादनी: मत्स्यादनी f. (-नी) A name applied to several plants, as to Jussieua repens, Hingtsha repens, Nama zeylanica, &c. E. मत्स्य a fish, अदन eating, food, aff. ङीष्.
मत्स्याशन: मत्स्याशन m. (-नः) The king-fisher. E. मत्स्य a fish, and अशन eating.
मत्स्योदरी: मत्स्योदरी f. (-री) 1 A name of SATYAVATĪ, the mother of VYĀSA. 2 A place of pilgrimage, a particular pool at Benares held in reverence by pilgrims to that sacred city. E. मत्स्य a fish, and उदर the belly; the mother of VYĀSA was found in the belly of a fish, and retaining a fishy odour, was thence also called MATSYAGANDHA, till the scent was changed to that of a lotus by her paramour the Muni PARĀŚARA, the father of VYĀSA.
मथ: मथ(ए,)मथे r. 1st cl. (मथति) 1 To churn. 2 To stir or agitate. (इ,) मथि (मन्थति) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To afflict. 3 To suffer pain.
मथन: मथन n. (-नं) Churning. m. (-नः) A tree, the wood of which is used to produce fire by attrition, (Premna longifolia.) E. मथ to churn, to stir or rub, aff. ल्युट्.
मथित: मथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stirred, churned. 2 Agitated, mentally, distressed, anxious. n. (-तं) Butter-milk, without any watery admixture. E. मथ to churn, aff. क्त.
मथिन्: मथिन् m. (-न्था) A churning stick. E. मथि to stir or agitate, aff. इन्, and the nasal rejected.
मथुरा: मथुरा f. (-रा) A town in the province of Agra, celebrated as the birth place, and early residence of KṚṢṆA, and still an object of pilgrimage amongst the Hindus. E. मथि to stir, Uṇādi aff. उरच्.
मथुरेश: मथुरेश m. (-शः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. मथुरा a town, and ईश ruler.
मथूरा: मथूरा f. (-रा) Mathurā as above. E. ऊरच् affixed to मथि, instead of उरच्.
मद: मद r. 1st cl. (मादयते) (इ, इर्) मदि r. 1st cl. (मन्दति), and (ई, इर्) मदी r. 4th cl. (माद्यति) 1 To be glad, to be satisfied or content, to rejoice. 2 To be proud. (इ) मदि r. 1st cl. (मन्दति) 1 To praise. 2 To sleep, to doze, to be lazy or sluggish. 3 To be stupid, to be an idiot or fool. 4 To be elegant. 5 To go or approach. मद r. 10th cl. (मादयते) To cause or justify satisfaction or contentment. मदी r. 1st cl. causal form (मादयति) 1 To delight, to make glad, to exhilarate. 2 To madden or intoxicate, literally or figuratively. 2 To be poor or distressed. 4 To be proud. With नि prefixed, (निमादयति) To articulate.

मद m. (-दः) 1 Joy, pleasure, delight. 2 The juice that flows from an elephant's temples when in rut. 3 Spirituous or vinous liquor. 4 Inebriety, intoxication. 5 Pride, arrogance. 6 Insanity, madness. 7 Semen virile. 8 Musk. 9 A male river. 10 Passion, desire. f. (-दी) 1 A drinking vessel. 2 An instrument for making furrows. E. मद to be pleased, &c., aff. अप् or अच्.
मदकल: मदकल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Speaking inarticulately or like a drunken person. m. (-लः) An elephant in rut. E. मद inebriety, &c., कल to sound, aff. अच्.
मदकोहल: मदकोहल m. (-लः) A bull that has been liberated at some festival, and is allowed to wander about at will. E. मद pleasure, कुह to sound, aff. अलच्.
मदगन्धा: मदगन्धा f. (-न्धा) Spirituous liquor. E. मद intoxication, and गन्ध smell.
मदगमन: मदगमन m. (-नः) A buffalo. E. मद pleasure, and गमन going.
मदघ्नी: मदघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) A potherb, (Basella lucida, &c.) E. मद inebriety, घ्नी what destroys.
मदन: मदन m. (-नः) 1 KĀMADEVA, the Hindu CUPID. 2 The season of spring. 3 A plant commonly Mayana, (Vangueria spinosa.) 4 Thorn apple, (Datura metel.) 5 A bee. 6 A sort of bean, (Phaseolus radiatus.) 7 Bee's wax. 8 A tree, (Mimosa catechu.) f. (-ना-नी) Spirituous or vinous liquor. E. मद to exhilarate or rejoice, aff. ल्युट्, fem. aff. टाप्, or ङीष्.
मदनकाकुरव: मदनकाकुरव m. (-वः) A pigeon, a dove. E. मदन love, काकु change of voice, and रव who utters.
मदनपाठक: मदनपाठक m. (-कः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. मदन spring, and पाठक reader; announcing the season.
मदनवश: मदनवश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Subdued by love, in love. E. मदन, and वश subdued.
मदनललित: मदनललित n. (-तं) 1 Sign or effect of love. 2 A species of the Aṣṭī metre.
मदनशलाका: मदनशलाका f. (-का) 1 A provocative medicine. 2 The Mayana, or more properly the Śārikā, a small bird. 3 The female of the Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. मदन love, &c., and शलाका the bird, or a dart, &c.
मदनसारिका: मदनसारिका f. (-का) The Śārikā or Śārika, a small bird, (Turdus salica.) E. मदब love, and सारिका the Śālikā.
मदनाङ्कुश: मदनाङ्कुश m. (-शः) 1 Membrum virile. 2 A finger nail. E. मदन KĀMADEVA, and अङ्कुश a goad.
मदनायुध: मदनायुध m. (-धः) Pudendum muliebre. E. मदन, and आयुध a weapon.
मदनालय: मदनालय m. (-यः) 1 A sovereign, a prince. 2 A lotus. 3 Pudendum muliebre. E. मदन pleasure, आलय receptacle, abode.
मदनावस्था: मदनावस्था f. (-स्था) Separation of lovers. E. मदन love, अव depreciative prefix, स्था to stay, aff. क, and टाप्.
मदनीय: मदनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be enamoured. 2 Causing or exciting passion. E. मद to delight, अनीयर् aff.
मदनोत्सव: मदनोत्सव m. (-वः) The vernal festival of the Hindus, the Holī. f. (-वा) A courtezan of heaven. E. मदन spring or love, and उत्सव festival.
मदप्रयोग: मदप्रयोग m. (-गः) The issue of the fluid from the forehead of an elephant in rut. E. मद the fluid, and प्रयोग junction.
मदभञ्जिनी: मदभञ्जिनी f. (-नी) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) E. मद inebriety, भञ्ज breaking, इनि aff.
मदयन्तिका: मदयन्तिका f. (-का) Arabian jasmine. E. कन् added to the next.
मदयन्ती: मदयन्ती f. (-न्ती) Arabian jasmine. E. मद to delight, झच् Uṇādi aff., and ङीप् fem. aff.
मदयित्नु: मदयित्नु m. (-त्नुः) 1 Love or CUPID. 2 A distiller. 3 A drunken man, a mad man. 4 A cloud. n. (-त्नु) Vinous or spirituous liquor. E. मद in the causal form, to intoxicate, &c., Uṇādi aff. इत्नुच्.
मदराग: मदराग m. (-गः) 1 Love or KĀMA. 2 A cock. E. मद passion or desire, and राग propensity, inclination.
मदविक्षिप्त: मदविक्षिप्त m. (-प्तः) A furious elephant, or one in rut. E. मद the juice, and विक्षिप्त tossed, agitated.
मदवृन्द: मदवृन्द m. (-न्दः) An elephant. E. मद the juice, and वृन्द a quantity.
मदस्थल: मदस्थल n. (-लं) A tavern, a dram shop. E. मद intoxication, and स्थल place.
मदस्थान: मदस्थान n. (-नं) A place where liquor is sold, a tavern, a dram shop. E. मद drunkenness, and स्थान place.
मदाढ्य: मदाढ्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Intoxicated, drunk. m. (-द्यः) The palm tree. f. (-द्या) A sort of Barleria, with red flowers. E. मद intoxication, आद्य fit or proper for.
मदातङ्क: मदातङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) Pain and sickness, consequent upon ebriety. E. मद, and आतङ्क fear.
मदात्यय: मदात्यय m. (-यः) Disorder induced by drunkenness; head-ache, sickness, loss of appetite, &c. E. मद drunkenness, and अत्यय consequence.
मदान्ध: मदान्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Blind with pride or passion, arrogant, dissolute, &c. E. मद, and अन्ध blind.
मदाम्नात: मदाम्नात m. (-तः) A drum carried on an elephant. E. मद pride, आम्नात minded, respected, from मना with आङ् prefix, and क्त aff.
मदाम्बर: मदाम्बर m. (-रः) INDRA'S elephant. E. मद the frontal fluid, and अम्बर garment, housing.
मदार: मदार m. (-रः) 1 An elephant. 2 A rogue. 3 A libertine, a lecher. 4 An elephant in rut. 5 A hog. 6 The name of a king. 7 A sort of perfume, probably musk. E. मद to be intoxicated, &c., Uṇādi aff. आरन्.
मदार्मद: मदार्म्मद m. (-दः) A sort of fish: see फलक.
मदार्म्मद: मदार्म्मद m. (-दः) A sort of fish: see फलक.
मदालस: मदालस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Indolent, slothful, overcome with passion or pride. E. मद, and अलस idle.
मदालापिन्: मदालापिन् m. (-पी) The Koïl; or Indian cuckoo. E. मद delight, आङ् before लप to speak, aff. णिनि; the song of this bird is constantly heard in the spring in most parts of Hindustan.
मदाह्व: मदाह्व m. (-ह्वः) Musk. E. मद musk, and आह्व name.
मदिर: मदिर m. (-रः) A red species of Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.) f. (-रा) 1 Wine, spirits, spirituous or vinous liquor. 2 A wagtail. 3 A species of the Ākṛti metre. E. मद to be delighted, &c., Uṇādi aff. किरन्, fem. aff. टाप्.
मदिराक्षी: मदिराक्षी f. (-क्षी) A woman, a mistress, a wife. E. मदिरा wine, अक्षि the eye, षच् and ङीष् affs., whose eyes inebriate like wine.
मदिरागृह: मदिरागृह n. (-हं) A tavern, a dram shop. E. मदिरा wine, and गृह a house.
मदिरासख: मदिरासख m. (-खः) The mango, (Mangifera Indica.) E. मदिरा wine or spirits, and सखि the friend.
मदिरेक्षणा: मदिरेक्षणा f. (-णा) A fascinating woman. E. मदिरा, and ईक्षण the eye.
मदिष्ठा: मदिष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) Vinous liquor. E. मद what delights or intoxicates, इष्ठन् superlative aff.
मदीय: मदीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Mine, my own. E. मत् for मम mine, and छ aff.
मदोत्कट: मदोत्कट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Arrogant, haughty. 2 Furious, mad. m. (-टः) 1 An elephant in rut. 2 A pigeon. E. मद, and उत्कट who is furious.
मदोदग्र: मदोदग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Haughty, arrogant. f. (-ग्रा) A woman in general. E. मद, and उदग्र elevated.
मदोद्धत: मदोद्धत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Drunk, intoxicated. 2 Arrogant, drunk with pride. E. मद drunkenness, उद्धत struck, overcome.
मदोन्मत्त: मदोन्मत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Drunk or mad with pride, passion, &c. E. मद, and उन्मत्त mad.
मद्गु: मद्गु m. (-द्गुः) 1 An aquatic bird, the shag. 2 An outcaste, the son of a Brahman by a woman of the bard, or panegyrist class, whose employment is hunting wild beasts. 3 A ship, a galley. E. मस्ज to emerge, to dive, उ aff., deriv. irr., or मद to be delighted, (in the water,) and गुक् Uṇādi aff.
मद्गुर: मद्गुर m. (-रः) A fish, (Macropteronatus Magur, HAM.) E. मद to intoxicate, उरच् Uṇādi aff., and गुक् augment, form irr.; also with कन् added, मद्गुरक्.
मद्गुरसी: मद्गुरसी f. (-सी) A sort of fish: see मद्गुर.
मद्य: मद्य n. (-द्यं) Wine, vinous or spirituous liquor. E. मद to be intoxicated (by it), aff. यत्.
मद्यपङ्क: मद्यपङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) Vinous liquor for distilling. E. मद्य wine, पङ्क mud.
मद्यपासन: मद्यपासन n. (-नं) Eating a relish, or what excites thirst. E. मद्य wine, पस to go, aff. ल्युट्.
मद्यपीत: मद्यपीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Drunk, a drunkard. E. मद्य, and पीत drunk.
मद्यपुष्पी: मद्यपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A plant, the blossoms of which are used in distilling: see मद्यवासिनी, &c. E. मद्य wine, पुष्प the flower.
मद्यमण्ड: मद्यमण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Yeast, barm, froth. E. मद्य wine, मण्ड froth, scum.
मद्यवासिनी: मद्यवासिनी f. (-नी) A shrub, the blossoms of which are used in distilling, (Grislea tomentosa, or Lythrum fruticosum.) E. मद्य wine, वस to dwell, aff. णिनि and ङीष्.
मद्यवीज: मद्यवीज n. (-जं) A drug used to produce fermentation. E. मद्य wine, and वीज seed.
मद्यसन्धान: मद्यसन्धान n. (-नं) Distillation. E. मद्य vinous liquor, and सन्धान distilling.
मद्र: मद्र m. (-द्रः) 1 Joy, delight. 2 A country enumerated amongst those to the N. W. of Hindustan proper. 3 A sovereign of that country. f. (-द्रा) The name of a river. E. मदि to be delighted, Uṇādi aff. रक्.
मद्रक: मद्रक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Produced, &c. in the country of Madra. E. मद्र a country so named, and कन् aff.
मद्रकार: मद्रकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Delighting, giving delight. E. मद्र delight, कृ to make, aff. अण्; also with खच् aff., मद्रङ्कर.
मद्रसुता: मद्रसुता f. (-ता) The wife of Pāṇḍu, mother of the two youngest Paṇḍu princes. E. मद्र a proper name, and सुता the daughter.
मद्वन्: मद्वन् m. (-द्वा) A name of ŚIVA. E. मद to be intoxicated, वनिप् Uṇādi aff.
मद्वर्गीण: मद्वर्गीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Connected with or related to me. E. मत् mine, वर्ग a class or number, ख aff.; also with छ aff., मद्वर्ग्गीय; and with यत्, मद्वर्ग्य.
मधु: मधु mfn. (-धुः-ध्वी-धु) Sweet, literally or figuratively. n. (-धु) 1 Spirituous liquor, distilled from the blossoms of the Bassia latifolia, or according to some explanations wine, or spirit distilled from grapes. 2 Honey. 3 The nectar, or honey of flowers. 4 Water. 5 Milk. 6 Sugar. 7 Sweetness, in flavour, sound, or disposition. m. (-धुः) 1 The month Chaitra, (March-April.) 2 The season of spring. 3 A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) 4 The name of a Daitya or demon, slain by VIṢṆU. 5 The Aśoka tree, (Jonesia asoca.) 6 Liquorice. 7 The name of a RĀKṢASA killed by ŚATRUGHNA. f. (-धुः) A plant, (Celtis orientalis.) E. मन to mind or respect, Uṇādi aff. उ, and ध substituted for the final.
मधुक: मधुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Sweet, (in taste.) 2 Sweet speaking, or sounding, mellifluous, melodious. m. (-कः) 1 A bard, a panegyrist, one who recites the lineage and praises of sovereigns in their presence. 2 A bird. 2 A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) mn. (-कः-कं) Liquorice, &c. n. (-कं) Tin. f. (-का) 1 A plant, (Menispermum. glabrum.) 2 The sweet lime. 3 A kind of panic seed. E. मधु sweet, कै to sound, aff. ड; or मधु honey, कन् aff. of comparison, &c.
मधुकण्ठ: मधुकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. मधु honey, (as sweet,) कण्ठ the throat.
मधुकर: मधुकर m. (-रः) 1 A bee. 2 A lover. 3 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) 4 A fruit, the round sweet lime. E. मधु honey, and कर what makes.
मधुकर्कटिका: मधुकर्क्कटिका f. (-का) 1 A sort of citron, the round sweet lime. 2 A kind of date. E. मधु honey, and कर्क्कटी or कर्क्कटिका a cucumber; some authorities have मधुकुक्कुटिका in place of this word.
मधुकर्क्कटिका: मधुकर्क्कटिका f. (-का) 1 A sort of citron, the round sweet lime. 2 A kind of date. E. मधु honey, and कर्क्कटी or कर्क्कटिका a cucumber; some authorities have मधुकुक्कुटिका in place of this word.
मधुकारिन्: मधुकारिन् m. (-री) A bee. E. मधु, and कारिन् who makes.
मधुकेशट: मधुकेशट m. (-टः) A bee. E. मधुके in honey, and शट to go, aff. अच्.
मधुकृत्: मधुकृत् m. (-कृत्) A bee. E. मधु honey, and कृत् what makes.
मधुकोष: मधुकोष m. (-षः) The honeycomb or hive. E. मधु honey, कोष receptacle.
मधुक्रम: मधुक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Tippling. 2 The honeycomb. E. मधु wine or honey, and क्रम order, arrangement.
मधुक्षीर: मधुक्षीर m. (-रः) The date tree. E. मधु honey, and क्षीर milk.
मधुघोष: मधुघोष m. (-षः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. मधु sweet, and घोष voice.
मधुज: मधुज n. (-जं) Bee's wax. f. (-जा) 1 The earth. 2 Clayed or candied sugar. E. मधु honey, and ज produced.
मधुजित्: मधुजित् m. (-जित्) VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. E. मधु the demon so named, and जित् conqueror.
मधुतृण: मधुतृण n. (-णं) Sugar-cane. E. मधु sweet, and तृण grass.
मधुदीप: मधुदीप m. (-पः) KĀMA, the Hindu CUPID. E. मधु spring, and दीप inflaming.
मधुदूत: मधुदूत m. (-तः) The mango tree. E. मधु spring, and दूत messenger; blossoming in spring.
मधुद्र: मधुद्र m. (-द्रः) A bee. E. मधु honey, द्रु to take, क aff., and the vowel changed.
मधुद्रव: मधुद्रव m. (-वः) A red variety of the Hyperanthera morunga. E. मधु honey, and द्रव dropping.
मधुद्रुम: मधुद्रुम m. (-मः) A tree, from the blossoms of which a spirit is distilled, (Bassia latifolia.) E. मधु wine, and द्रुम a tree.
मधुधातु: मधुधातु m. (-तुः) A sort of pyrites. E. मधु honey, (as yellow,) and धातु mineral, honey-stone.
मधुधूलि: मधुधूलि f. (-लिः) Molasses, sugar before it is quite purified. E. मधु honey, and धूलि dust.
मधुनालिकेरक: मधुनालिकेरक m. (-कः) A sweet kind of cocoanut. E. मधु sweet, नालिकेरक cocoanut.
मधुनेतृ: मधुनेतृ m. (-ता) A bee. E. मधु honey, नी to get, तृच् aff.
मधुनोलेह: मधुनोलेह m. (-हः) A bee. E. मधुनः of honey, लेह who licks.
मधुप: मधुप m. (-पः) A bee. E. मधु honey, and प who drinks.
मधुपर्क: मधुपर्क n. (-र्कं) A dish of curds, ghee, and honey, to be offered to a respectable guest on his arrival. E. मधु honey, पृच to sprinkle, aff. घञ्.
मधुपर्णिका: मधुपर्णिका f. (-का) 1 The indigo plant. 2 A tree, (Gmelina arborea.) 3 Moon plant, (Asclepias acida.) 4 A creeper of the cryptogamia class, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.) 5 A shrub, (Menispermum glabrum.) E. मधु honey, पर्ण a leaf, aff. कन्, fem. form; also मधुपर्णी.
मधुपर्णी: मधुपर्णी f. (-र्णी) 1 A sort of creeper, (Menispermum glabrum.) 2 A tree, (Gmelina arborea.) 3 The indigo plant. 4 The sweet lime. E. मधु honey, पर्ण the leaf, aff. ङीष्.
मधुपायिन्: मधुपायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Living on honey. m. (-यी) A bee. E. मधु honey, पा to drink, णिनि aff., and युक् augment.
मधुपालिका: मधुपालिका f. (-का) A tree, (Gmelina arborea.) E. मधु honey, पाल to nourish, वुन् aff., fem. form.
मधुपुरी: मधुपुरी f. (-री) Mathurā, a city so called. E. मधु the Rākṣasa killed by ŚATRUGHNA, and पुरी city or capital.
मधुपुष्प: मधुपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) 2 The Mimosa Śirīṣa. 3 The Bakul, (Mimusops elengi.) E. मधु wine or honey, and पुष्प flower.
मधुप्रिय: मधुप्रिय m. (-यः) 1 A shrub, (Ardisia solanacea.) 2 A name of BALARĀMA. E. मधु wine, &c., and प्रिय fond of.
मधुफल: मधुफल m. (-लः) 1 A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) 2 A sweet kind of cocoanut. E. मधु honey, and फल fruit.
मधुमत्: मधुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Sweet, honied. f. (-ती) A species of the Uṣṇih metre. E. मधु, and मतुप् aff.
मधुभिद्: मधुभिद् m. (-भिट् or -भित्) A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. E. मधु the Daitya, and भिट् destroyer.
मधुमक्षिका: मधुमक्षिका f. (-का) A bee. E. मधु honey, and मक्षिका a fly.
मधुमथन: मधुमथन m. (-नः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. मधु the Daitya, and मथन destroyer.
मधुमय: मधुमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Sweet, luscious. E. मधु, and मयट् aff.
मधुमल्ली: मधुमल्ली f. (-ल्ली) Double jasmine. E. मधु honey, and मल्ली jasmine.
मधुमस्तक: मधुमस्तक n. (-कं) A sweetmeat made of flour, honey, oil, and ghee. E. मधु honey, and मस्तक a head.
मधुमाध्वीक: मधुमाध्वीक m. (-कं) A spirit distilled from the flowers of the Bassia latifolia. E. मधु spirit, and माध्वीक the same.
मधुमूल: मधुमूल n. (-लं) An esculent root, a sort of yam. E. मधु spirit, and मूल root.
मधुयष्टि: मधुयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Sugar-cane. E. मधु honey, and यष्टि a cane or stick.
मधुयष्टिका: मधुयष्टिका f. (-का) Liquorice, (Glycirrhiza glabra, or rather the Abrus precatorius, of which the root is similarly used.) E. मधु honey, यष्टि a stick, and कन् added; or without the aff. मधुयष्टी f. (-ष्टी)
मधुर: मधुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Sweet. 2 Pleasing, agreeable, liked. m. (-रः) 3 The sweet taste, sweetness. 4 A drug, commonly Jīvaka. n. (-रं) 1 Poison. 2 Tin. 3 Treacle, syrup. f. (-रा) 1 A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa or panmorium, Rox.) 2 Anise, (Pimpinella anisum.) 3 A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) 4 Liquorice. 5 The sweet lime. 6 Marrow. 7 The city Mathurā. 8 A medicinal plant, commonly Kakkoli. 9 Asparagus racemosus. 10 Bengal beet. E. मधु honey, and रा to get or be, aff. क; to have the flavour of honey, to be as sweet.
मधुरक: मधुरक m. (-कः) A medicinal plant, commonly Jīvaka. E. मधुर the same, and कन् added.
मधुरकण्टक: मधुरकण्टक m. (-कः) A sort of fish. E. मधुर sweet, and कण्टक bone.
मधुरजम्बीर: मधुरजम्बीर m. (-रः) The sweet lime. E. मधुर sweet, जम्बीर lime.
मधुरत्वच: मधुरत्वच m. (-चः) A shrub, (Grislea tomentosa.) E. मधुर sweet, त्वच् bark, अच् added.
मधुरनिस्वना: मधुरनिस्वना f. (-ना) A woman with a sweet voice. E. मधुर sweet, निस्वन who sounds.
मधुरवीजपूर: मधुरवीजपूर m. (-रः) The sweet lime. E. मधुर sweet, वीजपूर a citron.
मधुरस: मधुरस m. (-सः) 1 Sweetness, (in flavour.) 2 Sweetness, (in speech.) 3 The sugar-cane. 4 The palm tree. f. (-सा) 1 A shrub, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) 2 A plant, (Asclepias acida.) E. मधु wine or honey, and रस juice, flavour.
मधुराक्षर: मधुराक्षर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Sweet, mellifluous, mellow, melodious. E. मधुर, and अक्षर a letter.
मधुराम्लक: मधुराम्लक m. (-कः) The hog plum, (Spondias mangifera.) E. मधुर sweet, अम्ल sour, कन् aff.
मधुरालापा: मधुरालापा f. (-पा) The talking Maina, (Turdus salica.) E. मधुर sweet, आलाप talking, fem. form.
मधुरिका: मधुरिका f. (-का) A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa, Rox.) E. मधुरा the same, कन् aff.; this name is applied also to the Anethum panmorium, Rox. and the Bengali derivative Mahuri is applied to common anise.
मधुरिपु: मधुरिपु m. (-पुः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. मधु the demon, and रिपु foe.
मधुरोदक: मधुरोदक m. (-कः) The sea of fresh or sweet water, surrounding Puṣkara dvīpa, and being the outermost of the seven seas. E. मधुर sweet, and उदक water.
मधुल: मधुल n. (-लं) Spirituous or vinous liquor. E. मधु wine, ला to be or get, aff. क.
मधुलिह्: मधुलिह् m. (-लिड्-लिट्) A bee. E. मधु honey, लिह् to lick, aff. क्विष्.
मधुलेह: मधुलेह m. (-हः) A bee. E. मधु, and लेह what licks.
मधुलेहिन्: मधुलेहिन् m. (-ही) A bee. E. मधु honey, लिह to lick, aff. णिनि
मधुवन: मधुवन m. (-नः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. मधु sweet, and वन who speaks or cries.
मधुवार: मधुवार m. (-रः) Tippling, drinking frequently and repeatedly. E. मधु wine, वार quantity.
मधुवीज: मधुवीज m. (-जः) The pomegranate. E. मधु sweet, वीज seed.
मधुव्रत: मधुव्रत m. (-तः) A bee. E. मधु honey, व्रत observance.
मधुशाख: मधुशाख m. (-खः) Bassia latifolia. E. मधु spirituous liquor, शाखा a branch.
मधुशिग्रु: मधुशिग्रु m. (-ग्रुः) A red variety of the Hyperanthera morunga. E. मधु sweet, and शिग्रु the same tree.
मधुश्रेणी: मधुश्रेणी f. (-णी) A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) E. मधु honey, श्रेणी a line or row.
मधुष्ठील: मधुष्ठील m. (-लः) A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) E. मधु spirit, ष्ठीव to eject, aff. क, and ल substituted for the final.
मधुसख: मधुसख m. (-खः) KĀMADEVA. E. मधु spring, and सख for सखि friend.
मधुसहाय: मधुसहाय m. (-यः) KĀMADEVA. E. मधु, and सहाय friend.
मधुसात्: मधुसात् ind. As honey, sweet. E. मधु, and साति aff.
मधुसाद्भूत: मधुसाद्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become sweet. E. मधुसात्, and भूत become.
मधुसारथि: मधुसारथि m. (-थिः) KĀMA the Hindu CUPID. E. मधु the spring personified, and सारथि a charioteer, having Vasanta or spring for his coachman.
मधुसिक्थक: मधुसिक्थक m. (-क) A sort of poison. E. मधु honey, and सिक्थक wax.
मधुसुहृद्: मधुसुहृद् m. (-हृद् or -हृत्) KĀMADEVA. E. मधु spring, सुहृत् the friend.
मधुसूदन: मधुसूदन m. (-नः) A name of VIṢṆU. f. (-नी) Bengal beet. E. मधु the Daitya or honey, and सूदन destroyer.
मधुस्रवस्: मधुस्रवस् m. (-वाः) A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) E. मधु spirituous liquor, स्रु to drop or distil, aff. असुन्.
मधुस्रवा: मधुस्रवा f. (-वा) 1 A plant, (Celtis orientalis.) 2 Liquorice. E. मधु honey, स्रु to drop, aff. अप् and टाप्.
मधुस्वर: मधुस्वर m. (-रः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. मधु sweet or spring, and स्वर note, song.
मधुहन्: मधुहन् m. (-हा) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. मधु the Daitya, and हन् destroyer.
मधूक: मधूक m. (-कः) A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) E. मन to respect, ऊक aff., and ध substituted for the final.
मधूच्छिष्ट: मधूच्छिष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Bee's wax. E. मधु honey, and उच्छिष्ट left, rejected.
मधूपघ्न: मधूपघ्न n. (-घ्नं) The city Mathurā. E. मधु the demon, उपघ्न destruction.
मधूल: मधूल m. (-लः) A sort of Bassia described as growing in watery or mountainous situations. f. (-ली) 1 Liquorice. 2 The sweet lime. 3 The mango tree. 4 A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) E. मधु honey or spirit, ला to be or get, aff. ड, and the उ of मधु irregularly long.
मधूलक: मधूलक mfn. (-लकः लिका-लकं) Sweet. m. (-कः) 1 A sort of Bassia, growing in watery or mountainous sites. 2 Sweetness. f. (-लिका) A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
मध्य: मध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 Middle, intermediate. 2 Right, proper, reasonable. 3 Low, vile. 4 Amongst, amidst. 5 Mean, (in astronomy,) as मध्यछाया middle or mean shadow. mn. (-ध्यः-ध्यं) 1 The west. 2 Mean or common time in music. 3 The middle, the centre. 4 The waist. f. (-ध्या) 1 A young woman, a girl arrived at puberty. 2 The middle finger. 3 A form of metre, a stanza of four lines containing three syllables in each. m. (-ध्यः) Cessation, rest, interval. n. (-ध्यं) 1 A very large number, ten Āntyas. 2 A horse's flank. E. मां beauty, धा to have, अण् aff., deriv. irr.
मध्यग: मध्यग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Who or what goes in the centre or betwixt, amongst, &c. E. मध्य, and ग what goes.
मध्यगन्ध: मध्यगन्ध m. (-न्धः) The mango tree. E. मध्य middle, and गन्ध smell.
मध्यचारिन्: मध्यचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Going amongst or amidst. E. मध्य, and चारिन् who goes.
मध्यतस्: मध्यतस् ind. From or in the middle, centrical, centrically. E. मध्य the middle, and तसि aff.
मध्यदेश: मध्यदेश m. (-शः) The middle region; part of India, bounded by Kurukṣetra on the north, Allahabad on the south, the Himālaya mountains on the east, and the Vindhya mountains on the west; comprising therefore the modern provinces of Allahabad, Agra, Delhi, Oude, &c.; the northern limit is elsewhere defined to be the disappearance of the Sarasvatī. E. भध्य middle, and देश country.
मध्यम: मध्यम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Middle, centrical, intervening, intermediate. 2 Middle born, neither the oldest nor youngest. 3 Mean, (in astronomy,) as मध्यमगति mean motion (of a planet.) mn. (-मः-मं) The waist, the middle of the body. m. (-मः) 1 One of the seven musical notes, the fifth note of the Hindu gamut. 2 The middle country: see मध्यदेश. 3 A sort of deer. 4 One of the Grāmas or musical scales of the Hindus, corresponding apparently with the major mode of European music. f. (-मा) 1 A girl arrived at puberty, or in whom menstruation has commenced. 2 The middle finger. 3 A central blossom. 4 A form of metre, a verse of four lines of three syllables each. E. मध्य middle, and म aff.
मध्यमपाण्डव: मध्यमपाण्डव m. (-वः) ARJUNA, the third or middle of the PĀṆḌU princes. E. मध्यम middle, and पाण्डव Pāṇḍava or descendant of PĀṆḌU.
मध्यमलोक: मध्यमलोक m. (-कः) The earth, the world of mortals. E. मध्यम middle, and लोक world; between heaven and hell.
मध्यमभृतक: मध्यमभृतक m. (-कः) A husbandman. E. मध्यम middle, and भृतक a labourer; working partly for his own advantage, and partly for that of the landlord.
मध्यमवयस्क: मध्यमवयस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Middle, aged. E. मध्यम, and वयस्क aged.
मध्यमसंग्रह: मध्यमसंग्रह m. (-हः) Intriguing with another man's wife, the act of presenting flowers, perfumes, &c. to her, and conversing with her privately. E. मध्यम middle, संग्रह connexion.
मध्यमसाहस: मध्यमसाहस n. (-सः) 1 Punishment due to crimes of a middling degree. 2 Injuring buildings, throwing down walls, &c. E. मध्यम middle, साहस violence.
मध्यमिका: मध्यमिका f. (-का) A girl arrived at puberty, one in whom menstruation has commenced. E. मध्यमा the same, कन् added, in the fem. form.
मध्यमीय: मध्यमीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Central, middle. E. मध्यम middle, and छ aff.
मध्ययव: मध्ययव m. (-वः) A weight of six white mustard seeds. E. मध्य middle, and यव barley-corn, the Yava being sometimes considered equal to eight seeds.
मध्यरात्र: मध्यरात्र m. (-त्रः) Midnight. E. मध्य middle, रात्र night, and the masculine form in the compound.
मध्यलोक: मध्यलोक m. (-कः) The earth, the dwelling of mortals. E. मध्य middle, and लोक world; placed in the middle between heaven and hell; also with कन् added मध्यलोकक.
मध्यलोकेश: मध्यलोकेश m. (-शः) A king, a sovereign. E. मध्यलोक the earth, and ईश sovereign.
मध्यवर्तिन्: मध्यवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) 1 Central, middle. 2 Being amongst or amidst. m. (-र्त्ती) A mediator. E. मध्य, and वर्त्तिन् who abides.
मध्यवर्त्तिन्: मध्यवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) 1 Central, middle. 2 Being amongst or amidst. m. (-र्त्ती) A mediator. E. मध्य, and वर्त्तिन् who abides.
मध्यवृत्त: मध्यवृत्त n. (-त्तं) The navel. E. मध्य the middle, and वृत्त abiding.
मध्यस्थ: मध्यस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Centrical, middle. m. (-स्थः) A middle man, an umpire, an arbitrator, a mediator. E. मध्य middle, and स्थ what or who stays.
मध्यस्थता: मध्यस्थता f. (-ता) 1 Middle state or character. 2 Indifference. E. मध्यस्थ middle, and तल् aff. of the abstract; also with त्व, मध्यस्थत्व n. (-त्वं)
मध्यस्थल: मध्यस्थल n. (-लं) The waist. E. मध्य middle, स्थल place or part.
मध्याह्न: मध्याह्न m. (-ह्नः) Midday, noon. E. मध्य middle, अहन् a day.
मध्वल: मध्वल m. (-लः) Tippling, drinking repeatedly. E. मधु wine, अल to be equal to, aff. अच्.
मध्वापात: मध्वापात m. (-तः) Taste or touch of honey. E. मधु, and आपात alighting.
मध्वालुक: मध्वालुक n. (-कं) Sweet potatoe. E. मधु sweet, आलु an esculent root, कन् added.
मध्वासव: मध्वासव m. (-वः) A spirituous liquor, distilled from the blossoms of the Bassia latifolia. E. मधु the Bassia, and आसव spirit.
मध्वासवनिक: मध्वासवनिक m. (-कः) A distiller. E. मध्वासव spirit, नी to go, aff. क, form irr.
मन: मन r. 4th cl. (मन्यते) (उ,) मनु r. 8th cl. (मनुते) 1 To know, to understand. 2 To regard, to mind. 3 To think, to conceive. r. 10th cl. (मानयते) 1 To be dull or insensible. 2 To be proud. 3 To oppose, to stop. r. 1st and 10th cls. (मनति मानयति) To honour, to respect, to worship. With अनु prefixed, To assent to, to agree. With अभि, To desire. With अव, To disrespect. With सम, To concur, to agree.
मन n. (-नं) Indian spikenard. E. मन to respect, aff. अच्.
मनआप: मनआप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Pleasing, agreeable, beautiful. E. मनस् the mind, आप to go or attract, aff. अच्; the final consonant of the first word is rejected, and the vowels do not coalesce.
मनःकृत: मनःकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Attended to, applying the mind. E. मनस्, and कृत made.
मनःशिल: मनःशिल mf. (-लः-ला) Red arsenic. E. मनस् the mind, शिला a stone; a mineral delightful to the mind or heart; also with the dental स, मनःसिल.
मनःसिल: मनःसिल mf. (-लः-ला) Red arsenic: see the last.
मनन: मनन n. (-नं) Minding, understanding. E. मन to know, aff, ल्युट्.
मनस्: मनस् n. (-नः) 1 The mind, or considered as the seat of perception and passion, the heart. 2 The intellect, the understanding. E. मन to know, to understand, aff. असुन्.
मनसा: मनसा f. (-सा) The goddess of the serpent race, and the particular protectress against their venom. E. मनस् the mind, aff. ठाप्; the object of love and devotion.
मनसाज्ञायिन्: मनसाज्ञायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Knowing by the mind, perceiving intellectually. E. मनसा third case of मबस्, and ज्ञायिन् who knows.
मनसादेवी: मनसादेवी f. (-वी) The goddess presiding over snakes: see the last. E. मनसा the same, and देवी goddess.
मनसिज: मनसिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Mental, intellectual. m. (-जः) A name of KĀMA or love. E. मनसि in the heart or mind, and ज born.
मनसिशय: मनसिशय m. (-यः) KĀMA or love. E. मनसि in the heart or mind, and शय who reposes.
मनस्क: मनस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Mental. E. मनस्, and कन् aff.
मनस्कार: मनस्कार m. (-रः) The attention of the mind to its own sensations, consciousness of pleasure or pain. E. मनस् of the mind, and कार operation; the compound also occurs with the seventh case सनसिकार.
मनस्ताप: मनस्ताप m. (-पः) Mental distress. E. मनस्, and ताप sorrow.
मनस्ताल: मनस्ताल m. (-लः) The lion of DURGĀ. E. मनस् the mind, तल to depress, aff. घञ्.
मनस्विता: मनस्विता f. (-ता) 1 Hope, expectation, dependance. 2 Intelligence. E. मनस्विन्, and तल् aff.
मनस्विन्: मनस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 1 Attentive, fixing the mind upon any thing. 2 Intelligent, intellectual. f. (-स्विनी) A virtuous wife. E. मनस् the mind or heart, aff. विन्.
मनाक्: मनाक् ind. 1 A little. 2 Tardily, slowly. E. मन to know, आक् aff.
मनाका: मनाका f. (-का) A female elephant. E. मन to mind or know, Uṇādi aff. आक.
मनाक्कर: मनाक्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Doing little, lazy, sluggish. f. (-रा) A sort of Agallochum. E. मनाक् a little, and कर who does.
मनायी: मनायी f. (-यी) The wife of MANU. E. मनु the saint, ङीष् aff., and उ changed to ऐ; otherwise मनवी the same.
मनित: मनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Known, understood. E. मन to know, aff. क्त.
मनीक: मनीक n. (-कं) Collyrium, powdered antimony or other substances, used as an application and ornament to the eye. E. मन to know, to be agreeable, ईकन् Uṇādi aff.
मनीषा: मनीषा f. (-षा) Intellect, understanding. E. मनस् mind, ईष to go, aff. क, or ईष aff., form irr.
मनीषिन्: मनीषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Intellectual, intelligent. m. (-षी) A Paṇḍita, a learned Brahman, a teacher. E. मनीषा understanding, इनि possessive aff.
मनु: मनु m. (-नुः) 1 MANU, the legislator and saint, the son of BRAHMĀ, or a personification of BRAHMĀ himself, the creator of the world, and progenitor of mankind; the name is however a generic term, and in every Kalpa or interval from creation to creation, there are fourteen successive MANUS presiding over the universe for the period of a Manvantara, respectively: in the present creation there have been the six following MANUS: MANU called also SVAYAMBHUVA, the supposed revealer of the code of law possessed by the Hindus, SVAROCIṢA, UTTAMA, TĀMASA, RAIVATA, and CĀKṢUṢA; the seventh or the present MANU is VAIVASVATA, or RAIVATA the second. 2 A man in general. 3 One of the Jaina saints. 4 A Mantra, a mystical verse or formula. f. (-नुः-नायी-नावी) The wife of the legislator MANU. E. मन to know or understand, (the Vedas or scripture especially,) and उ Uṇādi aff.
मनुज: मनुज m. (-जः) A man in general. f. (-जा) A woman. E. मनु the legislator and progenitor of mankind, and ज born, descended.
मनुजेन्द्र: मनुजेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A king. E. मनुज, and इन्द्र chief.
मनुभू: मनुभू m. (-भूः) Man, a man, mankind. E. मनु the saint, and भू born: see the last.
मनुराज्: मनुराज् m. (-राट्) KUVERA, the god of wealth. E. मनु man, and राज् to shine, aff. क्विप्.
मनुषी: मनुषी f. (-षी) A woman, the wife or female of the man. E. मनुष्य a man, and ङीष् aff.
मनुष्य: मनुष्य m. (-ष्यः) Man, a man, mankind. E. मनु the progenitor of mankind, यत् aff. of descent, and युक् augment.
मनुष्यत्व: मनुष्यत्व n. (-त्वं) The state or condition of man, manhood, humanity. E. त्व added to मनुष्य; also with तल्, मनुष्यता.
मनुष्यधर्मन्: मनुष्यधर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) KUVERA, the god of wealth. n. (-र्म्म) The duty of man. E. मनुष्य man, and धर्म्मन् piety.
मनुष्यधर्म्मन्: मनुष्यधर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) KUVERA, the god of wealth. n. (-र्म्म) The duty of man. E. मनुष्य man, and धर्म्मन् piety.
मनुष्ययज्ञ: मनुष्ययज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) Hospitality. E. मनुष्य a man, and यज्ञ sacrifice, sacrament.
मनुष्यसभा: मनुष्यसभा f. (-भा) 1 A multitude, a crowd, a meeting. 2 A place of meeting or assembly. E. मनुष्य a man, mankind, and सभा assembly.
मनोगत: मनोगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seated in the mind. n. (-तं) Thoughts, ideas, notions, feelings. E. मनस्, and गत gone to or in.
मनोगवी: मनोगवी f. (-वी) Wish, desire. E. मनस् the mind, and गो a cow, &c., fem. form.
मनोगुप्त: मनोगुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Thought or meditated on secretly. f. (-प्ता) Red arsenic. E. मनस् the mind, and गुप्त cherished.
मनोज: मनोज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born or seated in the mind. m. (-जः) KĀMA. E. मनस्, and ज born.
मनोजन्मन्: मनोजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Born or seated in the mind. m. (-न्मा) KĀMA or CUPID. E. मनस् the heart or mind, and जन्मन् birth; also मनोज.
मनोजव: मनोजव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Fatherly, parental. 2 Quick in thought or apprehension. 3 Swift, as thought. f. (-वा) A plant: see अग्निजिह्वा. n. (-वं) Quickness of thought or apprehension. E. मनस् the mind, जु to move, to pervade, aff. अच्, or मनस् compounded with जव speed.
मनोजवस: मनोजवस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Fatherly. E. मनोज desire, love, वस to abide, aff. अच्.
मनोज्ञ: मनोज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Beautiful, handsome, lovely, pleasing, agreeable. f. (-ज्ञा) 1 Red arsenic. 2 The daughter of a sovereign, a princess. E. मनस् the mind or heart, ज्ञा to know, to get, aff. क.
मनोदण्ड: मनोदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Restraint or controul over the mind. E. मनस्, and दण्ड castigation.
मनोनीत: मनोनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Chosen, preferred. E. मनस्, and नीत taken.
मनोभव: मनोभव m. (-वः) KĀMA or CUPID. E. मनस् the mind or heart, and भव born.
मनोभू: मनोभू m. (-भूः) KĀMADEVA. E. मनस् the heart, भू born.
मनोयायिन्: मनोयायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Swift, quick, as thought. E. मनस्, and यायिन् what goes.
मनोयोनि: मनोयोनि m. (-निः) The deity KĀMA. E. मनस् the heart, and योनि place of production.
मनोरथ: मनोरथ m. (-थः) Wish, desire. E. मनस् the heart, and रथ vehicle.
मनोरम: मनोरम mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Beautiful, lovely, pleasing. f. (-मा) 1 A goddess, peculiar to the Bauddhas. 2 A species of the Paṅkti metre. E. मनस् the mind, रम to delight, aff. अच्.
मनोलौल्य: मनोलौल्य n. (-ल्यं) Fancy, caprice, whim. E. मनस्, and लौल्य unsteadiness.
मनोहत: मनोहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disappointed. E. मनस् the mind, हत struck.
मनोहर: मनोहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Beautiful, lovely, pleasing. E. मनस् the mind, हृ to take or steal, aff. अप्.
मनोहारिन्: मनोहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable, lovely. E. मनस् the mind, हृ to steal, aff. णिनि.
मनोह्वा: मनोह्वा f. (-ह्वा) Red arsenic. E. मनस् the mind, and ह्वेञ् to call, to arrest, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
मन्तव्य: मन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be reflected on, to be ascertained or fixed in the mind, to be discussed either mentally or with proper persons. 2 To be thought, believed, conceived, &c. E. मन to know, aff. तव्य.
मन्तु: मन्तु m. (-न्तुः) 1 Fault, offence, transgression. 2 A man, mankind. 3 A king. f. (-न्तुः) Understanding, intellect. E. मन to know, Uṇādi aff. तु.
मन्तृ: मन्तृ m. (-न्ता) 1 A sage, one who is possessed of holy knowledge. 2 An adviser, a counsellor. E. मन to know, Uṇādi aff. तृच्.
मन्त्र: मन्त्र m. (-न्त्रः) 1 A division of the Vedas; in the first or practical part or Kāṇḍam, it includes prayers and hymns, addressed to particular deities, and used at peculiar sacrifices, &c.; in the Uttara Kāṇḍam, it is applied to addresses to BRAHMĀ or God, and to didactic explanations of his nature and attributes,  &c. 2 A mystical verse or incantation, (in the Tantras.) 3 A formula sacred to any individual deity, as, Om Viṣṇave nama, Om Śivāya nama, &c. 4 Secret consultation, private advice. E. मत्रि to advise or consult privately, aff. अच्.
मन्त्रकृत्: मन्त्रकृत् m. (-कृत्) A counsellor, a minister. E. मन्त्र advice, and कृत् who gives or makes.
मन्त्रकृत: मन्त्रकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Consecrated by the Mantra. E. मन्त्र, and कृत made.
मन्त्रगण्डक: मन्त्रगण्डक m. (-कः) Knowledge, science. E. मन्त्र advice, गडि to be a part of, aff. वुन्.
मन्त्रगुप्ति: मन्त्रगुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Secret counsel. E. मन्त्र, and गुप्ति concealing.
मन्त्रगूढ: मन्त्रगूढ m. (-ढः) A spy, a secret emissary or agent. E. मन्त्र advice, information, गूढ secret.
मन्त्रजिह्व: मन्त्रजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) A name of fire. E. मन्त्र prayer, and जिह्वा the tongue.
मन्त्रज्ञ: मन्त्रज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) 1 A spy, a secret emissary or agent. 2 A counsellor, an adviser. 3 A priest, a sacred teacher. E. मन्त्र advice, &c. and ज्ञ who knows.
मन्त्रण: मन्त्रण nf. (-णं-णा) Advising, counselling in private. E. मत्रि to counsel, युच् aff.
मन्त्रतस्: मन्त्रतस् ind. 1 From, with, or by, a Mantra or mystical prayer. 2 Advisedly, deliberately. E. मन्त्र, and तसि substituted for the termination of the fourth or fifth cases.
मन्त्रद: मन्त्रद m. (-दः) A spiritual guide or teacher. E. मन्त्र initiatory text, and द who gives.
मन्त्रदर्शिन्: मन्त्रदर्शिन् m. (-र्शी) A Brahman learned in the Vedas. E. मन्त्र, and दर्शिन् who sees.
मन्त्रदीधिति: मन्त्रदीधिति m. (-तिः) AGNI or fire. E. मन्त्र holy prayer, and दीधिति lustre.
मन्त्रपूतात्मन्: मन्त्रपूतात्मन् m. (-त्मा) A name of GARUḌA. E. मन्त्र, and पूतात्मन् pure.
मन्त्रफल: मन्त्रफल n. (-लं) The object or effect of counsel. E. मन्त्र, and फल fruit.
मन्त्रभेद: मन्त्रभेद m. (-दः) Divulging or betraying counsel. E. मन्त्र, and भेद breaking.
मन्त्रयत्: मन्त्रयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Counselling, consulting. E. मत्रि to advise, शतृ aff.
मन्त्रवत्: मन्त्रवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Accompanied with holy texts, (a ceremony.) 2 Entitled to use the Vedas. 3 Initiated. 4 Having or hearing counsel. E. मन्त्र, and मतुप् aff.
मन्त्रवित्: मन्त्रवित् m. (-विट्-वित्) 1 A spy, a secret emissary or agent. 2 A counsellor. 3 A priest. 4 A Brahman learned in the Vedas. E. मन्त्र secret council, &c. and विट् who knows.
मन्त्रस्पृश्: मन्त्रस्पृश् mfn. (-स्पृक्) Obtaining or effecting any thing by means of mystic formulæ or prayers. E. मन्त्र a prayer of the Vedas, &c., and स्पृश् to touch, aff. क्विन्.
मन्त्रित: मन्त्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Advised, counselled, planned. E. मत्रि to consult, aff. क्त.
मन्त्रित्व: मन्त्रित्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Property or condition of a counsellor, counsellorship. E. मन्त्रिन्, and त्व added.
मन्त्रिन्: मन्त्रिन् m. (-न्त्री) A counsellor or adviser, a king's counsellor or minister. E. मचि to advise, इनि aff.
मन्त्रोपष्टम्भ: मन्त्रोपष्टम्भ m. (-म्मः) Advice, direction. E. मन्त्र, and उपष्टम्भ stopping.
मन्थ: मन्थ r. 1st cl. (मन्थति) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To afflict. 3 To suffer pain. 1st and 9th cls. (मन्थति मथ्नाति) To agitate, to stir, to churn.

मन्थ m. (-न्थः) 1 A churning. stick. 2 The sun. 3 A dish made of barley meal with ghee and water, a sort of gruel or porridge. 4 A disease of the eyes, cataract or opacity. 5 Rheum, excretion of the eyes. 6 Killing, destroying. 7 Agitating, stirring, churning. E. मन्थ to churn, &c., aff. अच्.
मन्थज: मन्थज n. (-जं) Butter. E. मन्थ churning, and ज produced.
मन्थदण्डक: मन्थदण्डक m. (-कः) A churning-stick. E. मन्थ churning, and दण्डक a stick.
मन्थन: मन्थन n. (-नं) 1 Agitating, stirring, churning. 2 Killing, injuring. f. (-नी) A churn. E. मन्थ to agitate, &c. aff. ल्युट्.
मन्थनघटी: मन्थनघटी f. (-टी) A churn, a common earthen pot used for the purpose. E. मन्थन churning, and घटी a small jar or pitcher.
मन्थर: मन्थर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Slow, lazy, tardy. 2 Large, bulky. 3 Curved, bowed, crooked. 4 Stupid, dull, a fool. 5 Low, vile, little. 6 Low, hollow, (as sound.) m. (-रः) 1 A soldier marching slowly. 2 A spy, an informer. 3 A treasury, a store, a repertory. 4 Fruit. 5 An obstacle, a hindrance. 6 A churning-stick. 7 Fresh butter. 8 The month Vaiśākha. 9 Passion, wrath. 10 A deer. 11 A fort, a strong-hold. 12 The mountain Mandara. n. (-रं) Safflower. E. मन्थ to agitate, &c. aff. अरण्.
मन्थरु: मन्थरु m. (-रुः) The wind from a Chowrie or whisk. E. मन्थ to agitate, अरुन् aff.
मन्थशैल: मन्थशैल m. (-लः) The mountain Mandara. E. मन्थ a churningstick, and शैल a mountain, being so employed in churning the ocean.
मन्थान: मन्थान m. (-नः) A churning-stick. E. मन्थ to agitate, आनच् aff.
मन्थिन्: मन्थिन् mfn. (-न्थी-न्थिनी-न्थि) 1 Agitating, churning. 2 Paining, afflicting. f. (-नी) A churn. E. मन्थ to churn, णीनि aff.
मन्थोदधि: मन्थोदधि m. (-धिः) Sea of milk. E. मन्थ churning, and उदघि a sea.
मन्द: मन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) 1 Slow, tardy. 2 Dull, stupid, heavy. 3 Foolish, a fool. 4 Unlucky. 5 Sick, diseased. 6 Little. 7 Idle, lazy. 8 Drunken, addicted to drunkenness. 9 Vile, wicked. 10 Self-willed. 11 Cold, phlegmatic, apathetic. 12 Low, (as a tone.) m. (-न्दः) 1 A name of SATURN. 2 A sort of elephant. 3 A name of YAMA. 4 (In astronomy,) Anomaly. 5 A destruction of the universe. E. मदि to be lazy, &c. aff. घञ्.
मन्दकान्त: मन्दकान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Dull, not bright. E. मन्द, and कान्त shining.
मन्दगत: मन्दगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Going slowly. E. मन्द, and गत gone.
मन्दगति: मन्दगति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Slow moving. f. (-तिः) Going slowly. E. मन्द, and गति going.
मन्दगमन: मन्दगमन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Who or what moves slowly. n. (-नं) Moving or going slowly. E. मन्द, and गमन going.
मन्दगामिन्: मन्दगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going slowly or gently. m. (-मी) A soldier marching slowly. E. मन्द slow, गम to go, aff. घिनुण्.
मन्दजननी: मन्दजननी f. (-नी) The wife of SŪRYA. E. मन्द SATURN, and जननी mother.
मन्दट: मन्दट m. (-टः) The coral tree, (Erythrina fulgens.) E. मदि to please, aff. अटच्.
मन्दन: मन्दन n. (-नं) Praise, eulogium. E. मदि to be pleased, (by) Uṇādi aff. क्यु.
मन्दफल: मन्दफल n. (-लं) (In astronomy), The anomalistic equation of a planet. E. मन्द, and फल product.
मन्दबुद्धि: मन्दबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Stupid, foolish. E. मन्द, and बुद्धि understanding.
मन्दभाग्य: मन्दभाग्य. mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Wretched, unhappy, unfortunate. E. मन्द, and भाग्य fate.
मन्दमति: मन्दमति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Dull, stupid, slow of apprehension. E. मन्द, and मति intellect.
मन्दयमान: मन्दयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Slow, tardy. E. मदि to be slow, शानच् aff.
मन्दर: मन्दर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Large, bulky. 2 Slow, sluggish, dull, lazy, &c. m. (-रः) 1 The mountain Mandara, with which the ocean was churned by the Suras and Asuras, after the deluge, for the purpose of recovering the sacred things lost in it during that period. 2 The Mandara tree, one of the trees of paradise. 3 Svarga or the paradise of the Hindus. 4 A string of pearls, &c. 5 A mirror. E. मदि to please, to be lazy, &c. अरन् aff.
मन्दसान: मन्दसान m. (-नः) 1 A name of AGNI or fire. 2 Life, living. 3 Sleep, sleeping. E. मदि to be slow or sleepy, Uṇādi aff. असानच्.
मन्दस्मित: मन्दस्मित n. (-तं) A smile, a gentle laugh. E. मन्द slowly, gently, स्मित smiling.
मन्दहास्य: मन्दहास्य n. (-स्यं) A smile, a gentle laugh. E. मन्द slowly, gently, and हास्य laughter.
मन्दाक: मन्दाक n. (-कः) Praising, praise. E. मन्द to praise, आकन् Uṇādi aff.
मन्दाकिनी: मन्दाकिनी f. (-नी) 1 The Ganges of heaven. 2 A species of the Jagatī metre. E. मन्द slowly, अक to go, aff. णिनि, fem. form.
मन्दाक्रान्ता: मन्दाक्रान्ता f. (-न्ता) A species of the Atyaṣṭi metre.
मन्दाक्ष: मन्दाक्ष n. (-क्षं) Modesty, shame, bashfulness. E. मन्द slow, retiring, and अक्ष organ of sense.
मन्दात्मन्: मन्दात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Slow of apprehension, dull. E. मन्द, and आत्मन् self.
मन्दादर: मन्दादर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Disregarding, neglecting, disrespecting. E. मन्द, and आदर respect.
मन्दानिल: मन्दानिल m. (-लः) A gentle breeze, zephyr. E. मन्द, and अनिल wind.
मन्दायमान: मन्दायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Delaying, going tardily. E. मदि to be lazy, causal v., शानच् aff.
मन्दार: मन्दार m. (-रः) 1 One of the five trees of Svarga. 2 The coral tree, (Erythrina fulgens.) 3 Swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea.) E. मदि to delight, &c. aff. आरक्.
मन्दास्य: मन्दास्य n. (-स्यं) Shame, modesty. E. मन्द retiring, and आस्य face.
मन्दिकुकुर: मन्दिकुकुर m. (-रः) A sort of fish.
मन्दिर: मन्दिर nf. (-रं-रा) A house. n. (-रं) 1 A town. 2 A temple. m. (-रः) 1 The sea. 2 The back of the knee, the ham. 3 One of the Gandharbas. f. (-रा) A stable. E. मदि to sleep, &c. Uṇādi aff. किरच्.
मन्दिरपशु: मन्दिरपशु m. (-शुः) A cat. E. मन्दिर a house, and पशु an animal.
मन्दीभव: मन्दीभव m. (-वः) 1 Tardiness. 2 Stupidity. E. मन्द्, and भू to be, अप् aff., च्चि augment.
मन्दीभूत: मन्दीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Being slow, dull, stupid, &c. E. मन्द, and भू to be, aff. क्त, च्चि augment.
मन्दुरज: मन्दुरज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born in a stable. E. मन्दुरा, and ज born, the final of the first rejected.
मन्दुरा: मन्दुरा f. (-रा) 1 A stable. 2 A bed, a mat used as one. E. मदि to please, &c. Uṇādi aff. उरच्.
मन्दोच्छ: मन्दोच्छ m. (-च्छः) The apsis of a planet's orbit. E. मन्द, and उच्छ high.
मन्दोदरी: मन्दोदरी f. (-री) A proper name, the wife of RĀVAṆA. E. मन्द slow, heavy, उदर the belly, aff. ङीष्.
मन्दोदरीश: मन्दोदरीश m. (-शः) A name of RĀVAṆA. E. मन्दोदरी as above, and ईश lord or husband.
मन्दोदरीसुत: मन्दोदरीसुत m. (-तः) The son of RĀVAṆA. E. मन्दोदरी the wife of the demon, and सुत son.
मन्दोष्ण: मन्दोष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Temperate, tepid, moderately warm. n. (-ष्णं) Warmth, gentle heat. E. मन्द slack, and उष्ण hot.
मन्द्र: मन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A base or low tone, such as the grumbling of clouds, &c. 2 A sort of drum. E. मदि to please, Uṇādi aff. रक्.
मन्मथ: मन्मथ m. (-थः) 1 A name of KĀMA, the god of love. 2 Love, amorous passion or desire. 3 The elephant or wood-apple. E. मत् the heart, मथ to agitate, aff. अच्.
मन्मन: मन्मन m. (-नः) Whispering, murmuring, low reiterated sound, especially murmur libidinosum. E. मत् the heart or mind, मन to express, aff. अच्.
मन्मथिन्: मन्मथिन् mfn. (-थी-थिनी-थि) Amorous, impassioned, in love. E. मन्मथ, and इनि aff.
मन्मय: मन्मय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Full of me, like me, (God.) E. मत्, and मयट् aff.
मन्यमान: मन्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Thinking, considering. 2 Respecting, attending to. 3 Praising. E. मन to mind, शानच् aff.
मन्या: मन्या f. (-न्या) The tendon forming the nape of the neck. E. मन to mind, to admire, aff. क्यप्.
मन्याका: मन्याका f. (-का) The tendon of the trapezium muscle forming the nape of the neck. E. मन्या the same, and कन् added.
मन्यु: मन्यु m. (-न्युः) 1 Sorrow, grief. 2 Distress, indigence. 3 Anger, wrath. 4 A sacrifice. 5 Pride. E. मन to know, Uṇādi aff. युच्.
मन्युमत्: मन्युमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Sorrowful, distressed. 2 Angry, wrathful. E. मन्यु, and मतुप् aff.
मन्वन्तर: मन्वन्तर n. (-रं) The reign of a MANU, a period equal to seventy-one ages of the gods, or 306,720,000 years of mortals, or with its Sandhi or interval of universal deluge, 308,448,000 years; fourteen Manvantaras constitute a Kalpa; the grand period of creation and destruction, or 4,320,000,000 years; each Manvantara is governed by its distinct MANU, and is provided with its own INDRA, and minor deities; according to Hindu cosmogony, there have been innumerable Manvantaras since the first creation of the world. E. मनु MANU, and अन्तर period or interval.
मन्वान: मन्वान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Thinking, conceiving. 2 Minding, regarding. E. म्ना to mind, शानच् aff.
मपष्ट: मपष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus mungo;) also मपष्टक, and मपुष्टक.
