मपुष्टक: मपुष्टक m. (-कं) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus mungo;) also मपष्टक.
मभ्र: मभ्र r. 1st cl. (मभ्रति) To go, to move.
ममता: ममता f. (-ता) 1 Pride, arrogance, self-sufficiency. 2 The interest or affection entertained for other objects from considering  them as belonging to or connected with one's self. 3 Individuality. E. मम mine, the possessive case of अस्मट् I, and तल् aff. of the abstract; also with त्व aff. ममत्व.
ममतायुक्त: ममतायुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Selfish. m. (-क्तः) A miser, a niggard. E. ममता selfishness, and युक्त affected.
ममापताल: ममापताल m. (-लः) An object of sense. E. मव्य to bind, आल Uṇādi aff., य rejected, and म substituted for ब, and आपतुट् augment.
मय: मय r. 1st cl. (मयते) To go, to move.

मय m. (-यः) 1 A camel. 2 A mule. 3 A demon, and the carpenter or architect of the DAITYAS. 4 Hurting, injuring. f. (-या) Administering remedies, the practice of physic. E. मय to go, or मि to scatter, or मी to hurt, aff. अच् or खल् and टाप्.
मयट: मयट m. (-टः) A hut of grass or leaves. E. मय to go, अटच् aff.
मयु: मयु m. (-युः) 1 A Kinnara or chorister of Svarga. 2 A deer. E. मि to scatter, (sweet sounds, &c.,) Uṇādi aff. उ.
मयुराज: मयुराज m. (-जः) A name of KUVERA. E. मयु a Kinnara, and राज chief; having these beings attached especially to his court and capital.
मयुष्टक: मयुष्टक m. (-कः) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus mungo.) E. मय to go, aff. उ, मयु one who goes, ष्टक to impede, aff. ड, मयुष्ट, and with the pleonastic addition, कुन् मयुष्टक; also with अच् aff. after मय to go, मयष्ट, and मयष्टक; and again with प substituted for म, मपष्ट, मपष्टक, मपुष्ट or मपुष्टक.
मयूख: मयूख m. (-खः) 1 Light, lustre, brightness. 2 A ray of light. 3 Flame. 4 Beauty. 5 The pin or gnomon of a sun-dial. E. मा to measure, (time, &c.,) ऊख Uṇādi aff., and मय substituted for the root.
मयूर: मयूर m. (-रः) 1 A peacock. 2 A flower, the coxcomb, (Celosia cristata.) 3 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) f. (-री) 1 A peahen. 2 A potherb, (Basella rubra, &c.) E. मि to scatter, Uṇādi aff. ऊरन् or मही the earth in the seventh case, मह्यां, रु to cry, ड aff., and the formation irr.
मयूरक: मयूरक m. (-कः) 1 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) 2 A flower, (Celosia cristata.) 3 A peacock. n. (-कं) Blue vitriol. E. कन् added to the preceding.
मयूरचटक: मयूरचटक m. (-कः) A house or dunghill cock.
मयूरचूडा: मयूरचूडा f. (-डा) Coxcomb, (Celosia cristata.) E. मयूर a peacock, and चूडा the comb or crest.
मयूरपदक: मयूरपदक n. (-कं) A sort of scratch with a finger nail. E. मयूर a peacock, पद a foot, and कन् aff. implying resemblance.
मयूरारि: मयूरारि m. (-रिः) A chameleon, a lizard. E. मयूर a peacock, and अरि the enemy.
मरक: मरक m. (-कः) Epidemic or pestilential disease. E. मृ to die, वुन् aff.
मरकत: मरकत m. (-तः) An emerald. E. मरक epidemic disease, तॄ to cross or escape, aff. ड; it is also read मरकतक n. (-कं).
मरण: मरण n. (-णं) Death, dying. E. मृ to die, aff. ल्युट्.
मरत: मरत m. (-तः) Death, dying. E. मृ to die, अतच् Uṇādi aff.
मरन्द: मरन्द m. (-न्दः) The nectar or honey of a flower. E. मकरन्द, q. v. the second syllable being rejected; also with कन् added मरन्दक.
मरन्दौकस्: मरन्दौकस् n. (-कः) A flower. E. मरन्द nectar or honey, ओकस् abode.
मराकाली: मराकाली f. (-ली) A plant, commonly Bichhati.
मरार: मरार m. (-रः) A granary, a place where grain, &c. is kept.
मराल: मराल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Soft, mild, bland. m. (-लः) 1 A sort of goose with red legs and bill, or perhaps the Flamingo. 2 Lampblack, used as a collyrium. 3 A duck. 4 A horse. 5 A cloud. 6 A grove or garden of pomegranate trees. 7 A rogue, a scoundrel. E. मृ to die, aff. आलच्.
मरिच: मरिच n. (-चं) Pepper. E. मृ to die, (venom,) and इच aff.; considered as an antidote; also मरीच.
मरिमन्: मरिमन् m. (-मा) Death, dying. E. मृ to die, मनिन् Uṇādi aff.
मरीच: मरीच n. (-चं) Pepper, (Piper nigrum.) E. मृ to die, ईच aff.
मरीचि: मरीचि m. (-चिः) 1 A saint, the son of BRAHMĀ, and one of the Prajāpatis, and Brahmādikas, or first created beings, and sovereigns of the world. 2 A niggard, a miser. mf. (-चिः) A ray of light. E. मृ to perish, (darkness,) Uṇādi aff. ईचि.
मरीचिका: मरीचिका f. (-का) The Mirage; vapor which in hot, and sandy countries especially appears at a distance like a sheet of water. E. मरीचि a ray of light, कन् aff., implying resemblance.
मरीचिमालिन्: मरीचिमालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Splendid, radiant. m. (-ली) The sun. E. मरीचि, and मालिन् having a chaplet.
मरीमृज: मरीमृज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Who or what cleans or rubs repeatedly. E. मृज to rub, reiter. v., अच् aff.
मरु: मरु m. (-रुः) 1 A region or soil destitute of water, sands, a desert. 2 A mountain. 3 The province Marwar, or, in the plu. (-रुवः) The inhabitants. E. मृ to die, (where,) and Uṇādi aff. उ.
मरुज: मरुज m. (-जः) A sort of perfume, commonly Nakhi. E. मरु a desert, and ज produced.
मरुटा: मरुटा f. (-टा) A woman with a high forehead. E. मृ to perish, (of love for such a woman,) उटच् aff.
मरुण्डा: मरुण्डा f. (-ण्डा) A woman with a high forehead. E. मृ to die, उण्डच् aff.: see the last.
मरुत्: मरुत् m. (-रुत्) 1 Wind, air, or its deified personification. 2 A deity, an immortal. n. (-रुत्) A sort of perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla. f. (-रुत्) A kind of grass, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. मृ to die, Uṇādi aff. उति.
मरुत: मरुत m. (-तः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A deity. 3 A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpātali. E. अच् added to the preceding.
मरुत्कर: मरुत्कर m. (-रः) A sort of bean, (Dolichos catjang.) E. मरुत् wind, (eructation,) and कर making.
मरुत्त: मरुत्त m. (-त्तः) 1 Wind, a gale. 2 The name of a king. E. मरुत्, and तप् added.
मरुत्पथ: मरुत्पथ m. (-थः) The atmosphere, sky, heaven. E. मरुत् the wind, and पथ road.
मरुत्पाल: मरुत्पाल m. (-लः) A name of INDRA. E. मरुत् the wind, and पाल who nourishes.
मरुत्पुत्त्र: मरुत्पुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) BHĪMASENA, the second of the PĀṆḌU princes. E. मरुत् the deity of the wind, and पुत्त्र son.
मरुत्प्लव: मरुत्प्लव m. (-वः) A lion. E. मरुत् wind, and प्लव who leaps.
मरुत्फल: मरुत्फल n. (-लं) Hail. E. मरुत् wind, and फल fruit.
मरुत्वत्: मरुत्वत् m. (-त्वान्) 1 A name of INDRA. 2 The monkey Hanumān. 3 A cloud. E. मरुत् wind, मतुप् aff.
मरुत्सख: मरुत्सख m. (-खः) INDRA. E. मरुत् the wind, (the deity,) and सखि friend, aff. टच्.
मरुदान्दोल: मरुदान्दोल m. (-लः) A sort of fan made of deer's or buffalo's skin. E. मरुत् wind, आन्दोल agitating.
मरुद्ध्वज: मरुद्ध्वज n. (-जं) Flocculent seeds wafted by the wind. E. मरुत् wind, ध्वज standard.
मरुद्बद्ध: मरुद्बद्ध m. (-द्धः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 A sort of vessel used in sacrifices. 3 A portion of the Sāma Veda. E. मरुत् the wind, बद्ध bound.
मरुद्रथ: मरुद्रथ m. (-थः) 1 A horse. 2 A car in which idols are carried. E. मरुत् the wind, and रथ a vehicle.
मरुद्रुम: मरुद्रुम m. (-मः) A fœtid mimosa. E. मरु dry, and द्रुम a tree.
मरुद्वर्त्मन्: मरुद्वर्त्मन् n. (-र्त्म) The atmosphere, heaven, sky. E. मरुत् the wind, and वर्त्मन् road or path.
मरुद्वाह: मरुद्वाह m. (-हः) 1 Smoke. 2 Fire. E. मरुत् wind, and वाह vehicle.
मरुद्विप: मरुद्विप m. (-पः) A camel. E. मरु the desert, and द्विप the elephant.
मरुद्वृता: मरुद्वृता f. (-ता) The Kāverī river in the peninsula. E. मरुत् the wind, and वृत covered, screened.
मरुन्माला: मरुन्माला f. (-ला) 1 A sort of grass, (Trigonella corniculata.) 2 Another plant, commonly Belśunṭh. E. मरुत् a deity, and माला a garland.
मरुप्रिय: मरुप्रिय m. (-यः) A camel. E. मरु a sandy soil, and प्रिय fond of; it also occurs मरुत्प्रिय m. (-यः) from मरुत् wind.
मरुभू: मरुभू m. (-भूः) The province of Marwar, or plu. (-भुवः) The inhabitants of Marwar. E. मरु sandy, and भू country.
मरुल: मरुल m. (-लः) A sort of duck. E. मॄ to die, उलच् aff.
मरुवक: मरुवक m. (-कः) 1 A large thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.) 2 A species of basil (Ocymum), described as having small leaves and red flowers. 3 A variety of the citron or lime, said to be a thorny plant, and to bear a small fruit. 4 A flower, (Artemisia vulgaris.) 5 A tiger. 6 The ascending node. 7 A crane. E. मरु a sandy or dry soil, वा to grow or go, aff. क, and कन् added; it sometimes occurs, मरूवक.
मरुस्थल: मरुस्थल nf. (-लं-ली) A desart, a dry and desart tract. E. मरु, and स्थल place.
मरूक: मरूक m. (-कः) A sort of deer. E. मृ to die, ऊकन् Uṇādi aff.
मरूद्भवा: मरूद्भवा f. (-वा) 1 A cucumber. 2 Wild cotton. 3 A small species of the fœtid mimosa. 4 A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) E. मरु dry soil, and उद्भव produced.
मरोलि: मरोलि m. (-लिः) The Makara, a marine monster, apparently the Monodon or unicorn, and usually confounded with the crocodile or shark. E. मृ to die, (by it,) ओलिच् aff.; also with कन् added मरोलिक m. (-कः)
मर्क: मर्क m. (-र्कः) 1 The air, the wind. 2 The body. 3 A monkey. E. मर्च to sound, or a Sautra root, to move, Uṇādi aff. कन्.
मर्कक: मर्कक m. (-कः) A spider. E. मर्क going, aff. कन्.
मर्कट: मर्कट m. (-टः) 1 A monkey or ape. 2 A spider. 3 The large crane, called in India the adjutant, (Ardea argala.) 4 A kind of venom. f. (-टी) 1 A variety of grey Bonduc, (Guilandina bonduccella.) 2 Cowatch, (Carpopogon pruriens.) 3 A small or female monkey. E. मर्क a Sautra root, to go, Uṇādi aff. अटन्.
मर्कटक: मर्कटक m. (-कः) 1 A spider. 2 An ape. 3 A fruit. 4 A demon. 5 A fish. E. कन् added to the last.
मर्कटपिप्पली: मर्कटपिप्पली f. (-ली) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) E. मर्कट an ape, and पिप्पली long pepper.
मर्कटप्रिय: मर्कटप्रिय m. (-यः) A tree, a kind of Mimosa, (M. kauki.) E. मर्कट a monkey, and प्रिय beloved.
मर्कटवास: मर्कटवास m. (-सः) A spider's web, a cobweb. E. मर्कट a spider, and वास abode; also with कन् added मर्कटवासक.
मर्कटास्य: मर्कटास्य n. (-स्यं) Copper. E. मर्कट a monkey, and आस्य face.
मर्कटेन्दु: मर्कटेन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A sort of ebony, (Diospyros melanoxylon.)
मर्करा: मर्करा f. (-रा) 1 A cave, a hole, a chasm. 2 A vessel. 3 A barren or childless woman.
मर्च: मर्च r. 4th and 10th cls. (मर्चति मर्चयति) 1 To sound. 2 To go.
मर्जू: मर्ज्जू f. (-र्ज्जूः) Cleaning, cleansing, purification. m. (-र्ज्जूः) 1 A washerman. 2 A catamite. E. मृज to cleanse, aff. ऊ.
मर्ज्जू: मर्ज्जू f. (-र्ज्जूः) Cleaning, cleansing, purification. m. (-र्ज्जूः) 1 A washerman. 2 A catamite. E. मृज to cleanse, aff. ऊ.
मर्त: मर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A man, a mortal. E. मृ to die, तन् Uṇādi aff.
मर्त्त: मर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A man, a mortal. E. मृ to die, तन् Uṇādi aff.
मर्तव्य: मर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Mortal, what must or should die. E. मृ to die, तव्य aff.
मर्त्तव्य: मर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Mortal, what must or should die. E. मृ to die, तव्य aff.
मर्त्त्य: मर्त्त्य m. (-र्त्त्यः) 1 A man, a mortal. 2 The earth, the world, the habitation of mortals. f. (-र्त्त्या) A woman, a female. E. मर्त्त as above, यत् pleonasm.
मर्त्त्यमुख: मर्त्त्यमुख m. (-खः) A demigod, attendant on KUVERA, a Kinnara, a Yakṣa. E. मर्त्त्य a mortal, and मुख chief, principal.
मर्दन: मर्द्दन n. (-नं) 1 Rubbing, touching. 2 Rubbing, grinding, pounding, &c. E. मृद to rub or grind, aff. ल्युट्.
मर्द्दन: मर्द्दन n. (-नं) 1 Rubbing, touching. 2 Rubbing, grinding, pounding, &c. E. मृद to rub or grind, aff. ल्युट्.
मर्दनीय: मर्द्दनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be rubbed or touched. E. मृद to rub, अनीयर aff.
मर्द्दनीय: मर्द्दनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be rubbed or touched. E. मृद to rub, अनीयर aff.
मर्दयित्वा: मर्द्दयित्वा ind. Having rubbed or touched. E. मृद to rub, क्त्वा aff.
मर्द्दयित्वा: मर्द्दयित्वा ind. Having rubbed or touched. E. मृद to rub, क्त्वा aff.
मर्दल: मर्द्दल m. (-लः) A sort of drum. E. मृद to rub or strike, aff. अच्; मर्द्द striking, and ला to get, aff. क.
मर्द्दल: मर्द्दल m. (-लः) A sort of drum. E. मृद to rub or strike, aff. अच्; मर्द्द striking, and ला to get, aff. क.
मर्दित: मर्द्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Strung, tied. 2 Rubbed, ground, pounded. 3 Obtained, got. E. मृद to rub, aff. क्त.
मर्द्दित: मर्द्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Strung, tied. 2 Rubbed, ground, pounded. 3 Obtained, got. E. मृद to rub, aff. क्त.
मर्ब: मर्ब r. 1st cl. (मर्बति) To go, to move.
मर्मज्ञ: मर्म्मज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A learned and intelligent man or Brahman. E. मर्म्म secret meaning (of the Śāstras), and ज्ञ who knows.
मर्म्मज्ञ: मर्म्मज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A learned and intelligent man or Brahman. E. मर्म्म secret meaning (of the Śāstras), and ज्ञ who knows.
मर्मन्: मर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 A joint, an articulation of the body. 2 A vital member or organ. 3 Secret meaning or purpose, a secret, any thing hidden or recondite. E. मृ to die, aff. मनिन्.
मर्म्मन्: मर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 A joint, an articulation of the body. 2 A vital member or organ. 3 Secret meaning or purpose, a secret, any thing hidden or recondite. E. मृ to die, aff. मनिन्.
मर्मभेदिन्: मर्म्मभेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Fatal. 2 Penetrating, piercing. 3 Painful. E. मर्म्म, and भेदिन् what cuts or breaks.
मर्म्मभेदिन्: मर्म्मभेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Fatal. 2 Penetrating, piercing. 3 Painful. E. मर्म्म, and भेदिन् what cuts or breaks.
मर्मर: मर्म्मर m. (-रः) The rustling sound of cloth or dry leaves. f. (-री) A sort of pine, (P. Devadaru.) E. मृ to die, अरन् aff., and मुक् augment.
मर्म्मर: मर्म्मर m. (-रः) The rustling sound of cloth or dry leaves. f. (-री) A sort of pine, (P. Devadaru.) E. मृ to die, अरन् aff., and मुक् augment.
मर्मरीक: मर्म्मरीक m. (-कः) A pauper, a low or humble man. E. मृ to die, (with distress,) Uṇādi aff. ईकन्, and the root reduplicate.
मर्म्मरीक: मर्म्मरीक m. (-कः) A pauper, a low or humble man. E. मृ to die, (with distress,) Uṇādi aff. ईकन्, and the root reduplicate.
मर्मविद्: मर्म्मविद् m. (-विट् or -वित्) A learned and intelligent man or Brahman. E. मर्म्म secret meaning (of the Śāstras), and विट् who knows.
मर्म्मविद्: मर्म्मविद् m. (-विट् or -वित्) A learned and intelligent man or Brahman. E. मर्म्म secret meaning (of the Śāstras), and विट् who knows.
मर्मवेदिन्: मर्म्मवेदिन् m. (-दी) An acute and intelligent man. E. मर्म्म secret, and वेदिन् who knows: see the last.
मर्म्मवेदिन्: मर्म्मवेदिन् m. (-दी) An acute and intelligent man. E. मर्म्म secret, and वेदिन् who knows: see the last.
मर्मस्पृश्: मर्म्मस्पृश् mfn. (-स्पृक्) Sharp, corrosive, giving pain. E. मर्म्म a joint, and स्पृश् what touches.
मर्म्मस्पृश्: मर्म्मस्पृश् mfn. (-स्पृक्) Sharp, corrosive, giving pain. E. मर्म्म a joint, and स्पृश् what touches.
मर्माविध्: मर्म्माविध् mfn. (-विद् or -वित्) Piercing or affecting the joints, (pain, &c.) E. मर्म्म a joint, व्यध to pierce or pain, aff. क्विप्; the semivowel and following vowel of the radical changed to इ, and the final vowel of the noun made long.
मर्म्माविध्: मर्म्माविध् mfn. (-विद् or -वित्) Piercing or affecting the joints, (pain, &c.) E. मर्म्म a joint, व्यध to pierce or pain, aff. क्विप्; the semivowel and following vowel of the radical changed to इ, and the final vowel of the noun made long.
मर्मिक: मर्म्मिक m. (-कः) An intelligent and penetrating man. E. मर्म्म a joint, and ठक् aff.: see मर्म्मविट्.
मर्म्मिक: मर्म्मिक m. (-कः) An intelligent and penetrating man. E. मर्म्म a joint, and ठक् aff.: see मर्म्मविट्.
मर्या: मर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A boundary, a limit. ind. Bounding, limitative.
मर्य्या: मर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A boundary, a limit. ind. Bounding, limitative.
मर्यादा: मर्य्यादा f. (-दा) 1 Continuance in the right way, propriety of conduct, steadiness, rectitude. 2 A boundary, a limit. 3 A bank, a shore. E. मर्य्या limitative, आदा to have or take, aff. अङ् and टाप्; or परि about, round, prefixed to आदा, and म substituted for प.
मर्य्यादा: मर्य्यादा f. (-दा) 1 Continuance in the right way, propriety of conduct, steadiness, rectitude. 2 A boundary, a limit. 3 A bank, a shore. E. मर्य्या limitative, आदा to have or take, aff. अङ् and टाप्; or परि about, round, prefixed to आदा, and म substituted for प.
मर्व: मर्व r. 1st cl. (मर्वति) 1 To fill. 2 To go.
मर्श: मर्श m. (-र्शः) Counsel, advice. E. मृश to counsel, aff. घञ्.
मर्शण: मर्शण n. (-णं) Advising, counselling, deliberating. E. मृश to counsel, ल्युट् aff.
मर्ष: मर्ष m. (-र्षः) Patience, endurance. E. मृष to bear with, aff. घञ्.
मर्षण: मर्षण n. (-णं) Enduring, bearing, patience, resignation. E. मृष to bear with, aff. ल्युट्.
मर्षित: मर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Borne, endured. 2 Patient, content. n. (-तं) Patience. E. मृष to bear with, aff. क्त.
मर्षितवत्: मर्षितवत् mfn. (-वान-वती-वत्) Patient, enduring. E. मृष to bear, क्तवतु aff.
मल: मल r. 1st cl. (मलते) 10th cl. (मलयति) 1 To hold. 2 To wear. 3 To stick.

मल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Dirty. 2 Miserly, niggardly. mn. (-लः-लं) 1 Excretion of the body, as serum, semen, blood, marrow, urine, fæces, earwax, nails, phlegm, tears, rheum, and sweat. 2 Sin. 3 Dirt, filth. 4 Dreg, sediment. 5 Rust. 6 Camphor. 7 Cuttle-fish bone. f. (-ला) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta:) see झटामला. E. मल to hold or contain, (in the body,) अच् aff., or मृज to cleanse, Uṇādi aff. कल, and the penultimate and final radical rejected.
मलज: मलज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced from dregs or dirt, &c. n. (-जं) Pus, matter. E. मल as above, and ज born.
मलदूषित: मलदूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Foul, dirty, filthy. E. मल dirt, दूषित faulty.
मलन: मलन m. (-नः) A tent. n. (-नं) Rubbing, grinding, &c. E. मल to hold, aff. ल्युट्.
मलपङ्किन्: मलपङ्किन् mfn. (-ङ्की-ङ्किनी-ङ्कि) Filthy, covered with mud and dirt. E. मल, and पङ्क mud, इनि aff.
मलपू: मलपू f. (-पूः) The opposite-leaved fig tree, (Ficus oppositifolia, Rox.) E. मल sin, पू to purify, aff. क्विप्; it is also read with a final consonant, derived from पूर to complete or fill, मलपूर् f. (-पूः) Also मलयू.
मलभुज्: मलभुज् m. (-भुक्) A crow. E. मल dirt, and भुज् who eats.
मलय: मलय m. (-यः) 1 A mountain or mountainous range, from which the best Sandal wood is brought, answering to the western Ghāts in the peninsula of India. 2 The country that lies along the Malaya range, or the west coast of the peninsula, Malayālam or Malabar. 3 A garden. 4 The garden of INDRA. 5 One of the minor Dvīpas or divisions of the world. f. (-या) A plant, commonly Tëori, (Convolvulus turpethum.) E. मल to hold or contain (Sandal wood), Uṇādi aff. कयन्.
मलयगन्धिनी: मलयगन्धिनी f. (-नी) One of DURGĀ'S female attendants. E. मलय the mountain, and गन्धिन् fragrant; also मलयवासिनी.
मलयज: मलयज mn. (-जः-जं) Sandal wood. E. मलय the mountain Malaya, and ज produced.
मलयाचल: मलयाचल m. (-लः) The mountain Malaya. E. मलय Malaya, and अचल a mountain; also similar compounds, as मलयाद्रि, &c.
मलयानिल: मलयानिल m. (-लः) The southerly wind that prevails in central India during the hot weather. E. मलय the Malaya mountain, over which the air is supposed to have blown, and अनिल wind.
मलयू: मलयू f. (-यूः) The opposite-leaved fig tree. E. मल sin, यु to join, aff. क्विप्, and the final made long; also with the final short मलयु, or derived from पूञ्, मलपू.
मलवाहिन्: मलवाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) What conveys or contains soil or filth. E. मल, and वाहिन् bearing.
मलाकर्षिन्: मलाकर्षिन् m. (-र्षी) A sweeper, a cleaner. E. मल dirt, fæces, and कृष to draw, with आङ् prefix, and णिनि aff.
मलाका: मलाका f. (-का) 1 A female messenger. 2 A lewd woman. 3 A female elephant.
मलापकर्षण: मलापकर्षण n. (-णं) Purification, cleaning, cleansing. E. मल dirt, excrescence, अपकर्षण removing.
मलावह: मलावह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Soiling, dirtying. 2 Defiling, disgracing. m. (-हः) Acceptance of forbidden gifts. E. मल, and आवह what brings.
मलि: मलि f. (-लिः) Having, possession. E. मल to hold, इन् aff.
मलिन: मलिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Dirty, filthy, foul. 2 Black. 3 Vile, bad. 4 Foul, (figuratively,) soiled with crime or vice, sinful, depraved. n. (-नं) 1 Buttermilk. 2 Fault, defect. 3 Borax. f. (-नी) A woman during menstruation. E. मल dirt, इनच् Uṇādi aff.
मलिनप्रभ: मलिनप्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Obscured, beclouded. E. मलिन, and प्रभा light.
मलिनमुख: मलिनमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) 1 Cruel, fierce, savage. 2 Vile, wicked. m. (-खः) 1 AGNI or fire. 2 A ghost, a goblin. 3 The black-faced monkey. E. मलिन black, and मुख the face.
मलिनाम्बु: मलिनाम्बु m. (-म्बुः) Ink. E. मलिन dirty, and अम्बु water.
मलिनास्य: मलिनास्य m. (-स्यः) A savage, a cruel or ferocious man. E. मलिन black, foul, (with fury,) and आस्य the face.
मलिनित: मलिनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Soiled, defiled. 2 Corrupted, wicked. E. मलिन, and इतच् aff.
मलिम्लुच: मलिम्लुच m. (-चः) 1 A thief. 2 Burning, blazing. 3 Fire, air, wind, 4 The intercalary lunar month, introduced every third year, in order to approximate the lunar, and solar modes of computation. 5 A gnat, a musquito. 6 Frost. E. मलि possession, and म्लुच to steal, aff. क.
मलिष्ठ: मलिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Very foul or unclean. 2 Very wicked. f. (-ष्ठा) A woman during menstruation. E. मल unclean, इष्ठन् aff. of the superlative.
मलीमस: मलीमस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Dirty, foul, unclean. 2 Wicked. m. (-सः) 1 Iron. 2 Green vitriol. E. मल dirt, ईमसच् aff.
मलीयस्: मलीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Very dirty or impure. 2 Very wicked. E. मल, and ईयसुन् aff. of the superlative.
मलूक: मलूक m. (-कः) A kind of worm. E. मल dirt, ऊकन् Uṇādi aff.
मल्ल: मल्ल r. 1st cl. (मल्लते) To hold, to have.

मल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) 1 Strong, stout, athletic, robust. 2 Best, excellent. m. (-ल्लः) 1 A wrestler, a boxer, by birth; the offspring of an outcaste Kṣatriya by a Kṣatriya female. 2 A cup or vessel. 3 The cheek and temples, the hemicranium, 4 A kind of fish. 5 The residue of an oblation. f. (-ल्ला) 1 A woman. 2 Arabian jasmine. 3 Ornamenting the person with coloured unguents. E. मल्ल to hold, and aff. अच्.
मल्लक: मल्लक mf. (-ल्लकः-ल्लिका) An oil vessel, a vessel made of the shell of a cocoanut for holding oil, whether for culinary purposes or for burning as a lamp. m. (-कः) A tooth. E. मल्ल to hold, aff. वुन्.
मल्लतूर्य: मल्लतूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A musical instrument, a drum or trumpet used at athletic contests. E. मल्ल a wrestler, and तूर्य्य an instrument of music; it also occurs गन्धतूर्य्यं.
मल्लतूर्य्य: मल्लतूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A musical instrument, a drum or trumpet used at athletic contests. E. मल्ल a wrestler, and तूर्य्य an instrument of music; it also occurs गन्धतूर्य्यं.
मल्लनाग: मल्लनाग m. (-गः) 1 The elephant of INDRA. 2 A name of the saint VĀTSYĀYANA. 2 A letter-carrier. 4 A work on amorous topics by VĀTSYĀYANA Muni. E. मल्ल strong, and नाग an elephant.
मल्लभू: मल्लभू f. (-भूः) A palæstrum or arena, a place for athletic contests; it is also applied to the site of any conflict, as a field of battle, &c. E. मल्ल a wrestler, and भू earth, place; also मल्लभूमि f. (-मिः).
मल्लयाचा: मल्लयाचा f. (-चा) A match of wrestling or boxing. E. मल्ल a wrestler, and याचा a festival.
मल्लयुद्ध: मल्लयुद्ध n. (-द्धं) Wrestling, boxing. E. मल्ल a wrestler, and युद्ध contest.
मल्लारी: मल्लारी f. (-री) One of the Rāgiṇīs or divisions of the musical mode Megha.
मल्लि: मल्लि m. (-ल्लिः) 1 Having, holding. 2 One of the Jinas or Jaina saints, the 19th of the present era. f. (-ल्लिः-ल्लि) Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.) E. मल्ल to hold, Uṇādi aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added for the fem.
मल्लिक: मल्लिक m. (-कः) 1 A bird, said to be a sort of goose with brown legs and bill. 2 A shuttle. 3 The month Māgha. f. (-का) 1 Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.) 2 A kind of fish. 3 An earthen vessel for holding oil, &c. 4 A goblet, a cup, a drinking vessel. 6 A river. E. कन् added to मल्लि.
मल्लिकाक्ष: मल्लिकाक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A horse marked with white about the eyes. 2 A sort of goose with brown legs and bill. E. मल्लिका the jasmine, and अक्ष the eye, being of like whiteness.
मल्लिकापुष्प: मल्लिकापुष्प m. (-ष्पः) Arabian jasmine. E. मल्लिका the same, पुष्प a flower.
मल्लिगन्धि: मल्लिगन्धि n. (-न्धिः) Aloe wood. E. मल्लि jasmine, and गन्धि smelling.
मल्लु: मल्लु m. (-ल्लुः) A bear. E. मल्ल to hold, aff. उ.
मव: मव r. 1st cl. (-मवति) To bind, to tie.
मवित: मवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Strung, tied. E. मू to bind, aff. क्त.
मव्य: मव्य r. 1st cl. (मव्यति) To bind, to tie.
मश: मश r. 1st cl. (मशति) 1 To sound. 2 To be angry or irascible.
मश m. (-शः) 1 Anger. 2 Sounding. 3 A musquito. E. मश to sound, &c., अच् aff.
मशक: मशक m. (-कः) 1 A gnat, a musquito. 2 A kind of cutaneous eruption, the formation of small pustules or warts. 3 A leather water bag. E. मश to be angry, and वुन् aff.
मशकिन्: मशकिन् m. (-की) The glomerous fig tree. E. मशक a gnat, and इनि aff.
मशच्छद: मशछद m. (-दः) A sort of grass, (Andropogon serratus.)
मशछद: मशछद m. (-दः) A sort of grass, (Andropogon serratus.)
मशहरी: मशहरी f. (-री) Musquito curtains, bed curtains of gauze, or of any thin substance, used to keep off musquitoes. E. मश a musquito, हृ to take off, ट and ङीप् affs.
मष: मष r. 1st cl. (मषति) To injure, to hurt or kill.
मषि: मषि f. (-षिः-षी) 1 Ink. 2 The stalk of the Nyctanthes tristis. E. मष to hurt, इन् aff.; also मशि or मसि.
मस: मस(इर, ई) इर् मसी r. 4th cl. (मस्यति) 1 To mete or measure by weight, bulk, length, &c. 2 To change form.
मस m. (-सः) 1 Measure. 2 Weight. E. मस to measure, aff. अच्.
मसक: मसक m. (-कः) A gnat. E. मष to hurt, वुन् aff.
मसन: मसन n. (-नं) 1 Hurting. 2 Measuring. 3 A medicinal fruit, (Serratula anthelmintica.) E. मष to hurt, ल्युट् aff.
मसार: मसार m. (-रः) An emerald. E. मस weight, ऋ to go or get, aff. अण्; also with कन् added मसारक; in some places it seems to be confounded with another gem of a blue colour, perhaps the sapphire.
मसि: मसि mf. (-सिः-सी) 1 Ink. 2 The stalk of the Nyctanthes tristis. E. मस to weigh, Uṇādi aff. इन्; it also occurs, मशि, मशी, मषि, and मषी.
मसिक: मसिक m. (-कः) A snake's hole. f. (-का) 1 A plant, (Nyctanthes tristis.) 2 Ink. E. मसि the stalk of the plant, &c., कन् added.
मसिकूपी: मसिकूपी f. (-पी) An inkstand. E. मसि ink, कूपी a little well; also with कन् added मसिकूपिका.
मसिधान: मसिधान nf. (-नं-नी) An inkstand. E. मसि ink, and घान what holds or contains; also मशिधान, मषिधान, &c.
मसिन: मसिन n. (-नं) Alliance by the right of presenting the funeral meat balls to a deceased common progenitor (?) E. मस to measure, (affinity,) Uṇādi aff. इनन्.
मसिपण्य: मसिपण्य m. (-ण्यः) A scribe, a clerk, an accountant. E. मसि ink, पण्य hireable.
मसिपथ: मसिपथ m. (-थः) A pen. E. मसि, and पथ path.
मसिप्रसू: मसिप्रसू f. (-सूः) An inkstand. E. मसि ink, प्रसू parent.
मसिमणि: मसिमणि f. (-णिः) An inkstand. E. मसि ink, and मणि a jewel.
मसिवर्द्धन: मसिवर्द्धन n. (-नं) Gum myrrh. E. मसि ink, वृद्ध to increase, aff. ल्युट्.
मसीजल: मसीजल n. (-लं) Writing ink. E. मसी ink, and जल water.
मसीधानी: मसीधानी f. (-नी) An inkstand. E. मसी ink, धानी what holds.
मसुर: मसुर mf. (-रः-रा) A sort of lentil or pulse, (Ervum hirsutum, or Cicer lens) f. (-रा) A whore. E. मस to weigh, Uṇādi aff. उरच्; more usually मसूर.
मसूर: मसूर mf. (-रः-रा) A sort of pulse or lentil, (Ervum hirsutum, and Cicer lens) f. (-रा) A whore. f. (-री) 1 Small-pox. 2 A small round pillow. E. मस to weigh, Uṇādi aff. ऊरन्, मसूर, the pulse; the other meanings refer to this, implying resemblance to the pea in figure, &c.
मसूरक: मसूरक m. (-कः) A small round pillow. E. कन् added to the preceding.
मसूरविदला: मसूरविदला f. (-ला) 1 A black variety of the plant, commonly called Tëori, (Convolvulus turpethum.) 2 A twining shrub, (Echites frutescens.) E. मसूर pulse, विदल division; having a leaf like a split pea.
मसूरिका: मसूरिका f. (-का) 1 A bawd, a procuress. 2 Small-pox. E. मसूरा a whore, aff. कन्, fem. form.
मसृण: मसृण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Smooth, soft, not hard, not rough. 2 Bland, mild, unctuous. f. (-णा) Linseed. E. मस to measure  or weigh, aff. ऋण, form irr.; or सम equally, smoothly, ऋण to go or be, aff. क, and the initiatory letters irregularly transposed.
मस्क: मस्क r. 1st cl. (मस्कते) To go, to move: sometimes read मस्क.
मस्कर: मस्कर m. (-रः) A bambu. E. मस्क to go, aff. अर, or मकि to adorn, aff. अर, and the nasal rejected, with सुट् augment.
मस्करिन्: मस्करिन् m. (-री) 1 The Brahman of the fourth and mendicant order. 2 The moon. E. मस्कर a bambu, (staff,) and इनि possess. aff.
मस्ज: मस्ज(टु ओ)टुमस्जो r. 6th cl. (मज्जति) 1 To immerse, to sink or plunge in water. 2 To purify by washing or bathing.
मस्त: मस्त n. (-स्तं) The head: see the next.
मस्तक: मस्तक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 The head, the skull. 2 The head or top of any thing. E. मस to weigh, aff. क्त, and कन् added.
मस्तकस्नेह: मस्तकस्नेह m. (-हः) The brain. E. मस्तक the head, and स्नेह marrow.
मस्तकाख्य: मस्तकाख्य m. (-ख्यः) The top of a tree. E. मस्तक the head, and आख्या appellation.
मस्तकमूलक: मस्तकमूलक n. (-कं) The neck, the upper part of it supporting the head. E. मस्तक the head, मूल the root, कन् added.
मस्ति: मस्ति f. (-स्तिः) Weighing, measuring. E. मस to weigh, क्तिन् aff.
मस्तिस्क: मस्तिस्क m. (-स्कः) The brain. E. मस्ति, मस्क to go or get, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.
मस्तु: मस्तु n. (-स्तुः) The watery part of curds, the whey. E. मस to weigh, Uṇādi aff. तुन्.
मस्तुलुङ्ग: मस्तुलुङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The brain; it also occurs मस्तुलुङ्गक.
मह: मह r. 1st and 10th cls. (महति महयति) To revere, to worship, to adore. (इ,) महि r. 1st cl. (मंहते) To grow or increase. r. 10th cl. (मंहयति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine.
मह m. (-हः) 1 A festival. 2 Light, lustre. 3 A buffalo. 4 Sacrifice, oblation. f. (-हा) 1 A cow. 2 A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) E. मह to worship, aff. घञ् : see महस and महि.
महक: महक m. (-कः) 1 An excellent man. 2 A tortoise. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. E. मह to worship, वुन् aff.
महत्: महत् mfn. (-हान्-हती-हत्) 1 Great, large, bulky. 2 Much, many. 3 Best, excellent, illustrious. n. (-त्) 1 Kingdom, dominion. 2 The intellectual principle, the second principle in creation. adv. Much, very, exceeding. f. (-ती) 1 The Vīṇā or lute of NĀRADA, containing seven or one hundred strings. 2 The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. मह to worship, अति Uṇādi aff. In composition, महा is generally substituted, आ being inserted in place of the final.
महत्तर: महत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Greater, more. m. (-रः) A man of the fourth or servile tribe, a Śūdra. E. महत् great, and तरप् aff. of comparison, perhaps in derision, or in comparison with the mixed tribes.
महत्त्व: महत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) Greatness, either in bulk or rank. E. महत् great, त्व aff. of the abstract.
महदाश्वर्य्य: महदाश्वर्य्य n. adv. (-र्य्यं) Very surprising. E. महत्, and आश्चर्य्य surprising.
महद्विल: महद्विल n. (-लं) Æther, heaven, Ākāśa. E. महत् great, and विल a variety.
महदाश्रय: महदाश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Dependant upon or attached to the great. E. महत्, and आश्रय asylum.
महर्लोक: महर्लोक m. (-कः) A division of the universe; a region said to be one Crore of Yojanas above the polar star, and to be the abode of those saints who survive a destruction of the world. E. महस् sacrifice, लोक world.
महर्षि: महर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A Ṛṣi or saint of a particular order, including VYĀSA, and others. E. मह for महत् great, and ऋषि a saint: see राजर्षि.
महल्लक: महल्लक m. (-कः) An eunuch employed in a Hāram. E. महल्ल said to mean the inner apartments, probably the Arabic word محل and कन् added; otherwise with ठक् added महल्लिक m. (-कः.)
महस्: महस् n. (-हः) 1 A festival, a sacred festival. 2 Light, lustre. 3 Greatness, vigour. 4 Sacrifice, oblation. E. मह to worship, aff. असुन्.
महस: महस n. (-सं) 1 Knowledge. 2 Kind, sort, difference. E. मह to worship, Uṇādi aff. असच्.
महाकच्छ: महाकच्छ m. (-च्छः) 1 The ocean. 2 The deity of the ocean VARUṆA. 3 A mountain. E. महा great, and कच्छ a shore or bank.
महाकण्टकिनी: महाकण्टकिनी f. (-नी) The Indian prickly pear, (Cactus Indicus.) E. महा great, कण्टक a thorn, इनि and ङीष् affs.
महाकन्द: महाकन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 Garlic. 2 A very large esculent root, a sort of yam. 3 A plant, (Hingtsha repens.) E. महा great, and कन्द root.
महाकपित्थ: महाकपित्थ m. (-त्थः) A tree, (Ægle marmelos.) E. महा great, and कपित्थ wood apple.
महाकर: महाकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Large-handed, &c. 2 Having a large revenue. m. (-रः) A large hand, rent, &c. E. महा, and कर a hand.
महाकाय: महाकाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Large, bulky, stout. m. (-यः) 1 A name of NANDI, the door-keeper and attendant of ŚIVA. 2 An elephant. E. महा large, and काय body.
महाकाल: महाकाल m. (-लः) 1 A name or rather a form of ŚIVA, in his character of the destroying deity, being then represented of a black colour, and of aspect more or less terrific. 2 A name of NANDI, ŚIVA'S porter and attendant. 3 The mango tree. f. (-ली) 1 The wife of the preceding deity, and a terrific form of DURGĀ. 2 A goddess peculiar to the Jainas. 3 One of the Vidyādevīs of the same sect. E. महा great, excessively, काल black, or time; in one capacity that of जगद्भक्षकः the world-eater, ŚIVA or MAHĀKĀLA may be considered as a personification of time that destroys all things.
महाकाव्य: महाकाव्य n. (-व्यं) A regular and classical poem. E. महा great, and काव्य a poem: the title is applied especially to six works; the Kumāra Sambhava, Raghu Vaṃśa, and Megha Dūta of KĀLIDĀSA; the Kirātārjunīya of BHĀRAVĪ; the Naiṣadhīya of ŚRĪHARṢA, and the Śiśupāla Badha of MĀGHA.
महाकुल: महाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Eminent by birth, of good family or extraction. E. महा great, and कुल lineage.
महाकुलीन: महाकुलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of good family. E. महा great, and कुलीन of family.
महाकूप: महाकूप m. (-पः) A large or deep well. E. महा great, and कूप a well.
महाकूल: महाकूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of a good family. E. see महाकुल.
महाक्षीर: महाक्षीर m. (-रः) Sugar-cane. E. महा great, and क्षीर milk.
महाग: महाग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Great, prosperous. E. महा, and ग who goes.
महागद: महागद m. (-दः) Fever. E. महा, and गद sickness.
महागन्ध: महागन्ध m. (-न्धः) A sort of cane growing near water, (Calamus fasciculatus, Rox.) f. (-न्धा) A name or form of DURGĀ. n. (-न्धं) Gum myrrh. E. महा great, and गन्ध smell.
महागिरि: महागिरि m. (-रिः) 1 Any large mountain. 2 A sacred personage peculiar to the Jainas. E. महा great, and गिरि a mountain.
महाग्रीव: महाग्रीव m. (-वः) A camel. E. महा great, and ग्रीवा a neck.
महाग्रीविन्: महाग्रीविन् m. (-वी) A camel. E. महा large, ग्रीवा neck, इनि aff.
महाघास: महाघास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Abounding with grass or fodder. E. महा, and घास grass.
महाघूर्णा: महाघूर्णा f. (-र्णा) Spirituous or vinous liquor. E. महा great, much, घूर्ण to roll, aff. अच्, and टाप्.
महाघोर: महाघोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Very formidable, terrific, horrible. m. (-रः) A division of Tartarus or hell. E. महा great, much, and घोर terrific.
महाघोष: महाघोष m. (-षः) A great noise, a loud sound. n. (-षं) A market, a fair. f. (-षा) 1 A plant, commonly called Karkaṭaśṛṅgī or Crab's horn, described as a climbing and milky plant, and supposed to be the Asclepias geminata. 2 Gum olibanum tree. E. महा great, घोष sound, &c.
महाङ्ग: महाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Bulky, big, large-bodied. m. (-ङ्गः) A camel. E. महा great, and अङ्ग body.
महाचण्ड: महाचण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 One of YAMA'S attendants. 2 A very violent or passionate man. E. महा great, much, चण्ड hot, passionate.
महाज: महाज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Illustrious, high-born. m. (-जः) A large goat. E. महा great, and अज a goat, or ज born.
महाजन: महाजन m. (-नः) 1 A virtuous or illustrious man, a great man. 2 A merchant, a trader. E. महा great, जन a man.
महाजम्बू: महाजम्बू f. (-म्बूः) A plant, perhaps a kind of Eugenia. E. महा great, and जम्बू the rose apple.
महाजातीय: महाजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of an excellent sort or species. E. महा great, जातीय of a species.
महाजाली: महाजाली f. (-ली) A plant, a sort of Ghoṣa, with yellow flowers. E. महा great, जाल a net.
महाज्वाल: महाज्वाल m. (-लः) Sacrificial fire. f. (-ला) One of the Vidyādevīs or goddesses peculiar to the Jainas. E. महा great, ज्वाल flame, lustre.
महातमप्रभा: महातमप्रभा f. (-भा) The lowermost division of Naraka or hell. E. महा great, तम darkness, and प्रभा flame.
महातरु: महातरु m. (-रुः) A plant, (Euphorbia of various kinds.) E. महा large, and तरु a tree.
महातल: महातल n. (-लं) The fifth in descent of the seven Pātālas or regions under the earth, inhabited by various races of evil beings, as the Nāgas, Asuras, Daityas, &c. E. महा great, and तल depth.
महातारा: महातारा f. (-रा) A goddess of the Bauddhas.
महातिक्त: महातिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Very bitter. m. (-क्तः) The large Nimb tree, (Melia sempervirens.) f. (-क्ता) A plant, commonly Aknadhi. E. महा much, and तिक्त bitter.
महातीक्ष्ण: महातीक्ष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Very sharp (as flavour), or literally (as a weapon), or figuratively, (as perception, &c.) f. (-ष्णा) The marking-nut plant. E. महा great or much, तीक्ष्ण sharp, acrid, acute.
महातेजस्: महातेजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) 1 Very bright. 2 Very energetic or vigorous. m. (-जाः) 1 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 AGNI, the deity of fire. 3 A hero, a demigod. E. महा great, and तेजस् light or glory, &c.
महात्मन्: महात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Liberal, lofty-minded, magnanimous. E. महा great, आत्मन् self, soul.
महादन्त: महादन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 An elephant with large tusks. 2 An elephant's tusk. E. महा great, and दन्त tooth.
महादारु: महादारु m. (-रुः) A sort of pine, (P. Devadaru.) E. महा large, and दारु wood.
महादेव: महादेव m. (-वः) ŚIVA. f. (-वी) DURGĀ, the wife of ŚIVA. E. महा great, and देव god; the epithet Mahā compounded with a substantive forms many appellatives of these deities especially; thus, ŚIVA is Mahākāla, Mahārudra, Maheśvara, &c. and DURGĀ is named Mahākāyā, Mahāsmṛti, Mahāmedhā, Mahāmohā, &c. &c.
महादुन्दु: महादुन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A large military drum. E. महा great, दुन्दु a drum.
महाद्रुम: महाद्रुम m. (-मः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. महा great, and द्रुम a tree.
महाधन: महाधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Rich, opulent. 2 Costly, precious, valuable. n. (-नं) Any thing costly or precious. 2 Gold. 3 Incense. 4 Costly raiment. 5 Agriculture. E. महा great, घन wealth or price.
महाधातु: महाधातु m. (-तुः) Gold. E. महा great, chief, and धातु mineral.
महानट: महानट m. (-टः) ŚIVA. E. महा great, and नट a dancer.
महानन्द: महानन्द m. (-न्दः) Eternal emancipation or beatitude. f. (-न्दा) Wine. E. महा great, आनन्द happiness.
महानरक: महानरक n. (-कं) One of the hells or divisions of Tartarus. E. महा, and नरक hell.
महानस: महानस mn. (-सः-सं) A kitchen. E. महा great, chief, अनस rice or food, टच् added; to which the food is conveyed to be dressed, &c.
महानाद: महानाद m. (-दः) 1 A large black rainy cloud. 2 A loud sound. 3 An elephant. 4 A lion. 5 The ear. 6 A camel. 7 A conch shell. n. (-दं) A musical instrument. E. महा great, and नाद noise or sound.
महानिद्रा: महानिद्रा f. (-द्रा) Death, dying. E. महा great, निद्रा sleep.
महानिम्ब: महानिम्ब m. (-म्बः) A large kind of Nimb tree, (Melia sempervirens). E. महा great, and निम्ब the Nimb.
महानिशा: महानिशा f. (-शा) Midnight. E. महा great, and निशा night.
महानीच: महानीच m. (-चः) A washerman. E. महा great, much, and नीच vile.
महानील: महानील m. (-लः) 1 The emerald. 2 One of the Nāgas. 3 A plant, (Verbesina scandens, Rox.) E. महा great, and नील blue.
महानुभाव: महानुभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Magnanimous, liberal. m. (-वः) A gentleman. E. महा great, अनुभाव disposition.
महापक्ष: महापक्ष m. (-क्षः) A sort of duck. f. (-क्षी) An owl. E. महा large, and पक्ष a side, a wing.
महापच: महापच m. (-चः) A potherb. f. (-चा) A kind of Eugenia. E. महा large, and पच a leaf.
महापथ: महापथ m. (-थः) 1 The principal path or entrance to a town or house, &c., a main road, a highway. 2 The end of life, the way of all flesh. E. महा chief, and पथ road.
महापथगम: महापथगम m. (-मः) Dying. E. महापथ the great way, (by which all mortals travel,) and गम going.
महापद्म: महापद्म m. (-द्मः) 1 One of the principal Nāgas or serpents of Pātāla. 2 One of KUVERA'S Nidhis or treasures. 3 A large number, one hundred thousand millions. 4 A Kinnara or attendant on KUVERA. n. (-द्मं) The large white lotus. E. महा great, and पद्म a lotus.
महापातक: महापातक n. (-कं) 1 A crime of the highest degree, as, killing a Brahman, stealing gold from a priest, drinking spirits, adultery with the wife of a spiritual teacher, and associating with persons who have committed these offences. 2 Great crime in general. E. महा great, पातक offence.
महापातकिन्: महापातकिन् m. (-की) An offender in the highest degree: see the last. E. महापातक great sin, and इनि aff.
महापाप: महापाप n. (-पं) 1 A sin of the highest kind: see महापातक. 2 Heinous crime, or sin in general. E. महा excessive, and पाप sin.
महापुरुष: महापुरुष m. (-षः) A great man. E. महा, and पुरुष a man.
महापुष्पा: महापुष्पा f. (-ष्पा) A flower, (Clitoria ternatea.) E. महा great, and पुष्प flower.
महाप्रभ: महाप्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Very bright, splendid. m. (-भः) Lamp light, the light of a lamp. E. महा much, प्रभा shining.
महाप्रभु: महाप्रभु m. (-भुः) 1 A holy man, a saint. 2 A king. 3 INDRA. 4 ŚIVA. E. महा chief, and प्रभु master.
महाप्रलय: महाप्रलय m. (-यः) 1 A destruction of the world, occurring after every period of 4,320,000,000 years. 2 A total destruction of the universe, happening after a period commensurate with the life of BRAHMĀ, or 100 years, each day of which is equal to the period first stated, and each night of which is of similar duration; at the expiration of this term, the seven Lokas, with the saints, gods, and BRAHMĀ himself, are annihilated. E. महा great, and प्रलय destruction.
महाफल: महाफल m. (-लः) A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.) f. (-ला) A bitter gourd: see इन्द्रवारुणी. E. महा great, and फल fruit.
महाफेणा: महाफेणा f. (-णा) Cuttle-fish bone. E. महा great, and फेण froth, foam.
महाबल: महाबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Strong, robust, powerful. m. (-लः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A Buddha or Bauddha deified saint. n. (-लं) Lead. f. (-ला) A sort of Sida with yellow flowers, (S. rhombifolia.) E. महा great or much, and बल strong, &c.
महाबाहु: महाबाहु mfn. (-हुः-हुः-हु) Having long arms. E. महा great, बाहु an arm.
महाबोधि: महाबोधि m. (-धिः) A Buddha, a deified teacher of the Bauddhas. E. महा great, and बोधि a teacher.
महाब्राह्मण: महाब्राह्मण m. (-णः) 1 A priest who officiates at funeral ceremonies. 2 An eminent Brahman. E. महा great, and ब्राह्मण a Brahman.
महाभद्रा: महाभद्रा f. (-द्रा) The Ganges. E. महा much, and भद्रा propitious.
महाभाग: महाभाग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Virtuous in a high degree, pure, holy. 2 Eminent, exalted. E. महा, and भाग portion.
महाभागता: महाभागता f. (-ता) 1 Possession of the eight cardinal virtues, clemency, &c. 2 Exalted station or merit. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, महाभागत्वं.
महाभीत: महाभीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Very timid, pusillanimous, cowardly f. (-ता) A sort of sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.) E. महा much, भीत frightened.
महाभीम: महाभीम m. (-मः) 1 A name of ŚĀNTANU. 2 One of ŚIVA'S chamberlains. E. महा great or much, and भीम formidable.
महाभीरु: महाभीरु m. (-रुः) A sort of beetle, found in cow-dung. E. महा, much, भीरु fearful.
महाभीष्म: महाभीष्म m. (-ष्मः) A name of ŚĀNTANU, a sovereign, and the father of BHĪṢMA. E. महा much, and भीष्म formidable.
महाभूत: महाभूत n. (-तं) A primary element: as air, fire, water, earth, and Ākāśa or ether. E. महा principal, and भूत element.
महामति: महामति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Magnanimous, high-minded. E. महा, and मति mind.
महामद: महामद m. (-दः) 1 An elephant in rut. 2 Great pride or intoxication. E. महा great, and मद fury, or the fluid that issues from the animal's temples.
महामनस्: महामनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Magnanimous, high-minded, liberal, munificent. E. महा great, मनस् mind.
महामन्त्रिन्: महामन्त्रिन् m. (-न्त्री) The prime minister. E. महा, and मन्त्रिन् a counsellor.
महामहिमन्: महामहिमन् mfn. (-मा-मा-म) Very great, high and mighty. E. महा, and महिमन् greatness.
महामात्र: महामात्र m. (-त्रः) 1 A king's minister or associate, any high officer in a kingdom: as a counsellor, a general, &c. 2 An elephant driver, a Mahout. 3 Superintendant of the elephants. 4 A man of wealth and consequence. f. (-त्री) 1 The wife of a spiritual preceptor. 2 The wife of an officer of state, &c. E. महा great, and मात्र wealth or retinue, &c.
महामानसी: महामानसी f. (-सी) A goddess peculiar to the Jainas.
महामाया: महामाया f. (-या) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 Worldly illusion or unreality. E. महा great, and माया illusion.
महामारी: महामारी f. (-री) A name of DURGĀ. E. महा great, and मारी destroyer.
महामाष: महामाष m. (-षः) A kind of bean, (Dolichos catjang.) E. महा large, and माष the Phaseolus radiatus.
महामुख: महामुख m. (-खः) A crocodile, an alligator. E. महा large, and मुख the mouth.
महामुनि: महामुनि m. (-निः) 1 A name of AGASTYA. 2 A name of Buddha, or more properly, of any one of the sacred persons called by that name. 3 The epithet of a warlike saint, celebrated in the Mahābhārata. 4 Time. 5 A name of VYĀSA. n. (-नि) Coriander. E. महा great, and मुनि saint.
महामूल्य: महामूल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Costly, precious. m. (-ल्यः) A ruby. E. महा great, मूल्य price.
महामृग: महामृग m. (-गः) An elephant. E. महा great, मृग an animal.
महामृत्यु: महामृत्यु m. (-त्युः) ŚIVA. E. महा great, मृत्यु death.
महामेद: महामेद m. (-दः) 1 The coral tree, (Erythrina Indica.) 2 A drug, classed amongst the principal drugs, and described as a tonic, and stimulant. E. महा much, and मेद marrow.
महामैत्र: महामैत्र m. (-चः) Buddha, the founder of the Bauddha sect, or a Buddha or form of him. E. महा great, मैच friendliness.
महाम्ल: महाम्ल mfn. (-म्लः-म्ला-म्लं) Very acid. n. (-म्लं) Acid seasoning. E. महा much, very, and अम्ल sour.
महायक्ष: महायक्ष m. (-क्षः) A sort of demigod, supposed to attend the Jinas or Jaina saints. E. महा great, and यक्ष a divine being, attending usually on KUVERA.
महायज्ञ: महायज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) An essential sacrifice, a sacrament of the Hindu religion; five acts are enumerated of this description, severally considered as due to the Vedas, to the gods, to man, to the manes, and to all created beings; they are respectively, study of scripture, offering of sacrifice to the gods, hospitable treatment of guests, libation of water, &c. to deceased progenitors, and the casting of food on the ground or in water as an offering to the gods, to spirits, &c. E. महा great, and यज्ञ sacrifice or act of worship.
महायन्त्र: महायन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) Any great mechanical work, as a lock, or dyke, &c. E. महा, and यन्त्र mechanical contrivance.
महायशस्: महायशस् mfn. (-शाः-शाः-शः) Illustrious, celebrated. m. (-शाः) The fifth Jaina of the past era. E. महा great, यशस् fame.
महायशस्क: महायशस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Illustrious, celebrated. E. महा great, यशस् celebrity, and कप् added.
महायुग: महायुग m. (-गः) A great Yuga; the aggregate of the four ages, or a period of four million, three hundred and twenty thousand years. E. महा great, and युग age.
महारजत: महारजत n. (-तं) Gold. E. महा great, and रजत silver.
महारजन: महारजन n. (-नं) 1 Safflower. 2 Gold. E. महा great, रञ्ज to color, aff. क्युच्.
महारण्य: महारण्य n. (-ण्यं) A large forest. E. महा great, अरण्य a wood.
महारथ: महारथ m. (-थः) 1 Wish, desire. 2 A large car. 3 A warrior fighting in a car, or any leader or warrior of note. E. महा great, and रथ a car.
महारस: महारस m. (-सः) 1 The date tree, (Phoenix sylvestris.) 2 A species of club rush, (Scirpus kysoor.) 2 Gruel made from the fermentation of rice water. E. महा great, रस juice.
महाराज: महाराज m. (-जः) 1 A sovereign, an emperor. 2 A finger nail. 3 A Jaina deified teacher. E. महा great, राजन् a king, aff. टच्.
महाराजक: महाराजक m. (-कः) A sort of demigod: see महाराजिक.
महाराजचूत: महाराजचूत m. (-तः) A kind of mango. E. महाराज sovereign, chief, and चूत the mango; bearing a superior sort of fruit; also similar compounds, as महाराजाम्र, महाराजफल, &c.
महाराजाधिराज: महाराजाधिराज m. (-जः) A paramount sovereign, an emperor. E. महाराज, and अधिराज chief sovereign.
महाराजिक: महाराजिक m. (-कः) A kind of demigod, of which there is a class of 226. E. महा great, राजि splendour, aff. कन्; or महाराज the epithet of their chief, and कन् added.
महारात्र: महारात्र m. (-त्रः) Midnight. E. भहा great, and रात्र for रात्रि night.
महारूप: महारूप m. (-पः) Resin. E. महा chief, and रूप form.
महारूपक: महारूपक m. (-कः) A drama, a play or dramatic poem. E. महा chief, रूपक rhetorical composition.
महारौरव: महारौरव m. (-वः) One of the divisions of Tartarus, a hell. E. महा great, रुरु a demon, aff. अण्.
महार्घ: महार्घ mfn. (-र्घः-र्घा-र्घं) Costly, precious, of great price or value. m. (-र्घः) A sort of quail. E. महा great, अर्घ cost.
महार्णव: महार्णव m. (-वः) The ocean. E. महा great, अर्णव the sea.
महार्थ: महार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Significant, meaning. 2 Great, dignified. m. (-र्थः) A principal object. E. महा, and अर्थ sense or object.
महार्द्ध: महार्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) A plant, commonly Mahāda.
महार्ह: महार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) 1 Costly, valuable. 2 Very worthy. E. महा, and अर्ह worthy.
महाराष्ट्र: महाराष्ट्र n. (-ष्ट्रं) A country in the west of India, that of the original Mahrattas. f. (-ष्ट्री) A dialect, Mahratta. E. महा, and राष्ट्र kingdom.
महालक्ष्मी: महालक्ष्मी f. (-क्ष्मीः) SARASVATĪ the wife of BRAHMĀ. E. महा great, and लक्ष्मी the goddess LAKṢMĪ.
महालय: महालय m. (-यः) 1 GOD, the Supreme being. 2 A place of pilgrimage. 3 A tree, &c. sacred to a deity. 4 The Loka or world of BRAHMĀ. 5 A place of refuge, a sanctuary, an asylum. 6 A temple. E. महा great, आलय asylum.
महालोध: महालोध m. (-धः) A tree, the bark of which is used as an astringent, (Symplocos racemosa.) E. महा great, लोध the Lodh tree.
महालोल: महालोल m. (-लः) A crow. E. महा great, and लोल moving.
महालोह: महालोह n. (-हं) The loadstone. E. महा great, chief, and लोह iron.
महावन: महावन n. (-नं) A large forest. E. महा large, वन a wood.
महावप: महावप m. (-पः) A plant and drug, commonly Mahāmeda.
महावरा: महावरा f. (-रा) Bent grass: see दूर्ब्बा. E. महा great, वर best.
महावराह: महावराह m. (-हः) VIṢṆU in the boar incarnation. E. महा, and वराह a boar.
महावर्तन: महावर्त्तन n. (-नं) Large pay or allowance. E. महा, and वर्त्तन maintaining.
महावर्त्तन: महावर्त्तन n. (-नं) Large pay or allowance. E. महा, and वर्त्तन maintaining.
महावल्ली: महावल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A large and handsome creeping plant, (Gærtnera racemosa.) E. महा great, and वल्ली pedicle.
महावस: महावस m. (-सः) The Gangetic porpoise. E. महा large, and वस who abides.
महाविल: महाविल n. (-लं) 1 Sky, heaven, atmosphere. 2 A water jar. 3 The heart, the mind. 4 A cave, a hole. E. महा great, and विल a chasm.
महाविशिष्ट: महाविशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Endowed with great, or excellent qualities. E. महा great, विशिष्ट endowed with.
महाविष: महाविष m. (-षः) A small venomous snake, supposed to be twoheaded. E. महा great, and विष venom.
महाविषुव: महाविषुव n. (-वं) The Saṅkrānti or moment of the sun's entering ARIES; the vernal equinox, but varying several days from the European computation. E. महा great, and विषुव equinox.
महावीचि: महावीचि f. (-चिः) One of the divisions of Tartarus. E. महा, and वीचि a wave.
महावीज्य: महावीज्य n. (-ज्यं) The septum of the scrotum, and part of the perinœum. E. महा chief, वीज seed, यत् added.
महावीर: महावीर m. (-रः) 1 GARUḌA the bird, and vehicle of VIṢṆU. 2 A hero. 3 A lion. 4 A white horse. 5 Sacrificial fire. 6 INDRA'S thunderbolt. 7 A bird, a sort of hawk. 8 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. 9 The last and most celebrated Jina or Jaina teacher of the present age; supposed to have flourished in the province of Behar, in the sixth century before the Christian era. 10 A sacrificial vessel. 11 VIṢṆU. 12 AGNI or fire. f. (-रा) A sort of drug, commonly Kṣīrakākolī, and conceived to be the dried root of a species of lily. E. महा great, and वीर hero.
महावीर्य: महावीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A Jina or Jaina saint. 2 A name of BRAHMĀ. f. (-र्य्या) 1 A name of SAṂJÑĀ the wife of the sun. 2 Wild cotton. E. महा great, and वीर्य्य essence.
महावीर्य्य: महावीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A Jina or Jaina saint. 2 A name of BRAHMĀ. f. (-र्य्या) 1 A name of SAṂJÑĀ the wife of the sun. 2 Wild cotton. E. महा great, and वीर्य्य essence.
महावृक्ष: महावृक्ष m. (-क्षः) Euphorbia, of several species: see स्नुही. E. महा great, and वृक्ष a tree.
महावृहती: महावृहती f. (-ती) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. महा great, and वृहती the egg-plant.
महावेग: महावेग m. (-गः) A monkey. E. महा great, and वेग speed.
महाव्याहृति: महाव्याहृति f. (-तिः) The three mystical words, Bhūr, BhuvaH, and Svar, the essential part, with Om and Gāyatrī, of the daily Brahminical prayer. E. महा great, and व्याहृति a word.
महाव्रतिन्: महाव्रतिन् m. (-ती) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A devotee, an ascetic. E. महा great, and व्रत religious penance or observance, and इनि aff.
महाव्रीहि: महाव्रीहि m. (-हिः) A large kind of rice. E. महा large, and व्रीहि rice.
महाशङ्ख: महाशङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) 1 A human bone. 2 The forehead. 3 A thousand millions. 4 One of KUVERA'S Nidhis or treasures. E. महा great, शङ्ख a shell, a number, &c.
महाशक्ति: महाशक्ति m. (-क्तिः) KĀRTTIKEYA the martial deity of the Hindus. E. महा great, शक्ति power.
महाशय: महाशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Magnanimous, liberal, munificent. m. (-यः) 1 The ocean. 2 A gentleman, sir. E. महा great, आशय purpose or an abode.
महाशय्या: महाशय्या f. (-य्या) A throne, a regal seat. E. महा great, and शय्या bed or couch.
महाशल्क: महाशल्क m. (-ल्कः) A prawn or shrimp. E. महा large, and शल्क a scale.
महाशाक: महाशाक n. (-कः) A kind of potherb. E. महा large, and शाक a potherb.
महाशालि: महाशालि m. (-लिः) A fragrant sort of rice. E. महा large, chief, and शालि rice.
महाशीता: महाशीता f. (-ता) A plant, (Asparagus racemosa.) E. महा great, much, शीता cooling.
महाशुक्ति: महाशुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) The pearl oyster. E. महा great, chief, and शुक्ति oyster.
महाशुक्ला: महाशुक्ला f. (-क्ला) The goddess SARASVATĪ. E. महा much, very, and शुक्ल white.
महाशुभ्र: महाशुभ्र n. (-भ्रं) Silver. E. महा much, and शुभ्र white.
महाशूद्र: महाशूद्र m. (-द्रः) The cowherd. f. (-द्री) The milk-woman, either wife of a cowherd or a woman of that caste. E. महा great, शूद्र Śūdra.
महाश्मशान: महाश्मशान n. (-नं) The holy city Benares. E. महा great, and श्मशान cemetery; people going thither to die.
महाश्यामा: महाश्यामा f. (-मा) A creeper, (Echites frutescens.) E. महा large, and श्याम black.
महाश्रमण: महाश्रमण m. (-णः) A Jaina or Bauddha saint. E. महा much, and श्रमण labouring, (in devotion.)
महाश्री: महाश्री f. (-श्रीः) 1 A goddess peculiar to the Jainas. 2 An epithet of LAKṢMĪ. E. महा great, and श्री prosperity or the goddess.
महाश्वेत: महाश्वेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Very white. f. (-ता) 1 A name of SARASVATĪ. 2 A white variety of the Convolvulus paniculatus. 3 Clayed or candied sugar. 4 A sort of Clitoria, (C. ternata, with white flowers.) E. महा much, and श्वेत white.
महासत्व: महासत्व mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं) Good, virtuous, just. E. महा, and सत्व purity.
महासन्न: महासन्न m. (-न्नः) A name of KUVERA.
महासर्ज: महासर्ज m. (-र्जः) 1 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) 2 The jack tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.) E. महा large, and सर्ज the Śāl tree.
महासह: महासह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Much-enduring. f. (-हा) 1 A plant, (Glycine debilis.) 2 A flower, (Gomphræna globosa.) 3 A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) E. महा great, सह to bear, aff. अच् or अङ् and टाप्.
महासान्तपन: महासान्तपन n. (-नं) A sort of penance; subsisting for six successive days, respectively, on cow's urine, cowdung, milk, curds, Ghee, and water in which Kusa grass has been boiled, and fasting on the seventh day: instead of one day some authorities assign a period of three days to each, considering the first as the common Sāntapana penance; others omit the two last periods, making it last fifteen days. E. महा great, and सान्तपन a penance.
महासाहस: महासाहस n. (-सं) Excessive violence, brutal assault. E. महा great, साहस violence.
महासाहसिक: महासाहसिक m. (-कः) 1 A robber, a plunderer, one who carries off property openly, and by force. 2 An assaulter, a violator. E. महासाहस violence, and ठक् aff.
महासि: महासि m. (-सिः) A large scymitar or sword. E. महा, and असि a sword.
महासुख: महासुख m. (-खः) A Bauddha or Jaina saint. n. (-खं) Copulation. E. महा great, and सुख happiness, pleasure.
महासूक्ष्म: महासूक्ष्म mfn. (-क्ष्मः-क्ष्मा-क्ष्मं) Subtile, fine, minute. f. (-क्ष्मा) Sand, E. महा very, सूक्ष्म thin.
महासेन: महासेन m. (-नः) 1 KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 A general, the commander of a large force. 3 The father of the eighth Jina or Jaina saint of the present era. E. महा great, सेना an army.
महास्कन्ध: महास्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A camel. E. महा, and स्कन्ध shoulder.
महास्थली: महास्थली f. (-ली) The earth. E. महा great, and स्थली heap.
महास्नायु: महास्नायु m. (-युः) Any principal vessel of the body. E. महा large, and स्नायु a tubular vessel.
महास्वन: महास्वन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Loud sounding. m. (-नः) 1 An instrument of martial music, a kind of drum or trumpet. 2 A loud sound. E. महा great, and स्वन sound or noise.
महाहव: महाहव m. (-वः) A great battle or war. E. महा, and आहव war.
महाहास: महाहास m. (-सः) A horse laugh. E. महा great, and हाद्य laughter.
महि: महि f. (-हिः) The earth. E. मह to worship, aff. इ, more commonly मही, q. v.
महिका: महिका f. (-का) Frost. E. नह to worship, aff. क्वुन्, fem. form; more commonly मिहिका.
महित: महित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Proper, right. 2 Worshipped, reverenced, &c. n. (-तं) The trident of ŚIVA. E. मह to worship, aff. क्त.
महिन: महिन n. (-नं) Kingdom, sovereignty. E. मह to worship or be worshipped, Uṇādi aff. इनन्.
महिन्धक: महिन्धक m. (-कः) 1 A rat. 2 An ichneumon. 3 The string of a pole for carrying loads.
महिमन्: महिमन् m. (-मा) 1 Greatness in general, literal or figurative. 2 Magnitude as one of ŚIVA'S attributes, illimitability. E. महत् reat, इमनिच् aff. of the abstract property.
महिर: महिर m. (-रः) The sun. E. मह to be worshipped, aff. इरच्.
महिला: महिला f. (-ला) 1 A woman, a female. 2 A woman, literally or figuratively intoxicated. 3 A plant bearing a fragrant seed, commonly Priyangu. E. मह to worship or be worshipped, Uṇādi aff. इलच्; also महला and महेला.
महिलाह्वया: महिलाह्वया f. (-या) A plant, commonly Priyangu. E. महिला a woman, and आह्वय appellation.
महिष: महिष m. (-षः) 1 A buffalo. 2 The emblem of one of the Jaina saints. 3 The emblem and vehicle of YAMA. 4 The name of an Asura or demon slain by DURGĀ. f. (-षी) 1 A female buffalo. 2 The wife of a king, but especially the one who has been consecrated or crowned, a queen. 3 A drug. E. मह to worship or be worshipped, Uṇādi aff. टिषच्, fem. aff. ङीष्.
महिषध्वज: महिषध्वज m. (-जः) YAMA the sovereign of hell, and judge of the dead. E. महिष a buffalo, and ध्वज emblem.
महिषमर्दिनी: महिषमर्द्दिनी f. (-नी) The goddess DURGĀ. E. महिष the Asura so named, and मर्द्दिनी destructress.
महिषमर्द्दिनी: महिषमर्द्दिनी f. (-नी) The goddess DURGĀ. E. महिष the Asura so named, and मर्द्दिनी destructress.
महिषवाहन: महिषवाहन m. (-नः) YAMA, the PLUTO of the Hindus. E. महिष a buffalo, and वाहन vehicle.
महिषाक्ष: महिषाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A plant, supposed to be the Bdellium tree. E. महिष a buffalo, and अक्ष eye.
मही: मही f. (-ही) 1 The earth. 2 A river, the Mahī which rises in the province of Malva, and after pursuing a westerly course of about 280 miles, falls into the upper part of the gulf of Cambay. 3 A cow. 4 A potherb, (Hingtsha repens.) E. मह to worship or be worshipped, aff. इ, and ङीष् added; also without the addition, महि.
महीक्षित्: महीक्षित् m. (-क्षित्) A king, a sovereign. E. मही the earth, and क्षि to rule, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् final augment.
महीतल: महीतल n. (-लं) The surface of the earth. E. मही, and तल below.
महीधर: महीधर m. (-रः) A mountain. E. मही, and घर what holds.
महीध्र: महीध्र m. (-ध्रः) A mountain. E. मही the earth, and धृ to uphold, aff. क, and the vowel changed to र.
महीप: महीप m. (-पः) A king. E. मही, and प who protects.
महीपति: महीपति m. (-तिः) A sovereign, a king. E. मही, and पति master.
महीपाल: महीपाल m. (-लः) A king. E. मही, and पाल who protects.
महीप्राचीर: महीप्राचीर n. (-रं) The ocean. E. मही the earth, and प्राचीर a boundary; being supposed to surround the earth completely.
महीभर्तृ: महीभर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A king. E. मही, and भर्त्तृ who cherishes.
महीभर्त्तृ: महीभर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A king. E. मही, and भर्त्तृ who cherishes.
महीभुज्: महीभुज् m. (-भुक्) A king. E. मही, and भुज् who possesses.
महीमय: महीमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Earthen, made of earth or clay. E. मही earth, and मयट् aff.
महीयस्: महीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Greatest, very great. E. महत् great, ईयसुन् aff.
महीय्यमान: महीय्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) To be worshipped, to be reverenced, to be treated with respect. E. मह to worship, शानच् aff., and यङ् inserted.
महीरुह: महीरुह m. (-हः) A tree. E. मही the earth, and रुह to grow, aff. क; also with क्विप् aff. महीरुह् m. (-रुट्.)
महीलता: महीलता f. (-ता) An earthworm. E. मही the earth, and लता a creeper.
महीसुत: महीसुत m. (-तः) The regent of the planet MARS. E. मही the earth, and सुत son; said to have sprung from the soil, near Oujein, which was sprinkled with the perspiration from ŚIVA'S body.
महेच्छ: महेछ mfn. (-छः-छा-छं) Liberal, magnanimous, high-minded. E. महा great, and इच्छा wish or design.
महेछ: महेछ mfn. (-छः-छा-छं) Liberal, magnanimous, high-minded. E. महा great, and इच्छा wish or design.
महेन्द्र: महेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 INDRA, the ruler of Svarga. 2 A range of mountains, one of the seven principal chains in Bhārata Varṣa or India, and apparently the northern part of the Ghāts of the peninsula. E. महा chief, great, इन्द्र the deity.
महेन्द्रनगरी: महेन्द्रनगरी f. (-री) Amaravatī the city of the immortals, and capital of INDRA. E. महेन्द्र INDRA, and नगरी capital.
महेन्द्राणी: महेन्द्राणी f. (-णी) The wife of INDRA. E. महा great, and इन्द्राणी the same.
महेरणा: महेरणा f. (-णा) The Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) E. महा great, ईरन diffusion; or मह sacrifice, ईर to go to, to be used in, aff. ल्यु; also महेरुणा.
महेला: महेला f. (-ला) A woman. E. मह a festival, इला the earth or site, or मह to worship, इलच् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel irregularly changed.
महेलिका: महेलिका f. (-का) A woman. E. कन् added to the last.
महेश: महेश m. (-शः) ŚIVA. E. मह great, ईश lord or God.
महेशबन्धु: महेशबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.) E. महेश ŚIVA, and बन्धु friend.
महेश्वर: महेश्वर m. (-रः) ŚIVA. f. (-री) 1 DURGĀ the wife of ŚIVA. 2 Mixed or bell-metal. 3 A flower, (Clitoria ternata.) E. महा great, ईश्वर God, fem. aff. ङीष्.
महेश्वरकरच्युता: महेश्वरकरच्युता f. (-ता) The Karatoya river in the north of Bengal. E. महेश्वर ŚIVA, कर the hand, and च्युत fallen.
महेषु: महेषु f. (-षुः) A large arrow. E. महा, And इषु an arrow.
महेष्वास: महेष्वास m. (-सः) A warrior, a champion, an archer. E. सहेषु, and आस who shoots.
महोक्ष: महोक्ष m. (-क्षः) A large bull or ox. E. महा large, उक्षम an ox, टच् aff.
महोत्का: महोत्का f. (-त्का) Lightning. E. महा great, (frequent,) उत्क opportunity, interval.
महोत्पल: महोत्पल n. (-लं) A lotus, (Nymphæa nelumbo.) E. महा large, chief, and उत्पल a water-lily.
महोत्सव: महोत्सव m. (-वः) A great festival. E. महा, and उत्सव a festival.
महोत्साह: महोत्साह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Persevering, diligent, making strenuous and unremitting exertion. m. (-हः) 1 A king, possessing all the appendages and powers of monarchy. 2 Diligence, effort, exertion. E. महा great, and उत्साह effort.
महोदधि: महोदधि m. (-धिः) 1 The ocean. 2 INDRA. E. महा great, and उदधि the sea.
महोदय: महोदय n. (-यं) Kanoj, the ancient city and district. m. (-यः) 1 Final beatitude, emancipation from vitality and absorption into the divine essence. 2 Prosperity, elevation, eminence. 3 Pride. 4 Abandoning, relinquishment. 5 A master, a lord. E. महा great, and उदय rising, splendor, &c.
महोदार: महोदार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Mighty, powerful. E. महा, and उदार great.
महोद्यम: महोद्यम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Diligent, persevering, making strenuous and unremitting effort. m. (-मः) Great effort, energy exertion. E. महा great, उद्यम effort.
महोन्नत: महोन्नत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Very high. m. (-तः) The palmyra tree. E. महा, and उन्नत high.
महोन्मद: महोन्मद m. (-दः) 1 Intoxication, either literal or figurative, as with pride, passion, &c. 2 A sort of fish, commonly Phalai. E. महा much, उन्मद intoxication.
महोरग: महोरग n. (-गं) The root of a plant: see तगर. m. (-गः) 1 A sort of demigod of the serpent genus, and forming one of the classes inhabiting Pātāla, &c. 2 Any large snake. E. महा great, and उरग a snake.
महौजस्: महौजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) Very mighty or powerful. m. (-जाः) A hero, a champion. n. (-जः) Great might or power. E. महा great, and ओजस् power.
महौजस: महौजस n. (-सं) The discus of VIṢṆU. E. टच् added to the last.
महौषध: महौषध n. (-धं) 1 Garlic. 2 A plant, commonly Atis, (Betula.) 3 Long pepper. nf. (-धं-धी) Dry ginger. f. (-धी) A potherb, (Hingtsha repens.) E. महा great, and औषध a drug; this word is of course applicable to a great number of plants and substances.
महौषधि: महौषधि f. (-धिः) 1 A sort of grass, commonly Dūb. 2 A kind of sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.) E. महा large, and औषधि a deciduous plant.
मा: मा r. 2d cl. (माति) 3d cl. (मिमीते) 4th cl. (मायते) To mete, to measure: with अनु prefixed, to infer, to conclude: with उप, to resemble; with परि, to measure; with प्र, to be evidence or authority.

मा ind. 1 A prohibitive and negative particle. 2 A particle implying doubt. E. मा to measure, aff. क्विप्; this particle is used chiefly prefixed to verbs, in the imperative mood, as माकुरु do not do (any act), &c., it is also read sometimes, माङ् the final being redundant.
मांस: मांस n. (-सं) Flesh. f. (-सी) 1 Indian spikenard, (Valeriana Jatamansi.) 2 A sort of drug, commonly Kākoli. m. (-सः) 1 Time. 2 A worm. E. मन to mind, स Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long by special rule.
मांसकाम: मांसकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Fond of flesh. E. मांस, कम to desire, ण aff.
मांसकारि: मांसकारि n. (-रि) Blood. E. मांस flesh, and कारि making, cause.
मांसज: मांसज n. (-जं) Marrow or serum of the flesh, adeps. E. मांस flesh, and ज produced.
मांसतेजस्: मांसतेजस् n. (-जः) The marrow of the flesh, meaning probably adeps. E. मांस flesh, and तेजस् lustre.
मांसदलन: मांसदलन m. (-नः) A plant, (Andersonia rohitaka.) E. मांस flesh, and दलन dividing.
मांसभक्ष: मांसभक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Eating flesh, carnivorous. E. मांस flesh, and भक्ष eating.
मांसल: मांसल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Strong, stout, lusty. E. मांस flesh, लच् aff.
मांसविक्रय: मांसविक्रय m. (-यः) Selling flesh or meat. E. मांस, and विक्रय sale.
मांसविक्रयिन्: मांसविक्रयिन् m. (-यी) 1 A vender of the flesh of beasts or birds. 2 A term of reproach, designating a mean or vile person. E. मांस flesh, विक्रयिन् who sells.
मांसशील: मांसशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fleshy. E. मांस flesh or meat, and शील possessing.
मांससार: मांससार m. (-रः) Adeps, fat, the serum of the flesh. E. मांस flesh, and सार essence.
मांसस्नेह: मांसस्नेह m. (-हः) Adeps, the serum or marrow of the flesh. E. मांस flesh, and स्नेह unguent.
मांसहासा: मांसहासा f. (-सा) Skin. E. मांस flesh, हास a smile.
मांसिक: मांसिक m. (-कः) A vender of flesh or meat, whether of beasts or of birds. E. मांस flesh, ठन् aff.
माकन्द: माकन्द m. (-न्दः) The mango. f. (-न्दी) 1 Emblic myrobalan. 2 Yellow saunders. 3 The name of a city. E. मा beauty, and कन्द root.
माकलि: माकलि m. (-लिः) 1 The charioteer of INDRA. 2 The moon.
माक्षिक: माक्षिक n. (-कं) 1 A mineral substance, of which two kinds are described; the स्वर्णमाक्षिक or gold Mākṣika, of a bright yellow colour, apparently the common pyritic iron ore: and the रूप्यमाक्षिक or silver Mākṣika, which answers in appearance to the Hepatic pyrites of iron; other names of these ores occur; as, विट्माक्षिक and कांस्यमाक्षिक, or feculent Mākṣika and mixed metal Mākṣika; they are however, perhaps rather synonyms of the gold and silver ore, respectively, than names of distinct species. 2 Honey. E. माक्षिका a bee, अण् aff. of derivation; the name is applied to the ore, from its honey-like colour.
माक्षिकज: माक्षिकज n. (-जं) Bee's wax. E. माक्षिक honey, and ज born.
माक्षिकशर्करा: माक्षिकशर्करा f. (-रा) A kind of sugar, candied sugar.
माक्षिकाश्रय: माक्षिकाश्रय n. (-यं) 1 Bee's wax. 2 A honey-comb. E. माक्षिक honey, आश्रय receptacle.
मागध: मागध mfn. (-धः-धी-धं) Belonging to, or produced in the province of Magadha or south Behar. m. (-धः) 1 A bard, a minstrel, whose duty it is, to recite the praises of sovereigns, their genealogy, and the deeds of their ancestors, in their presence; and to attend on the march of an army, and animate the soldiers by martial songs: the minstrel forms a particular caste, said to spring from a Vaiśya father, and Kṣatriya mother; in mythology, they are said to have been created at once by the will of ŚIVA: under the name of Bhauts, they are still numerous in the west of India, where they are a privileged tribe. 2 Cumin-seed. m. plu. (-धाः) The inhabitants or people of Magadha. f. (-धी) 1 A kind of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.) 2 Long-pepper, (Piper longum.) 3 A sort of cardamoms grown in Guzerat. 4 Refined sugar. 5 A dialect of Sanskrit: one of the principal forms of Prākṛta, and nearly the same as that used in the sacred books of the Bauddhas and Jainas: in the drama it is the dialect of the attendants and companions of royal person ages. E. मगध a Kaṇḍvādi verb to ask, (reward,) aff. अण्; or मगघ the country, and अण् derivative aff.
माघ: माघ m. (-घः) 1 One of the months of the Hindu year, (JanuaryFebruary.) 2 A poet, the author of the ŚIŚUPĀLA Badha, or as it is named after him the Māgha Kāvya, one of the great profane poems of Hindu literature. f. (-घी) A potherb, (Hingtsha repens.) E. मघा the asterism, in which the moon is full this month, and अण् aff.
माघ्य: माघ्य n. (-घ्यं) Many-flowered jasmine, (Jasminum multiflorum or pubescens.) E. माध the month Māgha, and ष्यञ् aff. of derivation.
माङ्गलिक: माङ्गलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Propitious, tending to good fortune, wishing for it, indicating or portending it, &c. E. मङ्गल, and ठञ् aff.
माङ्गल्य: माङ्गल्य n. (-ल्यं) Welfare, propitiousness. E. मङ्गल, and ष्यञ् aff.
माच: माच m. (-चः) A road, a way.
माचल: माचल m. (-लः) 1 A robber, a bandit. 2 An alligator, a crocodile. 3 Sickness, disease. E. मा fortune, wealth, चल to go, (by such means,) and टच् aff.
माचिर: माचिर ind. Quickly, without delay. E. मा prohibitive, and चिर long.
माजल: माजल m. (-लः) A sort of bird.
माञ्जिष्ठ: माञ्जिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Of a red colour. n. (-ष्ठं) Red, the colour. E. मञ्जिष्ठा madder, used as a red dye, and अण् aff.
माठर: माठर m. (-रः) 1 One of the sun's attendants. 2 The poet VYĀSA. 3 Name of a Muni. 4 A distiller. E. मन to reverence, अरन् Uṇādi aff., ठच् substituted for the radical final, and the vowel optionally long; also माठर्य्य.
माड: माड(ऋ)माडृ r. 1st cl. (माडति-ते) To measure, to weigh.
माड m. (-डः) Weight or quantity. E. माड to weigh, अच् aff.
माड्डुक: माड्डुक m. (-कः) A drummer, a player on the sort of drum called Maḍḍaka or Maḍḍu, q. v. E. मड्डुक as above, and अण् aff.; also with ठक् aff. माड्डुकिक.
माढि: माढि f. (-ढिः) 1 The germ of leaves, the young leaf before it opens. 2 Distress, affliction. 3 Evidence or declaration of distress. 4 A back or double tooth. 5 The hem or border of a garment. 6 Poverty, indigence. 7 Anger, passion. E. मह to worship, aff. क्तिन्; the final becomes ढ, and the preceding vowel is made long.
माणक: माणक m. (-कः) A small shrub, (Arum Indicum.)
माणव: माणव m. (-वः) 1 A child. 2 A man, (in a contemptuous sense,) a manikin. 3 A necklace of sixteen strings. E. मनु a man, and अण् aff.; also मानव.
माणवक: माणवक m. (-कः) 1 A child, a boy not exceeding sixteen years of age, a manikin. 2 A pupil, a scholar, a religious student. 3 A man, an ignorant or ridiculous man, a childish man. 4 A necklace of twenty strings. 5 A species of the Anuṣṭubh metre. E. कन् added to the last.
माणवीण: माणवीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Boyish, childish, fit or suitable for a child. E. माणव as above, and खञ् aff.
माणव्य: माणव्य n. (-व्यं) 1 A number of boys. 2 Boyhood. E. माणव a boy, यत् aff. of property or multitude.
माणिका: माणिका f. (-का) A weight of eight Palas.
माणिक्य: माणिक्य n. (-क्यं) A ruby. f. (-क्या) A house lizard. E. मणि a gem, कै to call, यत् or यञ् added.
माणिबन्ध: माणिबन्ध n. (-न्धं) Sea salt. E. मणिबन्ध a mountain, अण् aff.; found there.
माणिमन्थ: माणिमन्थ n. (-न्थं) Sea salt. E. मणिमन्थ a mountain, from which the salt is supposed to be produced, and अण् aff.
मातङ्ग: मातङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 An elephant. 2 A man of a degraded caste, a Cāṇḍāla, an outcaste. 3 A sort of divine being attendant on a Jina. 4 The sacred fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) 5 A mountaineer, a barbarian. f. (-ङ्गी) 1 The goddess PĀRVATĪ. 2 The wife of VAŚIṢṬHA. E. मतङ्ग a saint, an elephant, &c., and अण् aff. of descent or pleonastic aff.
मातरपितृ: मातरपितृ mdu. (-तरौ) Parents, mother and father. E. मातृ mother, and पितृ father.
मातरिश्वन्: मातरिश्वन् m. (-श्वा) Air, wind. E. मातृ space in the seventh case, in the heavens, श्वि to increase, Uṇādi aff. मनिन्.
मातलि: मातलि m. (-लिः) The charioteer of INDRA. E. मातुल the father, and इञ् patronymic aff.
मातली: मातली f. (-ली) One of DURGA'S female companions. E. माता from मातृ DURGĀ, and आली a friend.
मातापितृ: मातापितृ mdu. (-तरौ) Mother and father. E. माता from मातृ a mother, and पितृ a father.
मातामह: मातामह m. (-हः) A maternal grandfather. f. (-ही) A maternal grandmother. E. मातृ a mother, डामहच् aff. in this sense.
मातुल: मातुल m. (-लः) 1 A maternal uncle. 2 Thorn apple, (Datura metel.) 3 A sort of grain. 4 A variegated snake. f. (-ला-ली or- लानी) 1 The wife of a maternal uncle, &c. 2 Hemp, (Cannabis sativa.) 3 Common Bengal San, a sort of Crotolaria, (C. juncea.) (-लानी) Pulse of various kinds. E. मातृ a mother and डुलच् aff., fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष् with आनुक् optionally inserted before the latter.
मातुलपुत्त्रक: मातुलपुत्त्रक m. (-कः) 1 The son of a maternal uncle. 2 The fruit of the Datura. E. मातुल a maternal uncle, &c., and पुत्त्र son, with कन् pleonasm, or aff. of comparison; also similar compounds, as मातुलात्मज m. (-जः.)
मातुलाहि: मातुलाहि m. (-हिः) A variegated serpent. E. मातुल the same, and अहि snake.
मातुलुङ्ग: मातुलुङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Common citron. f. (-ङ्गा) The sweet lime. E. see the next.
मातुलुङ्गक: मातुलुङ्गक m. (-कः) Common citron, (Citrus medica.) E. मा prohibitive prefix, तुला a balance, गम to go, खच् aff.; with the power of डित्, and कन् added, not sold by weight; also without the additional prefix, मातुलुङ्ग.
मातृ: मातृ f. (-ता) 1 A mother. 2 A divine mother, the personified energy of a deity or his wife; in a figurative sense, a mother to mortals; eight divine Mātṛs are enumerated, BRĀHMĪ, the Mātṛ of BRAHMĀ; MAHEŚVARĪ, the Mātṛ of ŚIVA; VAIṢṆAVĪ, of VIṢṆU; AINDRĪ, of INDRA; VĀRĀHĪ, of VIṢṆU, as the Varāha Avatāra; KAUMĀRĪ, of KĀRTTIKEYA; KĀVERĪ or CĀMUṆḌĀ of KUVERA, and CARCIKĀ of ŚIVA, in one of his minor incarnations; another list calls them MAHEŚVARĪ, BRĀHMĪ, NĀRĀYAṆĪ, AINDRĪ, VĀRĀHĪ, KAUMĀRĪ, NARASIṂHĪ, and APARĀJITĀ, differing from the preceding one in the two last names, the first one of which, is the energy of VIṢṆU in the Narasiṃha Avatāra, and the latter a form of DURGĀ; another enumeration makes the Mātṛs sixteen, and another but seven. 3 A cow. 4 A female of the Brahman tribe, or the wife of a Brahman. 5 The earth. 6 A name of LAKṢMĪ. 7 A name of REVATĪ. 8 Space, ether. E. मान to respect, Uṇādi aff. तृच्, and the final of the radical rejected.
मातृक: मातृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Maternal, belonging to a mother. m. (-कः) A maternal uncle. f. (-का) 1 A mother. 2 A nurse. 3 The alphabet. 4 A simple sound, a note, a vowel. 5 A goddess. E. कन् added to the preceding.
मातृकच्छिद: मातृकछिद m. (-दः) PARAŚURĀMA. E. मातृ A mother, क the head, and छिद to cut, aff. क.
मातृकछिद: मातृकछिद m. (-दः) PARAŚURĀMA. E. मातृ A mother, क the head, and छिद to cut, aff. क.
मातृकेशट: मातृकेशट m. (-टः) A mother's brother. E. मातृ a mother, and केशट a brother.
मातृगामिन्: मातृगामिन् m. (-मी) An incestuous son. E. मातृ, and गामिन् who goes to.
मातृगोच: मातृगोच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Belonging to the mother's family. n. (-चं) The mother's family. E. मातृ, and गोच race.
मातृघातुक: मातृघातुक m. (-कः) 1 INDRA. 2 A matricide. E. मातृ a mother, DITI the mother of the gods, and घातुक destroyer, injurer.
मातृपक्ष: मातृपक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Belonging or relating to the maternal line, or mother, &c. E. मातृ, and पक्ष side.
मातृबन्धु: मातृबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) The cognate relation by the mother's side, as any of the maternal grandfather's or grandmother's sister's or brother's children. E. मातृ a mother, and बन्धु a kinsman.
मातृभोगीण: मातृभोगीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Fit or proper to be possessed, &c. by the mother. E. मातृ, भोग enjoyment, ख aff.
मातृमुख: मातृमुख m. (-खः) A blockhead, a fool. E. मातृ a mother, and मुख principal.
मातृशासित: मातृशासित m. (-तः) A blockhead, a fool. E. मातृ a mother, and शासित governed, mother-led.
मातृष्वसृ: मातृष्वसृ f. (-सा) A mother's sister. E. मातृ mother, and ष्वसृ a sister: also, मातुःष्वसृ, or मातुःस्वसृ.
मातृष्वसेय: मातृष्वसेय m. (-यः) A mother's sister's son. f. (-यी) A mother's sister's daughter. E. मातृ a mother, ष्वसृ a sister, and ढक् aff.
मातृष्वस्रीय: मातृष्वस्रीय m. (-यः) A mother's sister's son. f. (-या) A mother's sister's daughter. E. मातृष्वसृ a maternal aunt, and छण् aff.
मातृसिंही: मातृसिंही f. (-ही) A plant, (Justicia adhenatoda, and ganderussa.)
मात्र: मात्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The whole, the entire thing or class of things. 2 (adv.) Only, solely (exclusive and identical, the very thing.) 3 The primitive subtle or invisible type of visible elementary matter. 4 A pleonastic addition to words. f. (-त्रा) 1 Requisite, material. 2 Quantity, measure. 3 A little. 4 An ear-ring. 5 Wealth, substance. 6 A short vowel. 7 A moment. 8 Quantity in metre or prosody, a syllabic foot. 9 The upper or horizontal limb of the Nāgarī characters. E. मा to measure, Uṇādi aff. चन्, fem. aff. टाप्.
मात्रक: मात्रक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Mere, only, solely. E. कन् added to the last.
मात्सर: मात्सर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Envious, or impatient of another's prosperity. E. मत्सर envy, अण् aff.
मात्सर्य: मात्सर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Envy, malice. E. मत्सर envious, and ष्यञ् aff.
मात्सर्य्य: मात्सर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Envy, malice. E. मत्सर envious, and ष्यञ् aff.
मात्स्यिक: मात्स्यिक m. (-कः) A fisherman. E. मत्स्य a fish, and ठक् aff.
माथ: माथ(इ)माथि r. 1st cl. (मांथति) To hurt or kill, to afflict, to suffer pain.
माथ m. (-थः) 1 Churning, stirring. 2 A road. 3 Hurting, injuring, killing. E. माथ to hurt, aff. अच् or मथ to agitate, aff. अण्.
माद: माद m. (-दः) 1 Intoxication, literal or figurative. 2 Pride. 3 Joy, extasy. E. मद to be delighted or inebriated, and aff. घञ्.
मादक: मादक m. (-कः) A gallinule. E. मद to delight, aff. ण्वुल्.
मादन: मादन n. (-नं) 1 Cloves. 2 Delighting, inebriating. E. मद to be pleased, in the causal form, to please, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
मादृश्: मादृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Like me, resembling me. E. मा for अस्मट् I, दृश् to see, aff. क्विन्; also with कञ् or क्स, aff. मादृश and मादृक्ष.
माद्री: माद्री f. (-द्री) The wife of PĀṆḌU, and mother of the youngest of the Pāṇḍava princes. E. मद्र a king, अण् patronymic aff.
माद्रीपति: माद्रीपति m. (-तिः) A name of PĀṆḌU. E. माद्री the wife of the sovereign, and पति husband.
माद्रीपृथापति: माद्रीपृथापति m. (-तिः) A name of PĀṆḌU. E. माद्री, and पृथा his other wife, पति husband.
माधव: माधव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Made of honey, &c. m. (-वः) 1 A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. 2 The month Vaiśākha. 3 Spring. f. (-वी) 1 Sugar, clayed or candied. 2 A large creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.) 3 Spirituous liquor. 4 A bawd. 5 A sort of dentifrice, commonly Misi. 6 Sacred basil. 7 A name of DURGĀ. n. (-वं) Sweetness. E. मधु honey, &c., and अण् aff. of derivation or reference.
माधवक: माधवक m. (-कः) A spirituous liquor, made from the blossoms of the Bassia latifolia. f. (-विका) 1 A kind of creeper. 2 A female attendant. E. कन् added to the preceding.
माधवीलता: माधवीलता f. (-ता) A large creeper bearing white fragrant flowers, (Gærtnera racemosa.) E. माधवी the same, and लता a creeper.
माधवेष्टा: माधवेष्टा f. (-ष्टा) A name of DURGĀ. E. माधव, and इष्ट wished.
माधुकरी: माधुकरी f. (-री) The alms obtained from five places by the third class of religious mendicants. E. मधुकर a mendicant, अण् aff.
माधुमत: माधुमत m. plu. (-ताः) The people of Kashmir.
माधुर: माधुर n. (-रं) Arabian jasmine or its flower. f. (-री) 1 Spirituous or vinous liquor. 2 Sweetness of temper, amiableness. E. मधुर sweet, &c., aff. अण् and ङीष्.
माधुर्य: माधुर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Sweetness of flavour or disposition. E. मधुर sweet, literally or figuratively, aff. ष्यञ्.
माधुर्य्य: माधुर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Sweetness of flavour or disposition. E. मधुर sweet, literally or figuratively, aff. ष्यञ्.
माधूक: माधूक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Sweet-speaking or sounding. 2 Made from the Bassia tree. E. मधूक, and अण् aff.
माध्य: माध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) Middle, mid (day). E. मध्य, and अण् added.
माध्यम: माध्यम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Middle born. E. मध्यम the same, अण् pleonasm.
माध्यस्थ: माध्यस्थ n. (-स्थं) 1 Middle state or condition. 2 Indifference to earthly objects. E. मध्यस्थ, and अण् aff.
माध्यस्थ्य: माध्यस्थ्य n. (-स्थ्यं) Mediation, intercession. E. मध्यस्थ, and ष्यञ् aff.
माध्वक: माध्वक m. (-कः) Spirit distilled from the flowers of the Bassia. E. मधु Bassia, अण् aff., and कन् added.
माध्वी: माध्वी f. (-ध्वी) 1 Spirituous liquor. 2 A sort of fish. E. मधु sweet, q. v. अण्, and ङीष् aff.
माध्वीक: माध्वीक n. (-कं) 1 Spirituous liquor, distilled from the blossoms of the Bassia latifolia. 2 Wine, spirit distilled from grapes. E. माध्वी as above, कन् added.
मान: मान r. 1st cl. (मीमांसते) To investigate, to seek or desire knowledge. r. 1st and 10th cls. (मानति मानयति) To respect, to revere, to worship. With अप or अव prefixed, to treat with disrespect.

मान n.
