(-नं) 1 Measure in general, whether of weight, length, or capacity. 2 A measure, the fourth or eighth part of a khāri. 3 The computation of the duration of a year, solar, lunar, sydereal, &c. m. (-नः) 1 Arrogance, haughtiness, pride. 2 Female arrogance or indignation. 3 Taking, seizing. 4 A blockhead. 5 An agent. 6 A barbarian. E. मा to measure, ल्युट् aff., or मन to revere, (one's self,) aff. घञ्.
मानक: मानक n. (-कं) A plant, of which the root is sometimes eaten, (Arum indicum.) f. (-निका) The fourth or eighth part of a khāri. E. कन् added to the last.
मानकलि: मानकलि f. (-लिः) Coolness, haughtiness, disdain. E. मान pride, and कलि quarrelling.
मानग्रन्थि: मानग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) 1 Fault, transgression. 2 Pride, self-conceit (?) E. मान pride, and ग्रन्थि a knot or joint.
मानद: मानद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Inspiring pride. 2 Measuring. E. मान, and द what gives.
माननीय: माननीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be respected or revered. E. मान to respect, अनीयर् aff.
मानरन्ध्री: मानरन्ध्री f. (-न्ध्री) A perforated copper vessel, filled with water, to mark the time, &c.: see ताम्री. E. मान a measure, and रन्ध्री a hole.
मानव: मानव m. (-वः) 1 A man, man. 2 A boy. f. (-वी) 1 A woman. 2 A goddess peculiar to the Jainas. 3 A daughter of the first Menu. E. मनु the progenitor of mankind, and अण् patronymic aff.: see माणव, माणवक.
मानवत्: मानवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Proud, haughty, high-spirited. E. मान, and मतुप् aff.
मानवर्जित: मानवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Humble, lowly. E. मान pride, and वर्ज्जित freed from.
मानवर्ज्जित: मानवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Humble, lowly. E. मान pride, and वर्ज्जित freed from.
मानव्य: मानव्य n. (-व्यं) A multitude of boys. E. माणव or मानव a boy, यत् aff. of multitude, more properly माणव्य.
मानस: मानस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Mental. n. (-सं) 1 The mind, the seat or faculty of reason, and feeling. 2 The lake Mānas, or Mānasarovara in the Himālaya mountains. 3 (In law,) Tacit or implied consent. f. (-सी) A goddess peculiar to the Jainas. E. मनस् the mind, aff. अण्, or मनस् BRAHMĀ, the supreme mind, अण् aff. of derivation, &c.
मानसत्व: मानसत्व n. (-त्वं) Thoughtfulness. E. त्व added to the last.
मानसालय: मानसालय m. (-यः) A gander or wild swan. E. मानस, and आलय abode.
मानसूत्र: मानसूत्र n. (-त्रं) A chain of gold or silver, worn as an ornament round the loins. E. मान pride, सूत्र thread.
मानसौकस्: मानसौकस् m. (-काः) The wild swan or goose. E. मानस् the lake Mānasarovara, and ओकस् dwelling; being supposed to migrate yearly from Hindustan to the banks of the lake.
मानिता: मानिता f. (-ता) Pride, dignity. E. मानिन्, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, मानित्वं.
मानिन्: मानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) 1 Proud, arrogant, haughty. 2 (In composition,) Who thinks or fancies. f. (-निनी) 1 A woman, especially one displeased and indignant towards her lover. 2 A plant, commonly Priyangu. 3 A species of the Atiśarkarī metre. E. मान pride, इनि aff.
मानुष: मानुष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Human. m. (-षः) A man. f. (-षी) 1 A woman. 2 A branch of medicine, the administering of drugs and herbs. E. मनुष a man, अण् aff.
मानुष्य: मानुष्य n. (-ष्यं) Manhood, manliness, humanity, the state or quality of a man or mortal. E. मनुष a man, and ष्यञ् aff.
मानुष्यक: मानुष्यक n. (-कं) A multitude of men. E. मनुष्य a man, and वुञ् aff. of multitude.
मानोज्ञक: मानोज्ञक n. (-कं) Beauty, agreeableness, loveliness. E. मनोज्ञ agreeable, and वुञ् aff.
मान्द्य: मान्द्य n. (-न्द्यं) 1 Sickness, indisposition. 2 Sluggishness, torpor, apathy, stupidity, &c. E. मन्द slow, sluggish, and ष्यञ् aff.
मान्धातृ: मान्धातृ m. (-ता) A king fostered by INDRA. E. मां me, धातृ drinker, from धे to drink; having on one occasion sucked Amṛta from the finger of INDRA, who then used the exclamation which afterwards was the name of the prince.
मान्य: मान्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Respectable, venerable. E. मन to respect, aff. ण्यत्.
मापत्य: मापत्य m. (-त्यः) A name of KĀMA.
मापन: मापन m. (-नः) A balance, a pair of scales. n. (-नं) Measure, measuring. E. मा to measure, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
मामक: मामक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) 1 Mine. 2 Selfish. m. (-कः) 1 A miser, a niggard. 2 A mother's brother. E. ममक mine, from मम the poss. case of अहम् I, and अण् added.
मामकीन: मामकीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Mine. E. मम mine, खञ् aff.
माय: माय m. (-यः) 1 A mime, a juggler. 2 An Asura or evil spirit. f. (-या) 1 Fraud, trick, deceit, illusion. 2 A female juggler. 3 Understanding, human intellect. 4 Compassion. 5 Wickedness, villainy, villainous deception. 6 A name of LAKṢMĪ. 7 Trick in negotiation, political fraud, diplomacy. 8 Philosophical illusion, idealism, unreality of all worldly existence; personified in mythology as a female, the consort of BRAHMĀ or GOD, and the immediate and active cause of creation. 9 The mother of BUDDHA. E. मा to measure, Uṇādi aff. य; the medium through which all things are seen, and by which they are estimated.
मायाकार: मायाकार m. (-रः) A juggler, a mime, an actor. E. माया trick or delusion, and कार who makes.
मायाकृत्: मायाकृत् m. (-कृत्) A juggler. E. माया trick, and कृत् who practices.
मायाचण: मायाचण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Illusive, deceptive. E. माया, and चणष् aff.
मायाजीविन्: मायाजीविन् m. (-वी) A conjurer, a juggler. E. माया trick, and जीविन् who lives by.
मायाद: मायाद m. (-दः) A crocodile, an alligator. E. माया illusion, and द who gives or makes.
मायादेवीसुत: मायादेवीसुत m. (-तः) BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha sect. E. मायादेवी the goddess MĀYĀ or illusion, and सुत son.
मायापटु: मायापटु mfn. (-टुः-टुः-टु) Delusive, expert in deceiving. E. माया, and पटु clever.
मायामय: मायामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Illusive, deceptive. E. माया, and मयट् aff.
मायावत्: मायावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Deceptive, illusory. m. (-वान्) A name of KAṂSA. f. (-वती) The wife of KĀMA. E. माया fraud, illusion, and मतुप् poss. aff.
मायावसिक: मायावसिक m. (-कः) A deceiver, a cheater, a liar. E. माया fraud, वस to abide, aff. ठक्.
मायाविन्: मायाविन् m. (-वी) 1 A juggler, a conjurer. 2 A cat. E. माया trick, and विनि aff.
मायासुत: मायासुत m. (-तः) BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha sect. E. माया the goddess so named, and सुत the son.
मायिक: मायिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Illusory, deceptive. m. (-कः) A juggler, a conjurer. E. माया trick, and ठन् aff.
मायिन्: मायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Deceptive, illusory. m. (-यी) 1 A conjurer, a juggler. 2 A cheat, a deceiver. 3 ŚIVA. 4 AGNI. 5 BRAHMĀ. 6 KĀMA or love. E. माया fraud, &c., and इनि aff.
मायु: मायु m. (-युः) Bile, the bilious humour. E. मि to scatter or diffuse, (through the body,) उण् Uṇādi aff.
मायुराज: मायुराज m. (-जः) The son of KUVERA.
मायूर: मायूर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Belonging to a peacock, made of its feathers, &c. n. (-रं) A flock of peacocks. E. मयूर a peacock, and अण् aff. of multitude, &c.
मायूरिक: मायूरिक m. (-कः) A hunter or killer of peacocks. E. मयूर a peacock, and ठक् aff.
मार: मार m. (-रः) 1 Death, dying. 2 Killing, slaying, destroying. 3 Obstruction, opposition, impediment. 4 Thorn-apple, (Datura metel.) 5 A name of KĀMA. f. (-री) 1 A name of CAṆḌĪ, a form of DURGĀ. 2 Plague, pestilence, epidemic. E. मृ to die, aff. घञ्, or in the causal form, with अच् aff.
मारक: मारक m. (-कः) 1 Epidemic disease, plague. 2 A falcon, a hawk. 3 A slayer, a destroyer. E. मृ to die, causal form, aff. वुन्.
मारकत: मारकत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Emerald, of the colour of an emerald, &c. E. मरकत, and अण् aff.
मारजित्: मारजित् m. (-जित्) A BUDDHA. E. मार love, and जित् who overcomes.
मारण: मारण n. (-णं) Killing, slaughter. E. मृ to die, causal form, to kill, aff. ल्युट्.
मारात्मक: मारात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Murderous. E. मार, and आत्मक्र disposed to.
मारि: मारि f. (-रिः) 1 Killing. 2 Ruin. 3 Plague, epidemic. E. मृ to die, causal form, इ aff.: see मार and मारी.
मारिचिक: मारिचिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Peppered, seasoned with pepper. E. मरिच pepper, ठक् aff.
मारित: मारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Killed, slain. E. मृ to die, causal v., क्त aff.
मारिव्यसनवारक: मारिव्यसनवारक m. (-कः) The name of a royal saint. E. मारि plague, व्यसन calamity, वारक stopping.
मारिष: मारिष m. (-षः) A venerable person, (in dramatic language,) especially the title of the manager, or principal actor. mf. (-षः-षी) A potherb, (Amaranthus oleraceus.) f. (-षी) The mother of the sage DAKṢA. E. मृष to bear patiently, deriv. irr.
मारीच: मारीच m. (-चः) 1 The name of a Rākṣasa, the companion of RĀVAṆA. 2 A military or royal elephant. 3 A sort of berry, commonly Kakkoli. f. (-ची) A goddess, peculiar to the Bauddhas. E. मरीच a saint, &c., aff. अण्.
मारुण्ड: मारुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A serpent's egg. 2 A road. 3 A place spread with cow-dung; some authorities have मारण्ड.
मारुत: मारुत m. (-तः) 1 Air, wind. 2 Vital air, one of the three humours of the body. 3 A wind, a demigod, of whom there is a class consisting of forty-nine. n. (-तं) Burnt-offering on conception. E. मृ to die, (by excess of it,) उति aff., and the vowel made long; the demigods, called Mārutas, are said to be the sons of Diti, formed of the divisions of the foetus in utero, by the Vajra, or thunderbolt of INDRA, and to be named from that deity's addressing the foetus he thus divided by मारोदीः weep not.
मारुतव्रत: मारुतव्रत n. (-तं) One of the duties of a king, his universal presence by means of his emissaries. E. मारुत the wind, and व्रत observance, pervading all things like the wind.
मारुतात्मज: मारुतात्मज m. (-जः) HANUMĀN, the monkey god. E. मारुत air, and आत्मज son.
मारुतापह: मारुतापह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Removing or opposing wind, windy humour, &c. m. (-हः) A plant, (Capparis trifoliata.) E. मारुत wind, or a disease of that humour, and अपह removing, obviating.
मारुताशन: मारुताशन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fasting, feeding on air. E. मारुत the wind, and अशन who eats.
मारुति: मारुति m. (-तिः) 1 A name of HANUMĀN. 2 The Pāṇḍava prince BHĪMA. E. मरुत wind, the deity, and इञ् patronymic aff.; the son of the wind.
मार्कटपिपीलिका: मार्कटपिपीलिका f. (-का) A small black ant.
मार्कण्ड: मार्कण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A Muni, and narrator of one of the Purāṇas. E. मृकण्डु the father of the saint, and अण् aff.
मार्कण्डेय: मार्कण्डेय m. (-यः) MĀRKAṆḌEYA a holy sage, the supposed author or narrator of one of the Purāṇas, named the Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa. E. मृकण्डु the father of the sage, and ढक् aff.
मार्ग: मार्ग r. 1st and 10th cls. (मार्गति मार्गयति) 1 To make or prepare. 2 To go. 3 To prepare the way, to make a road. 4 To feather an arrow. (मार्गयति-ते) To seek.

मार्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 A road, a path or way. 2 Search, seeking, inquiry. 3 The anus. 4 Musk. 5 The month in which the moon is full in the asterism Mṛgaśīrṣa, (November-December.) 6 The constellation Mṛgaśīrṣa. 7 (In geometry,) A section. E. मृग to inquire, aff. घञ्, or मृग a deer, aff. अण्.
मार्गक: मार्गक m. (-कः) The month Agrahāyaṇa, (November-December.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
मार्गण: मार्गण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Mendicant, asking, begging, a beggar, n. (-णं) 1 Asking, soliciting, begging. 2 Research, inquiry. 3 Affection, affectionate solicitation or inquiry. m. (-णः) 1 An arrow. 2 A suppliant, a solicitor. E. मृग to ask, to seek, aff. ल्युट्.
मार्गणक: मार्गणक m. (-कः) A suppliant, a beggar. E. कन् added to the preceding.
मार्गधेनु: मार्गधेनु m. (-नुः) A Yojana, a measure of distance equal to 4,000 fathoms or four Kös, above eight miles. E. मार्ग a road, and धेनु a milch cow; also with कन् added, मार्गधेनुक (-कं).
मार्गव: मार्गव m. (-वः) A man of a low caste, born of a Niṣāda by an Ayogava female.
मार्गशिर: मार्गशिर m. (-रः) The month Agrahāyaṇa, (November-December.) E. मृगशिरस् the asterism in which the moon is full, and अण् aff.: also from मृगशीर्ष with अण् aff. मार्गशीर्ष.
मार्गशीर्ष: मार्गशीर्ष m. (-र्षः) The month Mārgaśīrṣa: see the last.
मार्गिक: मार्गिक m. (-कः) 1 A deer-killer, a hunter. 2 A traveller, a wayfarer. E. मृग a deer, or मार्ग a road, and ठक् aff.
मार्गित: मार्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sought, inquired after, pursued. E. मृग to seek for, aff. क्त.
मार्ग्य: मार्ग्य mfn. (-र्ग्यः-र्ग्या-र्ग्यं) 1 To be cleaned or purified. 2 To be sought. E. मृज to cleanse, aff. ण्यत्, or मार्ग to seek, यत् aff.
मार्ज: मार्ज r. 1st cl. (मार्जयति) 1 To sound. 2 To cleanse.
मार्ज m. (-र्जः). 1 Cleaning the body. 2 A washerman. 3 A name of VIṢṆU. E. मृज to cleanse, aff. घञ्.
मार्जन: मार्जन nf. (-नं-नी) 1 Cleaning, cleansing, wiping. 2 Cleaning the person, by wiping, bathing, or rubbing it with oil or fragrant unguents. m. (-नः) A tree, commonly Lodh. f. (-ना) The sound of a drum. f. (-नी) 1 A brush, a broom. 2 One of DURGĀ'S attendants. E. मृज to clean, aff. युच् or ल्युट्, or मार्ज to sound, with the same aff.
मार्जनीय: मार्जनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be cleaned, to be cleansed or purified. E. मृज to cleanse, अनीयर् aff.
मार्जार: मार्जार mf. (-रः-री) 1 The common cat. 2 The wild or polecat. E. मृज to cleanse, (its skin and face,) आरन् aff., and the vowel made long.
मार्जारक: मार्ज्जारक m. (-कः) A peacock. E. मार्जार a cat, and कन् aff.
मार्ज्जारक: मार्ज्जारक m. (-कः) A peacock. E. मार्जार a cat, and कन् aff.
मार्जारकण्ठ: मार्ज्जारकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A peacock, perhaps a wrong reading for the last, or vice versa.
मार्ज्जारकण्ठ: मार्ज्जारकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A peacock, perhaps a wrong reading for the last, or vice versa.
मार्जारकर्णिका: मार्ज्जारकर्णिका f. (-का) A goddess, a form of DURGĀ. E. मार्जार a cat, कर्ण the ear, कन् aff. fem. form; also मार्जारकर्णी having the ears of a cat.
मार्ज्जारकर्णिका: मार्ज्जारकर्णिका f. (-का) A goddess, a form of DURGĀ. E. मार्जार a cat, कर्ण the ear, कन् aff. fem. form; also मार्जारकर्णी having the ears of a cat.
मार्जारगन्धिका: मार्ज्जारगन्धिका f. (-का) A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus trilobus.) E. मार्जार a cat, गन्ध smell, कन् aff. of comparison; also मार्जारगन्धा.
मार्ज्जारगन्धिका: मार्ज्जारगन्धिका f. (-का) A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus trilobus.) E. मार्जार a cat, गन्ध smell, कन् aff. of comparison; also मार्जारगन्धा.
मार्जाल: मार्ज्जाल m. (-लः) A cat. E. see मार्जार, the final being changed to ल.
मार्ज्जाल: मार्ज्जाल m. (-लः) A cat. E. see मार्जार, the final being changed to ल.
मार्जालीय: मार्ज्जालीय m. (-यः) 1 A cat. 2 A Śūdra. 2 Cleaning the body. E. मृज to clean, and आलीयच् Uṇādi aff.; it is also written मार्जारीय, from the र and ल being interchanged, or as derived from मार्जार, with छ aff.
मार्ज्जालीय: मार्ज्जालीय m. (-यः) 1 A cat. 2 A Śūdra. 2 Cleaning the body. E. मृज to clean, and आलीयच् Uṇādi aff.; it is also written मार्जारीय, from the र and ल being interchanged, or as derived from मार्जार, with छ aff.
मार्जित: मार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cleansed. 2 Adorned. E. मार्ज to clean, क्त aff.
मार्ज्जित: मार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cleansed. 2 Adorned. E. मार्ज to clean, क्त aff.
मार्जिता: मार्ज्जिता f. (-ता) Curds with honey and spice. E. मार्ज to clean, aff. क्त, fem. aff. टाप्.
मार्ज्जिता: मार्ज्जिता f. (-ता) Curds with honey and spice. E. मार्ज to clean, aff. क्त, fem. aff. टाप्.
मार्तण्ड: मार्त्तण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 The sun. 2 A hog. E. मृतण्ड the progenitor of the sun, aff. अण्; also sometimes मार्त्ताण्ड.
मार्त्तण्ड: मार्त्तण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 The sun. 2 A hog. E. मृतण्ड the progenitor of the sun, aff. अण्; also sometimes मार्त्ताण्ड.
मार्तिक: मार्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Earthen, made of clay or earth. m. (-कः) The lid of a pot or pitcher. E. मृत्तिका earth, अण् aff.
मार्त्तिक: मार्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Earthen, made of clay or earth. m. (-कः) The lid of a pot or pitcher. E. मृत्तिका earth, अण् aff.
मार्दङ्ग: मार्द्दङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A town, a city. m. (-ङ्गः) A drummer. E. मृदङ्ग a drum, (played in or by,) अण् aff.
मार्द्दङ्ग: मार्द्दङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A town, a city. m. (-ङ्गः) A drummer. E. मृदङ्ग a drum, (played in or by,) अण् aff.
मार्दङ्गिक: मार्द्दङ्गिक m. (-कः) A drummer, a player on the drum. E. मृदङ्ग a drum, and ठक् aff.
मार्द्दङ्गिक: मार्द्दङ्गिक m. (-कः) A drummer, a player on the drum. E. मृदङ्ग a drum, and ठक् aff.
मार्दव: मार्द्दव n. (-वं) Softness. E. मृदु soft, aff. अण्.
मार्द्दव: मार्द्दव n. (-वं) Softness. E. मृदु soft, aff. अण्.
मार्द्धव: मार्द्धव m. (-वः) A man of low caste and occupation.
मार्द्वीक: मार्द्वीक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Made of or from grapes. n. (-कं) Wine. E. मृद्धीका a grape, अण् aff.
मार्ष: मार्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 A venerable or respectable man, (in dramatic language.) 2 A potherb. E. मृष to suffer, aff. अण्; also मारिष.
मार्ष्टि: मार्ष्टि f. (-र्ष्टिः) 1 Cleaning the person, bathing, wiping, smearing it with unguents or oil. 2 Cleaning, cleansing in general. E. मृज to cleanse, aff. क्तिन्.
माल: माल n. (-लं) A field. m. (-लः) 1 A man. 2 A mountain, a barbarian, one of a particular tribe. 3 A country, lying west and south-west of Bengal; Ramghur, &c., or according to WILFORD, Mālbhūm in Midnapur. 4 A name of VIṢṆU. f. (-ला) 1 A line, a row. 2 A garland, a string or wreath of flowers. 3 A chaplet of flowers. 4 A string of beads, a rosary. In rhetorical or poetical description, a series or string of epithets, similes, &c. E. मा fortune, ला to get or be, aff. अङ् and टाप्; or मा to measure, Uṇādi aff. र, and र changed to ल.
मालक: मालक m. (-कः) The Nimb tree, (Melia azadiracta.) n. (-कं) A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) f. (-का) A garland. E. माला a garland, कन् aff., and the final of the fem. rejected; also in the fem. form, मालाका and मालिका q. v.
मालती: मालती f. (-ती) 1 Great-flowered jasmine, (Jasminum grandiflorum.) 2 A bud, a blossom. 3 A young woman. 4 Moonlight. 5 Night. 6 A river. 7 A flower, (Bignonia suaveolens.) 8 A shrub, (Echites caryophyllata.) 9 A species of the Jagatī metre. E. मा LAKṢMĪ, लत Sautra root, to shake, aff. अच् and ङीप्; or मल to hold, अतच् aff.; or माल VIṢṆU, अत to go, (to be presented to,) aff. अण् and ङीष्.
मालतीतीरज: मालतीतीरज m. (-जः) Borax. E. मालती the river, तीर the bank, and ज produced.
मालय: मालय n. (-यं) Sandal, the unguent prepared from it. E. मलय the mountain whence the wood is brought, and अण् aff.
मालव: मालव m. (-वः) The province of Malva, or m. plu. (-वाः) The people of that province; also with ञ्य pleonasm मालव्य, fem. मालवी.
मालसी: मालसी f. (-सी) A plant, commonly Keśapuṣṭa.
मालाका: मालाका f. (-का) A garland, a wreath. E. माला the same, and कन् pleonasm.
मालाकार: मालाकार m. (-रः) A flower-seller, a florist, a gardener. E. माला a garland, and कार who makes; also मालाकृत्, &c.
मालातृणक: मालातृणक m. (-कः) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schoenanthus.) E. माला a wreath, तृण grass, and कन् added.
मालादीपक: मालादीपक n. (-कं) In rhetoric, affinity of various objects, by a common property. E. माला, and दीपक illustrating.
मालाफल: मालाफल n. (-लं) The seed of the Eleocarpus, of which common rosaries, are made. E. माला a rosary, and फल fruit.
मालिक: मालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to a garland, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A florist, a flower-gatherer or seller. 2 A sort of bird. 3 A colorist, a painter. f. (-का) 1 Double jasmine, (Jasminum zambac, floribus multiplicatis.) 2 A daughter. 3 A necklace, an ornament of the neck. 4 A garland of flowers, a wreath. 5 The name of a river. 6 A spirituous or vinous liquor. 7 Linseed, (Linum utilatissimum.) 8 A palace. E. माला a garland, ठक् aff., or कन् added, fem. form.
मालिन्: मालिन् m. (-ली) A florist, a gatherer and vender of flowers, a gardener. f. (-लिनी) 1 A name of UMĀ or DURGĀ. 2 The Ganges of heaven. 3 The city Campā, the modern Bhāgalpur. 4 A poetical stanza, consisting of alternate verses or hemistichs of eight and seven syllables; it is especially used to conclude a section or canto. 5 The wife of a flower-gatherer, or a female vender of garlands, &c. 6 A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) 7 A shrub, (Echites caryophyllata.) E. माला a garland, इनि aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.
मालु: मालु m. (-लुः) A sort of creeper. E. मल to hold, Uṇādi aff. उण्.
मालुधान: मालुधान m. (-नः) 1 A variegated snake. 2 One of the Nāgas or serpents of Pātāla (?) f. (-नी) A sort of creeper. E. मालु a creeper, and धान having.
मालूर: मालूर m. (-रः) A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.) E. मा fortune, लू to cut, and रक् aff., form irr.
मालेय: मालेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating to a garland, &c. f. (-या) Large cardamoms. E. माला, and ढक् aff.
माल्य: माल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Proper or fit for a garland, &c. n. (-ल्यं) 1 A flower. 2 A garland, a wreath. 3 A chaplet, a garland for the forehead. f. (-ल्या) A sort of grass, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. माला a garland, and यत् aff.
माल्यवत्: माल्यवत् m. (-वान्) A mountainous range, described as one of the smaller mountains of India proper; lying eastward of mount Meru. f. (-वता) Name of a river. E. माल्य a wreath, and मतुप् aff.
माल्लवी: माल्लवी f. (-वी) A wrestling or boxing match.
माशब्दिक: माशब्दिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Prohibitive, prohibiting, a prohibitor, a forbidder. E. मा particle of negation or prohibition, शब्द a sound, a word, and ठक् aff., implying the person or thing whence it proceeds.
माष: माष m. (-षः) 1 A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus radiatus.) 2 A jeweller's or goldsmith's weight, variously reckoned at five, eight, or ten Rattis, or seeds of the Abrus precatorius; the weight in common use, is about seventeen grains troy. 3 A blockhead, a fool. 4 A cutaneous disease. E. मष to hurt, aff. घञ्.
माषक: माषक m. (-कः) 1 A weight of silver of two Rattis or about 4½ grains. 2 The same in gold. 3 A Māṣa: see the last. E. कन् added to the preceding.
माषपर्णी: माषपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A kind of leguminous shrub, (Glycine debilis.) E. माष the kidney bean, and पर्ण a leaf, aff. ङीष् resembling it in the leaf.
माषवर्द्धक: माषवर्द्धक m. (-कः) A goldsmith, a jeweller. E. माष the weight so called, and वृद्ध to increase, aff. वुन्.
माषशस्: माषशस् ind. Māṣa by Māṣa, (given away, &c.) E. माष a particular weight, and शसि aff. of successive order.
माषीण: माषीण n. (-णं) A field of kidney-beans. E. माष as above, खञ् aff.
माष्य: माष्य n. (-ष्यं) A field of kidney-beans. E. माष as above, and यत् aff.
मास्: मास् m. (-माः) 1 The moon. 2 A month. E. मा splendor, light, अस् to be, क्विप् aff.
मास: मास m. (-सः) 1 A month, the twelfth part of the Hindu year; it is usually a lunar one, consisting of thirty Tithis, but it may be a Saura or solar month, being equal to the sun's passage through a sign of the zodiac; there is also a Sāvana month, consisting of thirty risings and settings of the sun; a Nākṣatra month, or month regulated by the lunar asterisms, and a fifth description of month called Vārhaspatya, depending on the motions of the planet JUPITER; the lunar month also, being of two kinds, as reckoned from the new or from the full moon, completes six different modes of monthly computation. 2 A jeweller's weight: see माष. E. मास् the moon, aff. अण् or मस to measure, (the year by it,) aff. घञ्.
मासजात: मासजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) A month old. E. मास, and जात born.
मासज्ञ: मासज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A gallinule. E. मास a month, and ज्ञ who knows.
मासन: मासन n. (-नं) A medicinal seed, (Serratula anthelmintica.)
मासप्रमित: मासप्रमित m. (-तः) New moon. E. मास, and प्रमित measured (by).
मासमान: मासमान m. (-नः) A year. E. मास a month, and मान measure.
मासर: मासर m. (-रः) The scum of boiled rice. E. मस to measure, aff. अरन्, and the vowel made long.
मासवर्तिका: मासवर्त्तिका f. (-का) A kind of bird. E. मास a month, वृत to be, aff. वुन्.
मासवर्त्तिका: मासवर्त्तिका f. (-का) A kind of bird. E. मास a month, वृत to be, aff. वुन्.
मासान्त: मासान्त m. (-न्तः) Day of new moon. E. मास the month, and अन्त end.
मासिक: मासिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Monthly, relating or belonging to a month. 2 Payable in a month, (a debt, &c.) 3 Hired by the month, (a servant.) 4 Lasting for a month. 5 Happening or occurring at the end of a month, what will occur a month hence, &c. n. (-कं) A particular Śrāddha, or obsequial sacrifice performed every day of new moon. E. मास a month, and ठक् or ठञ् aff.
मासीन: मासीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of a month, a month old. E. मास, and खञ् aff.
मासुरी: मासुरी f. (-री) The beard. E. मस to measure, aff. उरन्, form irr.
मास्म: मास्म ind. A prohibitive particle. E. मा prohibitive, and स्म termination added.
मास्य: मास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Of or lasting a month, a month old. E. मास, and यत् aff.
माह: माह (u, or f) माहु or माहृ r. 1st cl. (माहति-ते) To mete, to measure.
माहन: माहन m. (-नः) A Brahman. E. मा prohibitive prefix, हन to kill, aff. अच्, radical letters unchanged.
माहा: माहा f. (-हा) A cow. E. मा prohibitive prefix, and हन् to kill, affs. ड and टाप्.
माहाकुल: माहाकुल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Of a respectable family. E. महाकुल of respectable lineage, and अञ् aff. of descent; also with खञ् aff., माहाकुलीन, or with ख, महाकुलीन.
माहाजनिक: माहाजनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Fit for or suitable to great persons, &c. E. महाजन, and ठञ् aff.
माहात्मिक: माहात्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Glorious, majestic 2 Magnanimous. 3 Of great sanctity or honour. E. महात्मन्, and ठक् aff.
माहात्म्य: माहात्म्य n. (-त्म्यं) 1 Majesty, greatness, might. 2 The peculiar efficacy or virtue of any divinity or sacred shrine, &c. 3 A work, giving an account of the merits of any holy place or object. E. महात्मन् great, ष्यञ् aff.
माहानाम्निक: माहानाम्निक m. (-कः) A Brahman versed in a peculiar portion of the Vedas. E. महानाम्नी a portion of the Vedas so called, and ठञ् aff.; also with the final dropped, माहानामिक.
माहाराजिक: माहाराजिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Imperial, royal, fit for a king, &c. E. महाराज, and ठञ् aff.
माहिन: माहिन n. (-नं) Kingdom, dominion. E. महिन the same, अण् pleonasm.
माहिर: माहिर m. (-रः) A name of INDRA.
माहिष: माहिष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Belonging to or derived from a buffalo, (flesh, milk, &c.) E. महिष, and अण् aff.
माहिष्य: माहिष्य m. (-ष्यं) A man of a mixed class, sprung from a Kṣatriya father and Vaiśya mother. E. महिष a buffalo, and यत् aff., with अण् added; attendance on cattle forming with the practice of astronomy and music, the business of the Māhiṣya.
माहेन्द्र: माहेन्द्र mfn. (-न्द्रः-न्द्री-न्द्रं) Relating to or belonging to INDRA, fit or proper for, (as an oblation to him, &c.) f. (-न्द्री) The wife of INDRA. E. महेन्द्र the deity, and अण् aff.; also with छ, माहेन्द्रीय, &c.
माहेय: माहेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Earthen, made of or from earth. m. (-यः) Coral. f. (-यी) A cow. E. मही the earth, ढक् aff.
माहेश्वरी: माहेश्वरी f. (-री) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 One of the divine mothers or energies of the gods, the Śakti of ŚIVA. E. महेश्वर ŚIVA, अण् and ङीष् aff.
मि: मि(डु ञ्,) डुमिञ् r. 5th cl. (मिनोति मिनुते) To cast, to throw, to throw about, to scatter.
मिच्छ: मिच्छ r. 6th cl. (मिच्छति) 1 To pain, to inflict pain or distress. 2 To obstruct, to hinder.
मित: मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Measured. 2 Moderate, limited, few or little. 3 Known, understood. 4 Scattered, sprinkled. E. मा to mete, or मि to scatter, aff. क्त, form irr.
मितङ्गम: मितङ्गम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Going deliberately or slowly. m. (-मः) An elephant. f. (-मा) A she-elephant. E. मित measured, गम to go, aff. खच्.
मितद्रु: मितद्रु m. (-द्रुः) The ocean. E. मित what is measured, (the earth,) and द्रु to go, Uṇādi aff. कु.
मितभुज्: मितभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Moderate, temperate. E. मित, and भुज् who eats, &c.
मितम्पच: मितम्पच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Miserly, niggardly, a niggard, a miser. E. मित measured, (food,) and पच who cooks, from पच with खच् aff.
मितवाच्: मितवाच् mfn. (-क्) Prudent in speaking, of measured speech. E. मित, and वाच् speech.
मितार्थ: मितार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Of certain or restricted meaning. m. (-र्थः) A cautious emissary. E. मित, and अर्थ sense.
मिताशन: मिताशन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Abstemious, moderate in diet, eating little and sparingly. E. मित measured, and अशन who eats.
मिति: मिति f. (-तिः) 1 Measuring, measure. 2 Weighing, weight. 3 Value. 4 Knowledge. 5 Proof, evidence. E. मा to measure, aff. क्तिन्.
मित्र: मित्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A friend. 2 An ally; in this form it is always neuter; but it is convertible into an attributive, and is then of three genders, (मित्रः मित्रा मित्रं) Friendly, a friend. m. (-त्रः) The sun. f. (-त्री) One of the wives of DAŚARATHA, the mother of ŚATRUGHNA. E. मिद to be affectionate, aff. क्त्र; hence more properly written मित्त्र.
मित्रकार्य: मित्रकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A friendly deed, friendship. E. मित्र, and कार्य्यं act.
मित्रकार्य्य: मित्रकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A friendly deed, friendship. E. मित्र, and कार्य्यं act.
मित्रत्व: मित्रत्व n. (-त्वं) Friendship, friendliness. E. मित्र with त्व aff.; also with तल्, मित्रता.
मित्रद्रुह: मित्रद्रुह m. (-द्रुक्) A false or treacherous friend. E. मित्र, and द्रुह who injures.
मित्रद्विष्: मित्रद्विष् m. (-ट्) A treacherous friend. E. मित्र, and द्विष् who hates.
मित्रभेद: मित्रभेद m. (-दः) Breach of friendship. E. मित्र, and भेद division.
मित्रयु: मित्रयु mfn. (-युः-युः-यु) Attractive, winning or acquiring friends. m. (-युः) 1 A rememberer or retainer of traditions, a person acquainted with popular and unrecorded customs. 2 A friend. E. मित्र a friend, या to obtain, aff. कु.
मित्रयुद्ध: मित्रयुद्ध n. (-द्धं) The contest of friends, the conflict of allies. E. मित्र, and युद्ध war.
मित्रलब्धि: मित्रलब्धि f. (-ब्धिः) Acquirement of friendship. E. मित्र a friend, and लब्धि acquisition.
मित्रलाभ: मित्रलाभ m. (-भः) Acquirement of a friend or friendship, forming friendship, &c. E. मित्र a friend, and लाभ gain, acquisition.
मित्रवत्सल: मित्रवत्सल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Acquiring friendship, winning, captivating, engaging. E. मित्र a friend, and वत्सल a child.
मित्रशीस्: मित्रशीस् m. (-शीः) A ruler over his friends or allies. E. मित्र, and शास to govern, क्विप् aff. and ई substituted for the penultimate.
मित्रीयत्: मित्रीयत् mfn. (-यत्-यन्ती-यत्) Becoming or acting as a friend, desiring friendship. E. मित्र nominal verb, शतृ aff.
मिथ: मिथ(ऋ,) मिथृ r. 1st cl. (मिथति-ते) 1 To understand. 2 To injure, to hurt. 3 To unite, to pair.
मिथस्: मिथस् ind. 1 Mutually, reciprocally. 2 Privately. E. मिथ to pair, aff. असुन्, and the vowel unchanged.
मिथिला: मिथिला f. (-ला) A city, giving name also to a kingdom, lying north-east of Bengal, the modern Tirhut. E. मिथ to be agitated, (enemies by that kingdom,) and इलच् Uṇādi aff.
मिथुन: मिथुन n. (-नं) 1 A couple, a pair, a brace, male and female. 2 Copulation. 3 Union, junction. m. (-नः) The sign of the zodiac Gemini. E. मिथ to unite, उनन् Uṇādi aff.
मिथुनीभाव: मिथुनीभाव m. (-वः) Amorous inclination. E. मिथुन, and भाव property, च्चि aff.
मिथ्या: मिथ्या ind. Falsely, untruly. E. मिथ to injure, deriv. irr.
मिथ्याचरत्: मिथ्याचरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Acting or practising falsehood. E. मिथ्या, and आचरत् observing.
मिथ्याचार: मिथ्याचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Acting falsely. E. मिथ्या, and आचार observance.
मिथ्यादृष्टि: मिथ्यादृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Denial of future existence, atheism, heresy. E. मिथ्या falsely, and दृष्टि vision, knowledge.
मिथ्याध्यवसिति: मिथ्याध्यवसिति f. (-तिः) A figure of rhetoric, confirmation of one error or impossibility by another. E. मिथ्या falsehood, अध्यवसिति perseverance.
मिथ्याप्रतिज्ञ: मिथ्याप्रतिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Treacherous, guilty of a breach of promise. E. मिथ्या, and प्रतिज्ञा promise.
मिथ्याप्रसुप्त: मिथ्याप्रसुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Pretendedly asleep, but not so in reality. E. मिथ्या, and प्रसुप्त asleep.
मिथ्याभियोग: मिथ्याभियोग m. (-गः) Groundless plaint or demand. E. मिथ्या falsely, अभियोग plaint.
मिथ्याभिशंसन: मिथ्याभिशंसन n. (-नं) A false accusation. E. मिथ्या falsely, अभिशंसन accusing.
मिथ्याभिशंसिन्: मिथ्याभिशंसिन् m. (-सी) A false or unjust accuser. E. मिथ्या falsely, अभिशंसिन् who accuses.
मिथ्यामति: मिथ्यामति f. (-तिः) Error, ignorance, mistake. E. मिथ्या falsely, and मति understanding.
मिथ्यावदत्: मिथ्यावदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) Speaking falsely. E. मिथ्या, and वदत् speaking.
मिथ्यावादिन्: मिथ्यावादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Lying, a liar. E. मिथ्या, and वादिन् who speaks.
मिथ्योत्तर: मिथ्योत्तर n. (-रं) A false or prevaricating reply. E. मिथ्या, and उत्तर answer.
मिथ्योपचार: मिथ्योपचार m. (-रः) Pretended friendly services. E. मिथ्या, and उपचार assistance.
मिद्: मिद् r. 1st cl. (मेदति) 1 To be proud. 2 To be humble. r. 10th cl. (मेदयति) (इ) मिदि r. 1st and 10th cls. (मिन्दति मिन्दयति) also (ञि, आ,) ञिमिदा r. 1st cl. (मेदते) r. 4th cl. (मेद्यति) 1 To be unctuous, to be oily or greasy. 2 To liquefy, to melt. 3 To  anoint. 4 To have affection or regard for. 5 To be soft, (literally or figuratively.) (ऋ) मिदृ r. 1st cl. (मेदति-ते) 1 To understand. 2 To hurt, to injure.
मिद्ध: मिद्ध n. (-द्धं) 1 Sloth, indolence. 2 Sleepiness, torpor. 3 Dulness, heaviness of spirits or intellect.
मिमङ्क्षा: मिमङ्क्षा f. (-क्षा) Wishing to bathe or plunge into. E. मस्ज to bathe, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
मिमङ्क्षु: मिमङ्क्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Wishing to bathe, to plunge into, to be immersed in. E. मस्ज to bathe, desid. v., उ aff.
मिमन्थिषा: मिमन्थिषा f. (-षा) Desire or purpose to destroy. E. मथि to shake, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
मिमन्थिषु: मिमन्थिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to destroy, shake, overturn, &c. E. मथ to injure, desid. v., उ aff.
मिल: मिल r. 6th cl. (मिलति or मिलति-ते) To be connected or united with, to mix, to associate.
मिलन: मिलन n. (-नं) 1 Mixing with, being in contact with, associating with, &c. 2 Encountering, meeting. E. मिल to mix, ल्युट् aff.
मिलित: मिलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Mixed, united, combined or connected with. 2 Found, met with, encountered. E. मिल to mix, aff. क्त.
मिव: मिव(इ)मिवि r. 1st cl. (मिन्वति) 1 To sprinkle or moisten. 2 (According to some authorities,) To serve, to gratify by service.
मिश: मिश r. 1st cl. (मेशति) 1 To sound. 2 To be angry.
मिशि: मिशि f. (-शिः-शी) 1 A sort of fennel, (Anethum panmorium.) 2 Indian spikenard. 3 Common anise. E. मिश to sound, कि aff., and ङीष् optionally added; also मिषि, मिसि, &c.
मिश्र: मिश्र r. 10th cl. (मिश्रयति) To mix, to join, to blend, to combine.

मिश्र mfn. (-श्रः-श्रा-श्रं) Mixed, mingled, blended. n. (-श्रं) Mixing, mixture. m. (-श्रः) 1 An elephant, the fourth of the four classes in which elephants are arranged. 2 A respectable person; in which sense it is a common affix to proper names; or compounded with आर्य्य, as आर्य्यमिश्राः. E. मिश्र to mix, aff. अच्.
मिश्रक: मिश्रक m. (-कः) 1 An adulterator of commodities, &c. 2 A mixer, a compounder. n. (-कं) 1 A garden of the gods, a grove of paradise. 2 A description of song or singing. E. मिश्र mingled, (flowers, &c.) and कन् aff.
मिश्रकावन: मिश्रकावन n. (-नं) The grove of INDRA. E. मिश्रका for मिश्रक a divine garden, and वन a wood.
मिश्रण: मिश्रण n. (-णं) 1 Mixing, uniting. 2 (In arithmetic,) Addition. E. मिश्र to mix, aff. ल्युट्.
मिश्रित: मिश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Respected, respectable. 2 Mixed, mingled. 3 Added. E. मिश्र to mix, aff. क्त.
मिश्रेया: मिश्रेया f. (-या) 1 A sort of fennel, (Anethum panmorium, Rox.) 2 Another kind, (Anethum sowa.) 3 Common anise, (Pimpinella anisum.) E. मिश्र mixture, इड् to go or get, अचू aff.
मिष: मिष r. 1st cl. (उ) मिषु (मेषति) To sprinkle. r. 6th cl. (मिषति) To contend with, to emulate, to contest.
मिष n. (-षं) 1 Fraud, trick, deception. 2 Envy. E. मिष to vie, aff. क.
मिषि: मिषि f. (-षिः-षी) 1 Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) 2 A sort of fennel, (Anethum panmorium, &c.) E. मस to measure, इन् and ङीष् aff., स changed to ष, and इ substituted for the radical vowel; also मिसि, मिशि, and with कन् added मिषिका, &c.
मिष्ट: मिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Sprinkled, wetted. 2 Sweet, sugary n. (-ष्टं) A sweetmeat. E. मिष to sprinkle, aff. क्त.
मिष्टकर्तृ: मिष्टकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A confectioner, a good cook. E. मिष्ट, and कर्त्तृ who makes.
मिष्टकर्त्तृ: मिष्टकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A confectioner, a good cook. E. मिष्ट, and कर्त्तृ who makes.
मिष्टान्न: मिष्टान्न n. (-न्नं) Sauce, gravy, seasoning, a mixture of sugar and acids, &c. eaten with bread or rice. E. मिष्ट sprinkled, अन्न food.
मिसि: मिसि f. (-सिः-सी) 1 A sort of fennel, (Anethum panmorium, Rox.) 2 Another kind, (A. sowa.) 3 Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) 4 A sort of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen.) 5 Common anise, (Pimpinella anisum.) E. मस to mete, aff. इन्, and optionally ङीष्; the radical vowel changed to इ, deriv. irr.; also मिशि and मिषि.
मिस्र: मिस्र r. 10th cl. (मिस्रयति) To mix, to mingle or join.
मिह: मिह(औ)मिहौ r. 1st cl. (मेहति) To sprinkle, to shed.
मिहिका: मिहिका f. (-का) Frost. E. मिह to sprinkle, aff. क्वुन्.
मिहिर: मिहिर m. (-रः) 1 The sun. 2 A sage. 3 A cloud. 4 Air, wind. 5 The moon. E. मिह to sprinkle or scatter, (radiance, &c.) Uṇādi aff. किरच्.
मिहिराण: मिहिराण m. (-णः) A name of ŚIVA. E. मिहिर the sun, अन to live, अच् aff.
मी: मी r. 1st and 10th cls. (मयति माययति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To know. (टु, ङ्) टु मीङ् r. 4th cl. (मीयते) To part with life, to die. (ञ्) मीञ् r. 9th cl. (मीनाति मीनीते) To hurt, to injure, to kill.
मीढ: मीढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Passed as urine. E. मिह to sprinkle, aff. क्त.
मीढुष्टम: मीढुष्टम m. (-मः) 1 The sun. 2 ŚIVA. 3 A thief.
मीन: मीन m. (-नः) 1 A fish. 2 The sign of the zodiac Pisces. E. मी to hurt, Uṇādi aff. नक्.
मीनकेतन: मीनकेतन m. (-नः) KĀMADEVA. E. मीन a fish, and केतन a symbol.
मीनगोधिका: मीनगोधिका f. (-का) A pond, a pool. E. मीन a fish, and गोधिका a lizard.
मीनरङ्ग: मीनरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A kingfisher. E. मीन fish, रञ्ज to annoy, aff. अच्; it is also written but perhaps incorrectly मीनरङ्क.
मीनर: मीनर m. (-रः) A marine monster, sometimes applied to the shark and alligator: see मकर. E. मीन a fish, रा to seize, aff. क.
मीनाक्षी: मीनाक्षी f. (-क्षी) The daughter of KUVERA. E. मीन a fish, and अक्षि the eye, टच् and ङीष् aff.
मीनाघातिन्: मीनाघातिन् m. (-ती) 1 A crane. 2 A fisherman. E. मीन fish, and आघातिन् who kills.
मीनाण्ड: मीनाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) Fish-spawn, roe, milt. f. (-ण्डी) Clayed or candied sugar. E. मीन a fish, and अण्ड egg, spawn, ङीष् aff., to which the last is compared.
मीनालय: मीनालय m. (-यः) The ocean. E. मीन a fish, and आलय abode.
मीनाम्रीण: मीनाम्रीण m. (-णः) 1 A wagtail. 2 A sort of sauce, fish sauce. E. मीन fish, आम्र the mango, and छ aff.
मीम: मीम(ऋ)मीमृ r. 1st cl. (मीमति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To sound.
मीमांसक: मीमांसक m. (-कः) A Mīmāṃsaka, a follower of the Mīmāṃsā philosophy. E. मीमांसा the doctrine so termed, and वुन् aff.
मीमांसा: मीमांसा f. (-सा) One of the philosophical systems of the Hindus, or rather a two-fold system, the two parts of which form two of the six Darśanas or schools of philosophy; the first part, the Pūrva Mīmāṃsā, or Mīmāṃsā simply, originates with  the Muni JAIMINI, and illustrates the Karma kāṇḍa of the Vedas, or the practical part, (the ritual,) of religion and devotion, including also moral and legal obligations. The second part, or Uttara Mīmāṃsā, ascribed to VYĀSA, is the same as the Vedānta, founded on the Jñāna-kāṇḍa or theological portion of the Vedas, and treating of the spiritual worship of the Supreme Being or soul of the universe. E. मान to seek knowledge, aff. अङ् and टाप्; the derivative takes the augment of the reduplicate form of the verb.
मीर: मीर m. (-रः) The ocean. E. मी to scatter, रक् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long.
मील: मील r. 1st cl. (मीलति) To wink or twinkle, to close or contract the eye-lids: with उत् prefixed, to awake, (and figuratively) to expand, to bud, to blossom.
मीलत्: मीलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Winking, twinkling, closing, (as the eyes.) E. मील to wink, शतृ aff.
मीलन: मीलन n. (-नं) Twinkling, blinking, winking. E. मील to twinkle, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
मीलित: मीलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Twinkled. 2 Unblown, partly opened, as a young bud, &c. n. (-तं) Indirect allusion or description, (in rhetoric.) E. मील to twinkle, aff. क्त.
मीव: मीव r. 1st cl. (मीवति) To be large or corpulent.
मीवन्: मीवन् m. (-वा) Air, wind. E. मी to move, वन् Uṇādi aff.
मीवर: मीवर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Mischievous, hurting, killing. E. मी to hurt or kill, ष्वरच् Uṇādi aff.
मीवा: मीवा f. (-वा) The worm of the intestines, Ascarides, &c. E. मी to hurt, Uṇādi aff. वा.
मु: मु m. (मुः) 1 Binding, confinement. 2 Tawny, (the colour.) 3 Eternal beatitude or final emancipation. 4 A funeral pile. E. मू to bind, aff. क्विप् or मुच to loosen, &c., aff. डु.
मुकन्दक: मुकन्दक m. (-कः) The onion; also मुकुन्दक.
मुकु: मुकु f. (-कुः) Freedom, liberation. E. मुच to let loose, कु aff.
मुकुट: मुकुट n. (-टं) A crest, a diadem, a tiara. f. (-टी) Snapping the fingers. E. मकि to adorn, aff. उट, and उ substituted for the radical vowel, form irr.; also मकुट.
मुकुन्द: मुकुन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 Gum olibanum. 3 A precious gem. 4 Quicksilver. 5 One of KUVERA'S Nidhis, or divine treasures. E. मुकु liberation, (from passion, &c.) in the second case मुकुं, and टा to give, aff. क, or मुच to liberate, or मुकु as before, उन्द to wet, to sprinkle, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.
मुकुन्दक: मुकुन्दक m. (-कः) An onion; also मुकन्दक.
मुकुन्दु: मुकुन्दु m. (-न्दुः) Gum olibanum; also मुकुन्द.
मुकुर: मुकुर m. (-रः) 1 A mirror. 2 The handle of a potter's lathe. 3 A tree, (Mimusops elengi.) 4 A bud. 5 Arabian jasmine. E. मक to adorn, उरच् Uṇādi aff., and उ optionally substituted for the radical vowel, deriv. irr.; also मकुर.
मुकुल: मुकुल mn. (-लः-लं) 1 An opening bud. 2 The body. 3 The soul or spirit. E. मुच to let loose, (the flower, &c.) उलच् aff., and च changed to क.
मुकुलित: मुकुलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Half-closed, (as a bud.) 2 Half-shut, (as the eye,) blinking, winking. E. मुकुल, and इतच् aff.
मुकुलीकृत: मुकुलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Closed, shut, (as a bud.) E. मुकुल, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.
मुकुष्ठक: मुकुष्ठक n. (-कं) A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus lobatus.) Also मकुष्ठक, &c.
मुकूलक: मुकूलक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Danti, (Croton polyandrum.) E. मकि to adorn, ऊलच् aff. कन् added, उ substituted for the radical vowel, deriv. irr.; also मकूलक.
मुक्त: मुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Released, liberated, loosed, let go. 2 Liberated from corporal existence, finally happy. 3 Discharged, loosed as a weapon; this may be in two ways, as पाणिमुक्त thrown with the hand, as a dart, &c., and यन्त्रमुक्त thrown from an instrument, as an arrow from a bow, &c. n. (-क्तं) The spirit released from mundane existence, and re-integrated with its divine original. f. (-क्ता) A pearl. E. मुच to set free, aff. क्त.
मुक्तक: मुक्तक n. (-कं) 1 Any missile weapon. 2 A stanza or sentence completing the sense of a passage. E. मुक्त loosed, let fly, and कन् added.
मुक्तकञ्चुक: मुक्तकञ्चुक m. (-कः) A snake that has cast his slough. E. मुक्त let loose, and कञ्चुक the slough of a snake.
मुक्तकण्ठम्: मुक्तकण्ठम् ind. Aloud, as shouting or crying. E. मुक्त, and कण्ठ throat.
मुक्तसङ्ग: मुक्तसङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Disinterested, free from worldly attachment or improper bias. E. मुक्त, and सङ्ग attachment.
मुक्तहस्त: मुक्तहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Parting with, giving away, liberal. 2 Loosed, let go. E. मुक्त, and हस्त the hand.
मुक्ताकलाप: मुक्ताकलाप m. (-पः) A pearl necklace, a string of pearls. E. मुक्ता a pearl, and कलाप a sort of chain.
मुक्तागार: मुक्तागार n. (-रं) The pearl oyster. E. मुक्ता a pearl, and आगार abode.
मुक्ताप्रलम्ब: मुक्ताप्रलम्ब m. (-म्बः) A pearl necklace. E. मुक्ता a pearl, and प्रलम्ब string.
मुक्ताप्रसू: मुक्ताप्रसू f. (-सूः) The pearl oyster. E. मुक्ता a pearl, and प्रसू mother, mother of pearl.
मुक्ताफल: मुक्ताफल n. (-लं) 1 Camphor. 2 A pearl. 3 A sort of fruit, the custard apple. E. मुक्ता a pearl, and फल fruit, comparable to a pearl in whiteness.
मुक्तामुक्त: मुक्तामुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Loosed, and not loosed; applied especially to weapons which may be wielded or hurled, as a club, a javelin, &c. E. मुक्त loosed, अमुक्त not loosed.
मुक्तालता: मुक्तालता f. (-ता) A pearl necklace. E. मुक्ता a pearl, and लता a creeping plant.
मुक्तावली: मुक्तावली f. (-ली) A pearl necklace. E. मुक्ता a pearl, and आवली a line, a row.
मुक्तास्फोट: मुक्तास्फोट mf. (-टः-टा) A pearl oyster. E. मुक्ता a pearl, and स्फुट to burst, aff. घञ्.
मुक्ति: मुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Final beatitude, the delivery of the soul from the body and exemption from further transmigration; the re-absorption of the emancipated spirit into its great primary source, identification with GOD. 2 Liberation, setting or becoming free or loose. E. मुघ to let loose, aff. क्तिन्.
मुक्त्वा: मुक्त्वा ind. Having set free, loose, &c. E. मुच to free, क्त्वा aff.
मुख: मुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) 1 First, initial. 2 Chief, pre-eminent, principal. n. (-खं) 1 The mouth. 2 The face. 3 The entrance to a house. 4 Commencement. 5 A means, an expedient. 6 Sound. 7 The opening division of a drama, the first act, &c. 8 The previous or preparatory incidents of a drama. 9 The Vedas. scripture. m. (-खः) The beak of a bird. E. खन to dig, Uṇādi aff. अच् with the power of ड, by which the final is rejected, मुट् initial augment.
मुखगन्धक: मुखगन्धक m. (-कः) An onion. E. मुख the mouth, and गन्धक scenting.
मुखघण्टा: मुखघण्टा f. (-ण्टा) Howling, uttering a particular cry of grief, &c. E. मुस्व the mouth, and घण्टा a bell.
मुखचपला: मुखचपला f. (-ला) A species of the Āryā metre.
मुखचीरी: मुखचीरी f. (-री) The tongue. E. मुख the mouth, and चीरी the cry or chirp of the cricket, or a cricket.
मुखज: मुखज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Derived or proceeding from the mouth, born in the mouth, &c. m. (-जः) 1 A Brahman, born from the mouth of BRAHMĀ. 2 A tooth. E. मुख the mouth, and ज born.
मुखतस्: मुखतस् ind. From the mouth. E. मुख, and तसि aff.
मुखतीय: मुखतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating or pertaining to the mouth. E. मुलतस् as above, and छ aff.
मुखदूषण: मुखदूषण m. (-णः) The onion. E. मुख the mouth, and टूषण fouling.
मुखधौता: मुखधौता f. (-ता) A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) E. मुख the mouth, and धौत cleansed, (by it.)
मुखनिवासिनी: मुखनिवासिनी f. (-नी) The goddess SARASVATĪ. E. मुख the mouth, and निवासिनी abiding; as the goddess of speech, &c.
मुखनिरीक्षक: मुखनिरीक्षक m. (-कः) An idler, a lazy man. E. मुख the face, निरीक्षक contemplating.
मुखपूरण: मुखपूरण n. (-णं) 1 A mouthful of water for rinsing the mouth 2 A mouthful. 3 Filling the mouth. E. मुख the mouth, and पूरण filling.
मुखभूषण: मुखभूषण n. (-णं) Betel, the leaf of the piper betel eaten with the Areca nut, catechu, caustic lime, &c. E. मुख the mouth, and भूषण an ornament.
मुखम्पच: मुखम्पच m. (-चः) A beggar, a petitioner. E. मुख the mouth, and पच who ripens, (his purpose,) from पच with खच् aff.
मुखयन्त्रण: मुखयन्त्रण n. (-णं) The bit of a bridle. E. मुख the mouth, and यन्त्रण restraining.
मुखर: मुखर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Foul-mouthed, speaking harshly or scurrilously. 2 Sounding, noisy. 3 Speaking in ridicule of, rallying, mocking, &c. m. (-रः) 1 A leader. 2 A conch shell. 3 Leading, preceding. 4 A crow. E. मुख the mouth, and र aff. implying depreciation, or रा to go, ड aff.
मुखरित: मुखरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounding, ringing, making a noise. E. मुखर, and इतच् aff.
मुखरीकरण: मुखरीकरण n. (-णं) Rallying, mocking. E. मुखर, and करण making, च्चि augment.
मुखलाङ्गल: मुखलाङ्गल m. (-लः) A hog. E. मुख the mouth, and लाङ्गल a plough.
मुखवाद्य: मुखवाद्य n. (-द्यं) 1 A musical instrument played with the mouth, a jew's harp(?) 2 Making a noise with the mouth by striking it with the hand, playing on the mouth. E. मुख the mouth. and वाद्य a musical instrument.
मुखवासन: मुखवासन m. (-नः) A perfume for the mouth, any drug, as camphor or orris-root so used, or a composition usually taken in the form of a pill. E. मुख the mouth, and वासन perfuming.
मुखविष्ठा: मुखविष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) A cockroach. E. मुख the mouth, and विष्ठा fæces.
मुखव्यादान: मुखव्यादान n. (-नं) Opening the mouth wide. E. मुख, with वि and आङ् prefixed to दा to give, ल्युट् aff.
मुखशफ: मुखशफ mfn. (-फः-फा-फं) Foul-mouthed, scurrilous. E. मुख the mouth, and शफ a hoof.
मुखशोधन: मुखशोधन m. (-नः) Pungency, sharp or pungent flavour n. (-नं) Cleaning the mouth. E. मुख the mouth, and शोधन cleansing.
मुखशोधिन्: मुखशोधिन् m. (-धी) The lime or citron. E. मुख the mouth, and शोधिन् what cleanses.
मुखसम्भव: मुखसम्भव m. (-वः) A Brahman. E. मुख the mouth, (of BRAHMĀ,) and सम्भव born.
मुखसुर: मुखसुर n. (-रं) The moisture of the lips. E. मुख the mouth, and सुरा spirituous liquor, टच् aff.
मुखस्राव: मुखस्राव m. (-वः) Spittle, saliva. E. मुख the mouth, स्रु to drop, aff. अण्.
मुखाग्नि: मुखाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) 1 The conflagration of a forest. 2 A sort of goblin with a face of fire. 3 Fire put into the mouth of the corpse at the time of lighting the funeral pile. 4 A sacrificial or consecrated fire. E. मुच mouth, face, or chief, principal, and अग्नि fire.
मुखास्त्र: मुखास्त्र m. (-स्त्रः) A crab. E. मुख the mouth, and अस्त्र a weapon.
मुखोल्का: मुखोल्का f. (-ल्का) Fire in a forest. E. मुख face or mouth, and उल्का flame.
मुख्य: मुख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Chief, primary, principal. n. (-ख्यं) 1 A principal or essential rite or ordinance. 2 Reading or teaching the Vedas. 3 The month when reckoned from new moon to new moon. E. मुख chief, य aff.
मुख्यता: मुख्यता f. (-ता) Pre-eminence, being best or chief. E. मुख्य, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, मुख्यत्वं.
मुख्यशस्: मुख्यशस् ind. Principally, particularly. E. मुख्य, and शसि aff.
मुग्ध: मुग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) 1 Lovely, beautiful. 2 Stupid, ignorant, an idiot, a fool. 3 Simple, silly. f. (-ग्धा) A young and lovely female. E. मुह to be foolish, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
मुग्धता: मुग्धता f. (-ता) 1 Loveliness. 2 Ignorance, stupidity. 3 Simplicity. E. मुग्ध, and तल् added; also मुग्धत्वं.
मुग्धानन: मुग्धानन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Lovely-faced. E. मुग्ध, and आनन face.
मुच: मुच(ऌ औ) औ मुचॢ r. 6th cl. (मुञ्चति-ते) 1 To be loose or free. 2 To forsake or abandon. r. 10th cl. (मोचयति) 1 To let loose, to let go, to discharge as arrows, to part with, as wealth, &c. 2 To gladden, to delight. (मोचते) To deceive, to cheat. (इ) मुचि r. 1st cl. (मुंचते) 1 To be vain or proud. 2 To be wicked. 3 To speak. 4 To grind or pound. 5 To cheat, to deceive. With प्र, To give much. With वि, 1 To obtain liberation. 2 To give or bestow. 3 To lose.
मुचक: मुचक m. (-कः) Lac, the dye. E. मुच to loosen, aff. क्वुन्.
मुचिर: मुचिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Munificent, generous, liberal in giving, a donor, a giver. E. मुच to let loose, to part with wealth, and किरच् Uṇādi aff.
मुचुटी: मुचुटी f. (-टी) 1 Snapping the fingers. 2 The
मुज: मुज r. 1st cl. (मोजति मोजयति) also (इ,) मुजि (मुञ्जति मुञ्जयति) To sound.
मुञ्चत्: मुञ्चत् mfn. (ञ्चन्-ञ्चन्ती-ञ्चत्) 1 Letting go or loose. 2 Shooting, discharging. E. मुच to let go, शतृ aff.
मुञ्ज: मुञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) 1 A sort of grass, from the fibres of which a string is prepared, of which the triple thread worn by the Brahman as a girdle should be formed, (Saccharum munja, Rox.) 2 The Brahmanical girdle, or in common use, the sacred string or cord. 3 An arrow. E. मुजि to sound, aff. अच्.
मुञ्जकेश: मुञ्जकेश m. (-शः) VIṢṆU. E. मुञ्ज a sort of grass, and केश hair.
मुञ्जकेशिन्: मुञ्जकेशिन् m. (-शी) VIṢṆU. E. मुञ्ज the plant, केश hair, and इनि aff.
मुञ्जबन्धन: मुञ्जबन्धन n. (-नं) Investiture with the girdle or with the Brahmanical cord. E. मुञ्ज, and बन्धन binding.
मुञ्जर: मुञ्जर n. (-रं) The fibrous root of a lotus. E. मुञ्ज a sort of grass, रा to go or resemble, aff. क.
मुट: मुट r. 1st cl. (मोटति) 6th cl. (मुटति); and 10th cl. (मोटयति); also (इ) मुटि r. 1st. cl. (मुण्टति) 1 To rub, to press, to grind or pound, to reduce to powder. 2 To break down, to trample on. 6th cl. (मुटति) To reprove, to rebuke, to blame.
मुठ: मुठ(इ)मुठि r. 1st cl. (मुंठति) 1 To guard, to protect, to defend or cherish. 2 To fly, to run away.
मुड: मुड r. 6th cl. (मुडति) 1 To quit, to leave. 2 To clothe or cover. (इ) मुडि r. 1st cl. (मुण्डते) 1 To be pure or clean. 2 To cleanse. 3 To sink, (as in water.) 4 To sink, (in estimation,) to be despised or disregarded. (मुण्डति) 5 To shave or cut. 6 To grind or pound.
मुण: मुण r. 6th cl. (मुणति) To vow or promise.
मुण्ड: मुण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) 1 Shaved, bald, having no hair on the head. 2 Low, mean. mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) 1 The head. 2 The forehead. m. (-ण्डः) 1 A bald pate. 2 A barber. 3 The name of a Daitya or demon. 4 RĀHU, the personified ascending node. 5 The trunk of a lopped tree. f. (-ण्डा) Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) E. मुडि to shave or cut, aff. घञ्.
मुण्डक: मुण्डक m. (-कः) A barber. n. (-कं) The head. E. मुडि to shave, aff. वुन्, or मुण्ड the head, कन् pleonasm.
मुण्डचणक: मुण्डचणक m. (-कः) A kind of pulse.
मुण्डन: मुण्डन n. (-नं) Shaving, shearing, outing. E. मुडि to shave or cut, aff. ल्युट्.
मुण्डफल: मुण्डफल m. (-लः) The cocoanut tree. E. मुण्ड the head, and फल, fruit; the fruit being one step towards a human head, made by VIŚVĀMITRA, when he purposed establishing an opposition creation to that of BRAHMĀ.
मुण्डमण्डली: मुण्डमण्डली f. (-ली) 1 A number of shaven heads. 2 A mass of troops of an inferior description. E. मुण्ड, and मण्डली a circle.
मुण्डशालि: मुण्डशालि m. (-लिः) A kind of grain or rice.
मुण्डित: मुण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bald, shorn, shaven. E. मुण्ड bald, इतच् aff.
मुण्डितशिरस्: मुण्डितशिरस् mfn. (-राः-राः-रः) Bald-pated, shaven-headed. E. मुण्डित, and शिरस् the head.
मुण्डितिका: मुण्डितिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Muṇḍīrī.
मुण्डिन्: मुण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी) A barber. E. मुण्ड shaving, aff. इनि.
मुण्डीरिका: मुण्डीरिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Muṇḍīrī.
मुण्डीरी: मुण्डीरी f. (-री) A plant, described as a creeper, bearing a red and yellow flower, and commonly called by the same name, Muṇḍīrī.
मुथ: मुथ(इ,)मुथि r. 1st cl. (मुन्थति) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To suffer pain.
मुद: मुद r. 1st cl. (मोदते) To rejoice, to be glad. r. 10th cl. (मोदयति) To mix, to blend, to unite.
मुद्: मुद् f. (मुद् मुत्) 1 Pleasure, delight, joy. 2 Intoxication, phrensy. 3 A wife. E. मुद to be pleased, aff. क्विप्.
मुदा: मुदा f. (-दा) Happiness, joy. E. मुद to be happy, अङ् and टाप् affs.
मुदान्वित: मुदान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pleased, happy. E. मुदा, and अन्वित possessed of.
मुदित: मुदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pleased, delighted. n. (-तं) Pleasure, happiness. E. मुद to rejoice, aff. क्त.
मुदिर: मुदिर m. (-रः) 1 A cloud. 2 A lover, a libertine. E. मुद to be pleased, Uṇādi aff. किरच्.
मुदी: मुदी f. (-दी) Moonlight. E. मुद to please, affs. क and ङीष्.
मुद्ग: मुद्ग m. (-द्गः) 1 A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus mungo.) 2 A cover, as a lid or cloth, E. मुदि to please, Uṇādi aff. ग.
मुद्गपर्णी: मुद्गपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus trilobus.) E. मुद्ग P. mungo, पर्ण a leaf, ङीष् aff.
मुद्गभुज्: मुद्गभुज् m. (-भुक्) A horse. E. मुद्ग kidney-bean, and भुज् who eats; also मुद्गभोजिन् m. (-जी)
मुद्गर: मुद्गर m. (-रः) 1 A mallet, a mace, a weapon formed like a carpenter's hammer. 2 A staff, armed with iron, and larger at the lower extremity, used for breaking clods of earth, &c. 3 A carpenter's hammer. 4 A sort of flower, said to be a kind of jasmine, perhaps Jasminum zambac, the wild variety. E. मुट् pleasure, गॄ to swallow or destroy, aff. अच्; also with र changed to ल, मुद्गल.
मुद्गष्ठ: मुद्गष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus lobatus.) E. मुद्ग P. mungo, स्था to stay, to resemble, aff. क; also with कन् added, मुद्गष्ठक.
मुद्रा: मुद्रा f. (-द्रा) 1 A seal, a signet. 2 A seal ring. 3 The mark of a seal or similar impression, a stamp, a print, &c. 4 A mode of intertwining the fingers during religious worship. E. मुद to please, (by it,) Uṇādi aff. रक्.
मुद्राङ्कित: मुद्राङ्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stamped, sealed. f. (-ता) A mint. E. मुद्रा a seal, and अङ्कित marked.
मुद्रिका: मुद्रिका f. (-का) A sealed or signed paper. E. मुद्र a seal, and कन् aff., fem. form.
मुद्रित: मुद्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sealed. 2 Marked, struck, stamped. 3 Contracted, closed, sealed up. 4 Unblown, (as a flower.) E. मुद्रा a seal, and इतच् aff.
मुधा: मुधा ind. In vain, uselessly, unprofitably, idly. E. मुह to be foolish, aff. का, and ह changed to ध.
मुनि: मुनि m. (-निः) 1 A holy sage, a pious and learned person, endowed with more or less of a divine nature, or having attained it by rigid abstraction and mortification; the title is applied to the Ṛṣis, the Brahmādikas, and to a great number of persons distinguished for their writings, considered as inspired, as PĀṆINI, VYĀSA, &c. 2 An ascetic, a devotee. 3 An Arhat or Jaina deified teacher. 4 The saint AGASTYA. 5 The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) 6 Another tree, (Buchanania latifolia.) E. मन to be revered, Uṇādi aff. इन्, and उ substituted for the radical vowel.
मुनिद्रुम: मुनिद्रुम m. (-मः) A tree, (Æschynomene grandiflora.) E. मुनि the saint AGASTYA, and द्रुम a tree.
मुनिपित्तल: मुनिपित्तल n. (-लं) Copper. E. मुनि a devotee, and पित्तल brass.
मुनिपुङ्गव: मुनिपुङ्गव m. (-वः) A pre-eminent sage. E. मुनि a sage, and पुङ्गव (in composition) pre-eminent.
मुनिपुत्त्रक: मुनिपुत्त्रक m. (-कः) A wagtail. E. मुनि a sage, पुत्त्र a child, and कन् aff. of comparison.
मुनिपूग: मुनिपूग m. (-गः) A kind of Areca, (A. triandra, or gracilis, Rox.) E. मुनि a sage, and पूग the Areca.
मुनिभेषज: मुनिभेषज n. (-जं) 1 Fasting. 2 The fruit of the yellow myrobalan. 3 The saint AGASTYA. E. मुनि a sage and भेषज a drug or medicament.
मुनिसुव्रत: मुनिसुव्रत m. (-तः) The twentieth Jina or Jaina pontiff of the present era.
मुनिस्थान: मुनिस्थान n. (-नं) A hermitage, the abode or retirement of holy sages. E. मुनि an ascetic, and स्थान a place.
मुनीन्द्र: मुनीन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A superior Muni or sage. 2 A Buddha, a Bauddha sage or teacher. E. मुनि a sage, and इन्द्र chief.
मुन्यन्न: मुन्यन्न n. (-न्नं) Wild grain, roots, fruit, &c. E. मुनि a hermit, and अन्न food.
मुमुक्षु: मुमुक्षु m. (-क्षुः) 1 A sage, abstracted from all human passion and feeling, and preparing himself for eternal emancipation. 2 Any one anxious for liberation, especially from mundane existence. E. मुच to liberate, in the desiderative form, उ aff.
मुमुषिषु: मुमुषिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to steal. E. मुष to steal, desid. v., उ aff.
मुमुषिषुवत्: मुमुषिषुवत् ind. Like a thief. E. मुमु, and षिषुवति aff.
मुमूर्षा: मुमूर्षा f. (-र्षा) Wish to die, impatience of life. E. मृ to die, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
मुमूर्षु: मुमूर्षु m. (-र्षुः) A man at the point of death, a dying man. E. मृ to die, desiderative or expectative form, and उ aff.
मुर: मुर r. 6th cl. (मुरति) To encircle, to entwine, to bind together.
मुर m. (-रः) The name of a DAITYA killed by VIṢṆU. f. (-रा) A vegetable perfume. (-रं) Surrounding, encircling. E. मुर to encircle, aff. क, or अङ् and टाप् fem. aff.
मुर्: मुर् f. (-मूः) Fainting. E. मुर्च्छ to faint, aff. क्विप्, and the छ rejected after र.
मुरज: मुरज m. (-जः) A small drum, a tabor. f. (-जा) 1 The wife of KUVERA. 2 A large drum. E. मुर encircling, with wood, &c., and ज born, made.
मुरजफल: मुरजफल m. (-लः) The jack fruit tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.)
मुरण्ड: मुरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A country on the north-west of Hindustan, called also Lampaka, and now Lamgan. m. plu. (-ण्डाः) The inhabitants of Lamgan.
मुरद: मुरद m. (-दः) The conch of VIṢṆU. E. मुर a demon, दो to cut, (to alarm,) aff. ड.
मुरमण्ड: मुरमण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Pimples on the face.
मुररिपु: मुररिपु m. (-पुः) A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. E. मुर the demon, and रिपु enemy.
मुरली: मुरली f. (-ली) A flute, a pipe. E. मुर surrounding, ला to get or have, aff. क and ङीष्.
मुरलीधर: मुरलीधर m. (-रः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. मुरली a flute, and धर who holds.
मुरहन्: मुरहन् m. (-हा) A name of VIṢṆU. E. मुर the demon, and हन् slayer.
मुरारि: मुरारि m. (-रिः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. मुर the demon, and अरि the foe.
मुर्च्छ: मुर्च्छ(आ,)मुर्च्छा r. 1st cl. (मूर्च्छति) 1 To be faint, to lose consciousness or perception. 2 To increase, to grow.
मुर्भिणी: मुर्भिणी f. (-णी) A small fire place or fire pan.
मुर्मुर: मुर्मुर m. (-रः) 1 A name of KĀMA or CUPID. 2 A fire of chaff. 3 One of the horses of the sun.
मुर्व: मुर्व(ई)मुर्व्वी r. 1st cl. (मुर्वति) To bind, to tie.
मुल: मुल r. 10th cl. (मोलयति) To plant: more usually मूल.
मुशटी: मुशटी f. (-टी) A kind of panick seed, (Panicum italicum,) described as a white variety.
मुशली: मुशली f. (-ली) A small house lizard: see मुषली; also with कन added, मुशलिका f. (-का.)
मुष: मुष r. 1st cl. (मोषति) r. 9th cl. (मुष्णाति) To steal, to rob, to plunder. r. 4th cl. (मुष्यति) 1 To cut, to divide, to break. 2 To steal.
मुषक: मुषक m. (-कः) A rat: see मूषक.
मुषल: मुषल m. (-लः) 1 A club, a mace. 2 A pestle for cleaning rice. f. (-ली) 1 A house lizard. 2 A plant, (Curculigo orchioides:) see मुशली, मुसल, and मुसली.
मुषलामुषलि: मुषलामुषलि ind. Club to club, (fighting, &c.) E. मुषल repeated, and इच् added; also मुसलामुमली.
मुषल्य: मुषल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Meriting pounding to death: see मुसल्य.
मुषा: मुषा f. (-षा) A crucible. E. मुष to steal, aff. अङ् and टाप्, also मूषा.
मुषित: मुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stolen, robbed. E. मुष to steal, a. क्त.
मुष्क: मुष्क m. (-ष्कः) 1 The scrotum. 2 The testicle. 3 A heap, a quantity. 4 A thief. 5 A stout man. 6 A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpārali. E. मुष to steal, (semen, &c.) कक् aff.
मुष्कक: मुष्कक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpārali. E. मुष्क a thief, (of disease,) and कन् added.
मुष्कद्वय: मुष्कद्वय n. (-यं) The testicles. E. मुष्क, and द्वय pair.
मुष्कर: मुष्कर m. (-रः) A man with large testicles. E. मुष्क testicle, and रच् aff.
मुष्कशून्य: मुष्कशून्य m. (-न्यः) A eunuch, a guard of the women's apartments. E. मुष्क testicle, and शून्य wanting.
मुष्ट: मुष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Theft, robbery. E. मुष to steal, aff. क्त, form irr.
मुष्टि: मुष्टि mf. (-ष्टिः-ष्टी) 1 The fist, the closed hand. 2 The hilt or handle of a sword, &c. 3 A handful or Pala, the initiatory measure in the tables of the measures of grain. 4 Filching, stealing. E. मुष to steal or take, aff. क्तिन्.
मुष्टिक: मुष्टिक m. (-कः) A goldsmith. E. मुष्टि stealing, and कृ to make, aff. ड.
मुष्टिकान्तक: मुष्टिकान्तक m. (-कः) A name of BALADEVA the brother of KṚṢṆA.
मुष्टिद्यूत: मुष्टिद्यूत n. (-तं) A kind of game, odd or even. E. मुष्टि the fist, and द्यूत gaming.
मुष्टिन्धम: मुष्टिन्धम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Who blows in or on his closed fists. E. मुष्टि, and ध्मा to breathe, aff. खच्.
मुष्टिन्धय: मुष्टिन्धय m. (-यः) A child. E. मुष्टि the fist, and धे to drink or suck, aff. खश्.
मुष्टिपात: मुष्टिपात m. (-तः) Pummelling, boxing. E. मुष्टि, and पात falling.
मुष्टिबन्ध: मुष्टिबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Clenching the fist. E. मुष्टि the fist, and बन्ध binding.
मुष्टिसंग्राहपीडित: मुष्टिसंग्राहपीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Squeezed, pressed, griped. E. मुष्टि, सङ्ग्राह taking, पीडित squeezed.
मुष्टीमुष्टि: मुष्टीमुष्टि ind. Fist to fist, (fighting,) fisticuffs. E. मुष्टि repeated in this sense, and the first final made long.
मुष्णत्: मुष्णत् mfn. (-ष्णन्-ष्णन्ती-ष्णत्) 1 Stealing, robbing. 2 Depriving of. 3 Obscuring, eclipsing. E. मुष to steal, शतृ aff.
मुस: मुस(इर)मुसिर r. 4th cl. (मुस्यति) To divide, to cut or break to pieces.
मुसल: मुसल n. (-लं) 1 A pestle, a wooden pestle used for cleaning rice. 2 A club. f. (-ली) 1 A plant, (Curculigo orchioides.) 2 A house lizard. E. मुस to break, aff. कलच्; it is also read with its compounds and derivatives मुषल, मुषली, and sometimes मुशल, &c.
मुसलिन्: मुसलिन् m. (-ली) A name of BALARĀMA. E. मुसल a pestle, or pestle-like club, used by him as a weapon, and इनि aff.
मुसल्य: मुसल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Deserving death by pounding with a pestle. E. मुसल a pestle, and यत् aff.
मुस्त: मुस्त r. 10th cl. (मुस्तयति) To accumulate, to collect, to heap together.
मुस्त mf. (-स्तः-स्ता) A sort of grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. मुस्त to accumulate, aff. अच्.
मुस्तक: मुस्तक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 2 A sort of poison. E. मुस्त to accumulate, ण्वुल् aff.
मुस्ताद: मुस्ताद m. (-दः) A hog. E. मुस्ता Cyperus, and अद who eats.
मुस्तु: मुस्तु m. (-स्तुः) The fist. E. मुस to break, तुन् aff.
मुस्र: मुस्र n. (-स्रं) A pestle. E. मुस to divide, Uṇādi aff. रक्.
मुह: मुह r. 4th cl. (ऊ) मुहू (मुह्यति) To be foolish, to be incapable of discrimination or judgment, to be bereft of sense or wisdom.
मुहिर: मुहिर m. (-रः) 1 Love, desire, KĀMADEVA. 2 A fool, a blockhead. E. मुह to grow foolish, Uṇādi aff. किरच्.
मुहुर्भाषा: मुहुर्भाषा f. (-षा) Tautology, repetition. E. मुहुस् repeatedly, and भाषा speech.
मुहुस्: मुहुस् ind. Repeatedly, reiteratedly, again and again. E. मुह to be foolish, Uṇādi aff. उसि.
मुहूर्त: मुहूर्त्त mn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्तं) A division of time, the thirtieth part of a day and night, or an hour of forty-eight minutes. m. (-र्त्तः) An astrologer. E. हुर्च्छ to be crooked or fraudulent, क्त aff., form irr., and मुक् initiatory augment.
मुहूर्त्त: मुहूर्त्त mn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्तं) A division of time, the thirtieth part of a day and night, or an hour of forty-eight minutes. m. (-र्त्तः) An astrologer. E. हुर्च्छ to be crooked or fraudulent, क्त aff., form irr., and मुक् initiatory augment.
मुहेर: मुहेर m. (-रः) A fool, a blockhead, an ignoramus. E. मुह to be foolish, एरक् Uṇādi aff.
मू: मू r. 1st cl. (मवते) To bind, to tie, to make fast.
मू f. (-मूः) Binding, tying. E. मू to tie, aff. क्विप्.
मूक: मूक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Dumb. m. (-कः) 1 A fish. 2 A demon. 3 A pauper. E. मू imitative sound, and कै to utter, aff. क, or मू to bind, कक् aff.
मूढ: मूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Foolish, ignorant. 2 Cold, apathetic, stupid. 3 Perplexed, in doubt. 4 Deceived, erring. m. (-ढः) 1 An idiot, a fool. 2 A sluggard. E. मुह to be foolish, aff. क्त, form irr.
मूढगर्भ: मूढगर्भ m. (-र्भः) 1 A bad presentation of the child at birth, causing difficult delivery. 2 A dead foetus. E. मूढ, and गर्भ the foetus.
मूढग्राह: मूढग्राह m. (-हः) Infatuation. E. मूढ, and ग्राह seizure.
मूढचेतस्: मूढचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) Insane, bewildered. E. मूढ and चेतस् mind.
मूढता: मूढता f. (-ता) Folly, silliness, ignorance. E. मूढ, and तल् aff.; also मूढत्वं.
मूढात्मन्: मूढात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Foolish, a fool. E. मूढ, and आत्मन् self.
मूत: मूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bound, tied. E. मू to bind, aff. क्त.
मूत्र: मूत्र r. 10th cl. (मूत्रयति) To urine, to make water.
मूत्र n. (-त्रं) Urine, piss. E. मूत्र to piss, घञ् aff., or मुच to loose, Uṇādi aff. त्रन्, and ऊ substituted for the vowel.
मूत्रकृच्छ्र: मूत्रकृच्छ्र n. (-च्छ्रं) 1 Strangury. 2 Unrinary affection in general, as gravel, &c. E. मूत्र urine, and कृच्छ्र pain.
मूत्रदोष: मूत्रदोष m. (-षः) Gonorrhoea, considered as an urinary complaint. E. मूत्र urine, and दोष fault.
मूत्रपुट: मूत्रपुट n. (-टं) The lower belly. E. मूत्र urine, and पुट to be shallow, aff. क.
मूत्रग्रन्थि: मूत्रग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) Obstruction at the neck of the bladder. E. मूत्र, and ग्रन्थि knot.
मूत्रमार्ग: मूत्रमार्ग m. (-र्गः) The urethra. E. मूत्र, and मार्ग passage.
मूत्रल: मूत्रल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Diuretic. mf. (-लः-ला) A cucumber. E. मूत्र urine, and लच् aff.
मूत्रशुक्र: मूत्रशुक्र n. (-क्रं) Milky urine, depositing a thick white sediment. E. मूत्र, and शक्र semen, which is supposed to give the colour.
मूत्रसङ्ग: मूत्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Urinary obstruction. E. मूत्र, and सङ्ग being with.
मूत्राघात: मूत्राघात m. (-तः) Suppression of urine. E. मूत्र, and आधात impediment.
मूत्रातीत: मूत्रातीत m. (-तः) Difficult or slow passage of urine. E. मूत्र, and अतीत passed.
मूत्राशय: मूत्राशय m. (-यः) 1 The bladder. 2 The lower belly, the pubic region. E. मूत्र urine, and आशय place.
मूत्रित: मूत्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pissed, voided as urine. E. मूत्र to urine aff. क्त.
मूत्रोत्सङ्ग: मूत्रोत्सङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Obstructed or tardy flow of urine, discharge of it mixed with blood, &c. E. मूत्र, and उत्सङ्ग adhesion.
मूर्ख: मूर्ख mfn. (-र्खः-र्खा-र्खं) Foolish, ignorant, stupid, idiotic. m. (-र्खः) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus radiatus.) E. मूर्ख substituted for मुह to be foolish, aff. अच्, or मुर substituted for the root, with ख Uṇādi aff.
मूर्खभ्रातृक: मूर्खभ्रातृक m. (-कः) The brother of a fool. E. मूर्ख a fool, भ्रातृ a brother, and कप् aff.
मूर्च्छत्: मूर्च्छत् mfn. (-र्च्छन्-र्च्छन्ती-र्च्छत्) Fainting, swooning. E. मुर्च्छ to faint, शतृ aff.
मूर्च्छन: मूर्च्छन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Fainting, syncope, swooning. 2 Mixing, meeting. 3 A tone or semitone as placed in its scale, the seventh part of a Grāma or scale. 4 Calcining quicksilver with sulphur, &c. E. मुर्च्छ to faint, to become insensible, aff. ल्युट्.
मूर्च्छा: मूर्च्छा f. (-र्च्छा) Fainting, loss of consciousness or sense. E. मुर्च्छा to be faint, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
मूर्च्छाल: मूर्च्छाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fainted, fainting, insensible. E. मूर्च्छा fainting, (the act,) and लच् aff.
मूर्च्छावत्: मूर्च्छावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Faint. E. मूर्च्छा, and मतुप् aff.
मूर्च्छित: मूर्च्छित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fainting, fainted, insensible. 2 Stupid, ignorant. 3 Tall, lofty. 4 Grown, increased, augmented. E. मुर्च्छ to be faint, to grow or increase, &c., aff. क्त, or मूर्च्छा as above, इतच् aff.
मूर्ण: मूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Bound, tied. E. मुर्व्व to bind, aff. क्त; form irr.
मूर्त: मूर्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) 1 Fainting, fainted, losing sense or consciousness. 2 Solid, material, endowed with form or shape. E. मुर्च्छ to lose consciousness, aff. क्त, form irr.
मूर्त्त: मूर्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) 1 Fainting, fainted, losing sense or consciousness. 2 Solid, material, endowed with form or shape. E. मुर्च्छ to lose consciousness, aff. क्त, form irr.
मूर्ति: मूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Matter, substance, solidity. 2 The body. 3 Figure, form, body in general, or any definite shape or image. E. मुर्च्छ to faint, to become insensible, aff. क्तिन्, form irr.
मूर्त्ति: मूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Matter, substance, solidity. 2 The body. 3 Figure, form, body in general, or any definite shape or image. E. मुर्च्छ to faint, to become insensible, aff. क्तिन्, form irr.
मूर्तिमत्: मूर्त्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Material, substantial, having shape or substance. 2 Incarnate. n. (-मत्) The body. E. मूर्त्ति shape, &c., मतुप् poss. aff.
मूर्त्तिमत्: मूर्त्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Material, substantial, having shape or substance. 2 Incarnate. n. (-मत्) The body. E. मूर्त्ति shape, &c., मतुप् poss. aff.
मूर्द्धक: मूर्द्धक m. (-कः) The man of the second or military class. E. मूर्द्ध the head, and कन् aff.
मूर्द्धकर्प्परी: मूर्द्धकर्प्परी f. (-री) An umbrella, or inverted basket carried on the head for the same purpose. E. मूर्द्धं the head, कर्प्पर a sort of pan, and ङीष् aff.
मूर्द्धखोल: मूर्द्धखोल n. (-लं) A sort of umbrella: see the last. E. मूर्द्ध the head, खोल or खोलक a helmet.
मूर्द्धज: मूर्द्धज m. (-जः) Hair, the hair of the head. E. मूर्द्ध the head, and ज born.
मूर्द्धन्: मूर्द्धन् m. (-र्द्धा) The head. E. मुह to be foolish, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, form irr., or मुर्व्व to bind, the same aff., धङ् augment.
मूर्द्धपुष्प: मूर्द्धपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A tree, commonly Siris, (Mimosa sirisha.) E. मूर्द्धं the head, and पुष्प flower.
मूर्द्धरस: मूर्द्धरस m. (-सः) The scum of boiled rice, &c. E. मूर्द्ध head, top, and रस juice.
मूर्द्धवेष्टन: मूर्द्धवेष्टन n. (-नं) A turban, a fillet, a diadem, &c. E. मूर्द्ध the head, and वेष्टन surrounding.
मूर्द्धाभिषिक्त: मूर्द्धाभिषिक्त m. (-क्तः) 1 A man of the second or military class, the Kṣatriya or soldier. 2 A king, a prince. 3 A chief minister, a counsellor of state. 4 The name of a mixed class, sprung from a Brahman, and female of the second or Kṣatriya tribe; the principal of the mixed races, and soldier by profession. E. मूर्द्ध the head, and अभिषिक्त sprinkled, anointed; kings being consecrated by having poured on their heads, while seated on a throne prepared for the purpose, water from some sacred stream, mixed with honey, clarified butter, and spirituous liquor, as well as two sorts of grass and the sprouts of corn: the term applies to the Kṣatriya as identified with the king, the duties of royalty, belonging especially, to the military caste.
मूर्द्ध्वन्: मूर्द्ध्वन् m. (-र्द्ध्वा) 1 The head. 2 The base, (in geometry.) E. मुर्व्व to bind, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, and ध्वङ् substituted for the radical final.
मूर्वा: मूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा-र्व्वी) A sort of creeper, from the fibres of which bowstrings are made, (Sanseviera zeylanica;) they should also form the girdle worn by the Kṣatriya class. E. मुर्व्व to bind, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
मूर्व्वा: मूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा-र्व्वी) A sort of creeper, from the fibres of which bowstrings are made, (Sanseviera zeylanica;) they should also form the girdle worn by the Kṣatriya class. E. मुर्व्व to bind, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
मूल: मूल r. 1st cl. (मूलति-ते) To stand, to be rooted or firm. r. 10th cl. (मूलयति) 1 To plant or transplant. 2 To grow as a plant, to sprout, to shoot or germinate. With उद् prefixed, to root up or out, to eradicate, to exterminate.

मूल n. (-लं) 1 A root, the root of a tree, &c. 2 Origin, commencement. 3 Capital, principal. 4 Near, proximate. 5 Own, peculiar, proper. 6 The root of the Arum campanulatum. 7 The original text of any work, as opposed to the Ṭīkā or comment. mn. (-लः-लं) The nineteenth lunar asterism, containing eleven stars, which appear to be the same as those in the SCORPION'S tail. f. (-ली) A small house lizard. E. मूल to stand, to be rooted or firm, aff. क, or मू to bind, Uṇādi aff. क्ल.
मूलक: मूलक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 The radish, (Raphanus sativus.) 2 A large, sort of yam. m. (-कः) A sort of poison. E. मूल a root, कन् added.
मूलकपण: मूलकपण m. (-णः) A handful of radishes, &c. for sale. E. मूलक, and पण measure.
मूलकमूला: मूलकमूला f. (-ला) A plant, commonly Kṣīrakākolī.
मूलकर्मन्: मूलकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Magic. E. मूल original or essential, and कर्म्मन् act.
मूलकर्म्मन्: मूलकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Magic. E. मूल original or essential, and कर्म्मन् act.
मूलकारिका: मूलकारिका f. (-का) A fire place. E. मूल primary, (work,) and कारिका an agent.
मूलकृच्छ्र: मूलकृच्छ्र n. (-च्छ्रं) A sort of penance, subsisting for a given time on the roots of plants only. E. मूल a root, and कृच्छ्र penance.
मूलखानक: मूलखानक m. (-कः) A digger for roots. E. मूल, and खानक a digger.
मूलज: मूलज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born from a root, &c. m. (-जः) A plant growing from a root, as a lotus, &c. E. मूल a root, and ज born.
मूलदेव: मूलदेव m. (-वः) A name of KAṂSA, the uncle of KṚṢṆA. E. मूल original, and देव a deity; the incarnation of a demi-god.
मूलद्रव्य: मूलद्रव्य n. (-व्यं) Capital, principal, stock. E. मूल capital, and द्रव्य substance.
मूलधन: मूलधन n. (-नं) Capital, principal, stock. E. मूल capital, and धन wealth.
मूलभद्र: मूलभद्र m. (-द्रः) A name of KAṂSA, the uncle of KṚṢṆA. E. मूल origin, and भद्र auspicious.
मूलभृत्य: मूलभृत्य m. (-त्यः) An old or hereditary servant. E. मूल, and भृत्य dependant.
मूलविभुज: मूलविभुज m. (-जः) A car, a carriage. E. मूल the root, (the axle,) and विभुज what bends.
मूलशाकट: मूलशाकट mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) Fit or cultivated for esculent roots, (as the arum, the radish, and others, a field, &c.) E. मूल a root, and शाकट aff.; also with शाकिन aff. मूलशाकिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
मूलस्थान: मूलस्थान n. (-नं) 1 Ether, heaven, space or atmosphere. 2 GOD. f. (-नी) GAURĪ. E. मूल primary origin, &c., and स्थान place, abode.
मूलिक: मूलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Radical, (literal or figurative,) primary, principal. m. (-कः) A devotee, living on roots. E. मूल a root, ठक् aff.
मूलिन्: मूलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Having a root, stock, origin, &c. m. (-ली) A tree. E. मूल a root, aff. इनि.
मूलेर: मूलेर m. (-रः) Indian spikenard. E. मूल to be rooted, Uṇādi aff. एरक्.
मूल्य: मूल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 1 To be eradicated, to be pulled or plucked up by the root. 2 To be bent from the root, &c. 3 To be bought, purchasable. 4 To be bought for a fair or just price. n. (-ल्यं) 1 Price. 2 Wages, hire. 3 An article purchased. E. मूल principal, and यत् aff.
मूष: मूष r. 1st cl. (मूषति) To steal, to rob or plunder.
मूष mf. (-षः-षी-षं) 1 A rat, a mouse. 2 A crucible. f. (-षा) A sort of grass, (Andropogon serratum.) E. मूष to steal, aff. क.
मूषक: मूषक mf. (-कः-का-षिका) 1 A mouse, a rat. 2 A thief. E. कन् added to the last.
मूषकाराति: मूषकाराति m. (-तिः) A cat. E. मूषक a rat, and अराति enemy.
मूषण: मूषण n. (-णं) Stealing, pilfering. E. मूष to steal, ल्युट् aff.
मूषत्: मूषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Stealing, plundering. E. मूष, and शतृ aff.
मूषाकर्णी: मूषाकर्णी f. (-र्णी) An aquatic plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) E. मूषा a rat, कर्ण the ear; to which the leaf of the plant is compared, fem. aff. ङीष्; also मूषिकपर्णी.
मूषातुत्थ: मूषातुत्थ n. (-त्थं) Blue vitriol. E. मूषा a crucible, and तुत्थ sulphate of copper.
मूषिक: मूषिक mf. (-कः-का) A rat, a mouse. m. (-कः) 1 A tree, commonly Siris, (Mimosa sirisha.) 2 A thief, a plunderer. 3 A country, the part of the Malabar coast between Quilon and Cape Comorin. f. (-का) 1 A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) 2 A crucible. E. मूष to steal, Uṇādi aff. किनन्, and the vowel made long; also मूषिका, and मूषा, मूषी.
मूषिकपर्णी: मूषिकपर्णी f. (-र्णी) An aquatic plant of the cryptogamia class (Salvinia cucullata.) E. मूषिक a rat, (ears, understood,) and पर्णी a leaf, aff. ङीष्, having a leaf compared to a mouse's ear.
मूषिकाङ्क: मूषिकाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. मूषिक a rat, and अङ्क a mark or emblem; being usually painted riding on a rat or attended by one.
मूषिकाञ्चन: मूषिकाञ्चन m. (-नः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. मूषिक a rat, and अञ्चन going.
मूषिकाराति: मूषिकाराति m. (-तिः) A cat. E. मूषिक, and अराति an enemy.
मूषिकाह्वय: मूषिकाह्वय m. (-यः) A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) E. मूषिक a rat, and आह्वय appellation; also मूषिकाह्व.
मूषित: मूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stolen. E. मूष, and क्त, aff.
मूषिपर्णिका: मूषिपर्णिका f. (-का) A plant: see the last. E. मूषि for मूषी, and कन् added to पर्णी.
मूषीक: मूषीक mf. (-कः-का) A rat, a mouse. E. मूष to steal, कीकन् aff.
मूष्यायण: मूष्यायण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Born of unknown parents, of concealed birth or origin. E. अमूष्यायण the son of somebody, and the initiatory vowel rejected.
मृकण्डक: मृकण्डक m. (-कः) The name of a saint; also called MĀRKAṆḌEYA. E. मृकण्ड the name of his father, and वुन् aff.
मृकण्डु: मृकण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) The saint MĀRKAṆḌEYA. E. मृकण्डु his father, अण् aff., but the word unchanged.
मृक्ष: मृक्ष r. 1st cl. (मृक्षति) To accumulate, to collect, to fill. r. 10th cl. (मृक्षयति) 1 To mix, to mingle, to blend or combine. 2 To speak incorrectly.
मृग: मृग r. 4th cl. (मृग्यति) r. 10th cl. (मृगयते) To seek, to pursue, to hunt, to chase.

मृग m. (-गः) 1 A deer, an antelope. 2 An animal in general. 3 Research, inquiry, investigation. 4 Asking, soliciting, begging. 5 A kind of elephant, one with white marks on his forehead. 6 The fifth lunar constellation, more usually Mṛgaśiras: see मृगशिरस्. 7 The month in which the moon is full in the constellation Mṛgaśiras. 8 A particular sacrifice. 9 Musk. 10 Hunting, chase. 11 One of the four classes into which men are divided, in erotic works. f. (-गी) 1 A description of woman, perhaps the same as the one termed त्रित्रिणी, the corresponding female to the male called मृग. 2 A female deer, a doe. 3 A species of the Madhya metre. E. मृग to search, to chase, aff. घञ्.
मृगक्षीर: मृगक्षीर n. (-रं) Doe's milk. E. मृग for मृगी a female deer, and क्षीर milk.
मृगचैटक: मृगचैटक m. (-कः) A wild or pole cat.
मृगजालिका: मृगजालिका f. (-का) A net for confining deer. E. मृग a deer, and जालिका a net.
मृगजीवन: मृगजीवन m. (-नः) A hunter. E. मृग a deer, and जीवन living, subsistence.
मृगण: मृगण nf. (-णं-णा) Search, inquiry, research. E. मृग to search for or after, aff. युच् and टाप्.
मृगतृष्: मृगतृष् f. (-तृट्) Vapour floating over sands or desarts, and appearing at a distance like water. E. मृग a deer, तृष् to thirst, aff. क्विप्; deer being deceived by it; also with अङ्, and टाप् aff. मृगतृषा, and with तृष्णा thirst, मृगतृष्णा.
मृगतृषा: मृगतृषा f. (-षा) Mirage: see the last.
मृगतृष्णा: मृगतृष्णा f. (-ष्णा) Sultry vapour, mirage: see the last.
मृगतृष्णिका: मृगतृष्णिका f. (-का) Sultry vapour. E. कन् added to the last.
मृगदशक्: मृगदशक् m. (-कः) A dog. E. मृग deer, and दंशक who bites.
मृगद्युत्: मृगद्युत् m. (-द्युत्) A hunter. E. मृग and द्यु to go, क्विप् aff. and तुक् added.
मृगद्यू: मृगद्यू m. (-द्यूः) A hunter. E. मृग, and दिब to play, क्विप् aff., and the semivowel changed.
मृगधूर्तक: मृगधूर्त्तक m. (-कः) A jackal. E. मृग a deer, and धूर्त्तक a cheat; preying upon them only in consequence of his luring them into his reach.
मृगधूर्त्तक: मृगधूर्त्तक m. (-कः) A jackal. E. मृग a deer, and धूर्त्तक a cheat; preying upon them only in consequence of his luring them into his reach.
मृगनाभि: मृगनाभि m. (-भिः) Musk. E. मृग a deer, (the musk deer,) and नाभि the navel; the musk being formed in a bag attached to the belly of the animal about the navel.
मृगनाभिज: मृगनाभिज nf. (-जं-जा) Musk. E. मृग a deer, नाभि the navel, and ज produced.
मृगनेत्र: मृगनेत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Possessing or relating to the constellation Mṛgaśīrṣa. f. (-त्री) A woman with beautiful eyes, or eyes like a deer. E. मृग the asterism, णा to get, तृच् aff., and अप् added, or मृग a deer, and नेत्र the eye.
मृगपति: मृगपति m. (-तिः) A lion. E. मृग an animal or a deer, and पति lord.
मृगपद: मृगपद n. (-दं) A deer's foot. E. मृग, and पद for पाद foot.
मृगपालिका: मृगपालिका f. (-का) The musk deer. E. मृग a deer, पाल to nourish, वुन् aff., fem. form.
मृगपिप्लु: मृगपिप्लु m. (-प्लुः) The moon. E. मृग a deer, and पिप्ल a mark or spot.
मृगबधाजीव: मृगबधाजीव m. (-वः) A hunter, a deer-killer. E. मृग a deer, बध killing, and आजीव who lives by.
मृगबन्धिनी: मृगबन्धिनी f. (-नी) A net for confining deer. E. मृग a deer, and बन्धिनी confinement.
मृगभोजनी: मृगभोजनी f. (-नी) Bitter apple or Colocynth. E. मृग, and भोजन eating.
मृगमद: मृगमद m. (-दः) Musk. E. मृग a deer, and मद passion, or fluid that distils from the elephant's temples when in rut, and to which this secretion is considered analogous.
