मृगमातृका: मृगमातृका f. (-का) A female antelope. E. मृग, and मातृ mother कन् added.
मृगमान: मृगमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Seeking, pursuing, hunting. E. मृग to seek, शानच् aff.
मृगया: मृगया f. (-या) Chase, hunting. E. मृग to search or seek, यत् aff., deriv. irr.
मृगयु: मृगयु m. (-युः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 A jackal. 3 A hunter. E. मृग a deer, या to go, कु Uṇādi aff., form irr.
मृगराज्: मृगराज् m. (-राट्) A lion. E. मृग an animal, and राज् who rules over; also with a final vowel, मृगराज m. (-जः.)
मृगरिपु: मृगरिपु m. (-पुः) A lion. E. मृग an animal, and रिपु the enemy.
मृगरोमज: मृगरोमज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Woollen, (cloth, &c.) E. मृग an animal, रोम hair, and ज produced, made.
मृगलाञ्छन: मृगलाञ्छन m. (-नः) The moon. E. मृग a deer, लाच्छन symbol, sign.
मृगवाहन: मृगवाहन m. (-नः) Air, wind. E. मृग a deer, and वाहन vehicle.
मृगव्य: मृगव्य n. (-व्यं) 1 Chase, hunting. 2 The butt or mark in archery. E. मृग a deer, व्यथ to destroy, aff. ड.
मृगशिरस्: मृगशिरस् n. (-रः) The fifth lunar mansion, containing three stars, one of which is λ ORIONIS, and figured by an antelope's head, whence its name. E. मृग a deer, and शिरस् the head; also मृगशिरा f. (-रा) or मृगशिरस् m. (-राः.)
मृगशीर्ष: मृगशीर्ष m. (-र्षः) The constellation Mṛgaśiras: see the last. E. मृग a deer, and शीर्ष the head; also f. (-र्षा.)
मृगाक्षी: मृगाक्षी f. (-क्षी) 1 Bitter apple, (Cucumis coloquintida.) 2 A woman with eyes like a deer's. E. मृग a deer, अक्षि the eye.
मृगाङ्क: मृगाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 The moon. 2 Air, wind. E. मृग a deer, and अङ्क a mark, a symbol, or अकि to go, aff. अच्.
मृगाजिन: मृगाजिन n. (-नं) A deer skin. E. मृग, and अजिन a skin.
मृगाजीव: मृगाजीव m. (-वः) 1 A hyena. 2 A hunter. E. मृग a deer, and आजीव who lives by or preys upon.
मृगाण्डजा: मृगाण्डजा f. (-जा) Musk. E. मृग a deer, अण्ड testicle, and ज produced.
मृगाद्: मृगाद् m. (-ट् or -त्) A tiger. E. मृग a deer, अद to eat, aff. क्विन्.
मृगादन: मृगादन m. (-नः) 1 A hyena. 2 A leopard. f. (-नी) Colocynth, (Cucumis coloquintida.) E. मृग a deer, and अदन eating.
मृगान्तक: मृगान्तक m. (-कः) The Cīta or hunting leopard. E. मृग a deer, and अन्तक destroyer.
मृगाराति: मृगाराति m. (-तिः) A dog. E. मृग a deer, and अराति an enemy.
मृगारि: मृगारि m. (-रिः) 1 A lion. 2 A tiger. 3 A dog, a hound. E. मृग a deer, and अरि an enemy.
मृगाविध्: मृगाविध् m. (-विट्) A hunter, a deer-killer. E. मृग a deer, व्यध to destroy, with आङ् prefix, and क्विप् aff., and the semivowel changed.
मृगित: मृगित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sought, pursued. E. मृग to chase, aff. क्त.
मृगेन्द्र: मृगेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A lion. E. मृग an animal, and इन्द्र lord, master
मृगेन्द्रचटक: मृगेन्द्रचटक m. (-कः) A hawk, a falcon. E. मृगेन्द्र a lion, and चटक a sparrow.
मृगेन्द्रमुख: मृगेन्द्रमुख n. (-खं) 1 The lion's mouth. 2 A species of the Atijagatī metre. E. मृगेन्द्र, and मुख mouth.
मृग्य: मृग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) To be sought or inquired for. E. मृग to search, क्यप् aff.
मृग्यमान: मृग्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being sought or inquired after. E. मृग to search, pass. v., शानच् aff.
मृज: मृज(ऊ)मृजू r. 2nd cl. (मार्ष्टि) 1st and 10th cls. (मार्जति मार्जयति) 1 To clean, to cleanse. 2 To be clean or pure. 3 To ornament. 4 To sound. With अप or प्र prefixed, 1 To sweep, to sweep away. 2 To clean.

मृज m. (-जः) A musical instrument, probably a sort of tabor or drum. f. (-जा) 1 Cleaning the body, by washing, anointing, &c. 2 Purification, ablution. E. मृज to cleanse, to sound, aff. क or अङ्, and टाप् aff.
मृजान्वय: मृजान्वय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Clean, cleansed. E. मृजा, and अन्वय order.
मृज्य: मृज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) To be cleaned or purified. E. मृज to cleanse, क्यप् aff.; also मार्ग्य.
मृड: मृड r. 6th cl. (मृडति) r. 9th cl. (-मृड्णाति) 1 To delight, to make happy. 2 To rejoice, to be happy or delighted. r. 9th cl. (according to some authorities,) To grind or pound.
मृड m. (-डः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 The fire that completes an oblation. f. (-डानी) DURGĀ, the wife of ŚIVA. E. मृड to be pleased or delighted, aff. क, fem. aff. ङीष्, with आनुक् augment.
मृडङ्कण: मृडङ्कण m. (-णः) A child, a pupil. E. मृड to be pleased, Uṇādi aff. कङ्कण.
मृडीक: मृडीक m. (-कः) A deer. E. मृड to delight, Uṇādi aff. कीकन्.
मृण: मृण r. 6th cl. (मृणाति) To hurt, to injure.
मृणाल: मृणाल mn. (-लः-लं) The film or fibres attached to the stalk of a lotus. n. (-लं) The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) f. (-ली) A small fibre in the stalk of the waterlily. E. मृण to hurt, Uṇādi aff. कालन्.
मृणालिन्: मृणालिन् m. (-ली) A lotus. f. (-लिनी) An assemblage of lotus flowers. E. मृणाल a fibre, and इनि aff.
मृण्मय: मृण्मय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of earth or clay, (as porcelain, &c.) E. मृत्, and मयट् aff.
मृत: मृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dead, expired, extinct, defunct. 2 Calcined, reduced, (metals.) n. (-तं) 1 Solicited alms. 2 Death. E. मृ to die, aff. क्त.
मृतक: मृतक n. (-कं) A dead body, a corpse. E. मृत dead, कन् added.
मृतकल्प: मृतकल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Insensible, fainted. E. मृत dead, and कल्प aff. of comparison.
मृतकान्तक: मृतकान्तक m. (-कः) A jackal. E. मृत dead, and कान्तक fond of.
मृतपा: मृतपा m. (-पाः) A man of the lowest caste, who for a subsistence collects dead men's clothes; conveys dead bodies to the river side to be burnt; executes criminals, &c. E. मृत, and पा who cherishes.
मृतमत्त: मृतमत्त m. (-त्तः) A jackal. E. मृत a corpse, and मत्त fond of, mad for; also with कन् added मृतमत्तक.
मृतवत्सा: मृतवत्सा f. (-त्सा) A woman or female animal, whose offspring never live long. E. मृत, and वत्स young.
मृतशङ्का: मृतशङ्का f. (-ङ्का) The fear entertained of a person's being dead. E. मृत, and शङ्का fear.
मृतसञ्जीवनी: मृतसञ्जीवनी f. (-नी) A Mantra for reviving the dead. E. मृत, सञ्जीवनी reviving.
मृतस्नात: मृतस्नात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bathed after mourning. 2 Dying immediately after ablution. E. मृत dead, and स्नात bathed.
मृतस्नान: मृतस्नान n. (-नं) Funeral ablution, bathing after mourning. E. मृत dead, and स्नान bathing.
मृतस्वमोक्तृ: मृतस्वमोक्तृ m. (-क्ता) The name of a royal saint. E. मृत death, स्व his own, and मोक्तृ liberator.
मृताण्ड: मृताण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The sun. E. मृत dead, and अण्ड egg.
मृतामद: मृतामद n. (-दं) Blue vitriol. E. मृत् earth, मद to please, आङ् prefix, and अच् aff.
मृतालक: मृतालक n. (-कं) A fragrant sort of earth. E. मृत earth, अल to adorn, causal form, aff. अण्, and कन् added; also मृत्तालक.
मृति: मृति f. (-तिः) Death, dying. E. मृ to die, aff. क्तिन्.
मृतोद्भव: मृतोद्भव m. (-वः) The ocean. E. मृत dead, destroyed, and उद्भव produced.
मृत्कर: मृत्कर m. (-रः) A potter. E. मृत् earth, and कर who works.
मृत्कांश्य: मृत्कांश्य n. (-श्यं) An earthen vessel, a mug, a pitcher. E. मृत् earth, and कांश्य a goblet.
मृत्किरा: मृत्किरा f. (-रा) An earth worm. E. मृत् earth, and किर a hog, fem form.
मृत्खलिनी: मृत्खलिनी f. (-नी) A plant, commonly Carmaghās.
मृत्ताल: मृत्ताल n. (-लं) A sort of fragrant earth; also called Surat earth. E. मृत् earth, ताल site, place of abiding; also with कन् added,
मृत्तालक: मृत्तालक n. (-कं) and with a single consonant, मृतालक.
मृत्तिका: मृत्तिका f. (-का) 1 Earth, clay, soil. 2 A fragrant earth. E. मृत् earth, and तिकन् pleonastic addition, fem. aff. टाप्.
मृत्फली: मृत्फली f. (-ली) A sort of Costus. E. मृत् earth, and फल a fruit, fem. aff. ङीष्.
मृत्यु: मृत्यु mfn. subst. (-त्युः-त्युः-त्यु) Death, dying. m. (-त्युः) YAMA the judge of the dead. E. मृ to die, Uṇādi aff. त्युक्.
मृत्युञ्जय: मृत्युञ्जय m. (-यः) A name of ŚIVA. E. मृत्यु death, and जय conqueror.
मृत्युनाशक: मृत्युनाशक m. (-कः) Quicksilver. E. मृत्यु death, and नाशक destroyer, remover.
मृत्युपुष्प: मृत्युपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) Sugar cane. E. मृत्यु death, and पुष्प flower; dying after flowering.
मृत्युफल: मृत्युफल n. (-लं) A sort of fruit considered as poisonous. f. (-ला or -ली) The plantain. E. मृत्यु death, and फल fruit.
मृत्युभङ्गुरक: मृत्युभङ्गुरक m. (-कः) A drum beat on funeral occasions. E. मृत्यु death, भङ्गुर crooked, aff. कन्.
मृत्युभृत्य: मृत्युभृत्य m. (-त्यः) Sickness, malady, disease. E. मृत्यु death, भृत्य servant.
मृत्युवञ्चन: मृत्युवञ्चन m. (-नः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A raven or a kind of crow, the carrion crow. 3 A tree, (Ægle marmelos.) E. मृत्यु death or decay, and वञ्चन deceiving.
मृत्युवीज: मृत्युवीज m. (-जः) The bambu. E. मृत्यु death, and वीज seed.
मृत्युसूति: मृत्युसूति f. (-तिः) A crab. E. मृत्यु death, and सूति bearing.
मृत्सा: मृत्सा f. (-त्सा) 1 Good or rich soil. 2 A fragrant earth. E. मृत् earth, स aff. of superior quality.
मृत्स्ना: मृत्स्ना f. (-त्स्ना) 1 Good soil. 2 A fragrant sort of earth. E. मृत् earth, स्न aff. of excellence.
मृत्स्नाभाण्डक: मृत्स्नाभाण्डक n. (-कं) A pitcher, an earthen vessel for carrying water. E. मृत्स्ना earth, and भाण्डक vessel.
मृद: मृद r. 9th cl. (मृद्नाति) 1 To grind, to powder, to reduce to dust or powder. 2 To trample on, to tread under foot.
मृद्: मृद् f. (मृद् मृत्) 1 Earth, soil, clay. 2 A fragrant earth. E. मृद to trample on, aff. क्विप्.
मृदङ्कुर: मृदङ्कुर m. (-रः) The green pigeon, (Columba hariala, BUC.)
मृदङ्ग: मृदङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A tabour, a small drum. 2 A double drum. 3 A sound, a noise. 4 A bambu. E. मृद to be trampled on, to be beat, Uṇādi aff. अङ्गच्; also with कन् added मृदङ्गक.
मृदङ्गफल: मृदङ्गफल m. (-लः) The jack tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.) E. मृदङ्ग a drum, and फल a fruit; perhaps alluding to its size and shape.
मृदर: मृदर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Sportive, sporting. 2 Passing quickly away, transient. E. मृ to die, दर Uṇādi aff.
मृदा: मृदा f. (-दा) Earth, clay, soil. E. मृद to trample on, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
मृदाकर: मृदाकर m. (-रः) The thunderbolt. E. मृदा earth, and कर what makes.
मृदित: मृदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rubbed, ground. 2 Trodden or trampled on. E. मृद to reduce to powder, aff. क्त.
मृदिनी: मृदिनी f. (-नी) Good soil or earth. E. मृद् earth, इनि aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.
मृदु: मृदु mfn. (-दुः-द्वी-दु) 1 Soft. 2 Blunt, not sharp. 3 Gentle, mild. f. (-द्वी) The brown grape. E. म्रद to rub, aff. कु, and the semivowel changed to its congener.
मृदुकोष्ठ: मृदुकोष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A man of lax bowels, one easily affected by medicine. E. मृदु, and कोष्ठ intestinal canal.
मृदुगमना: मृदुगमना f. (-ना) A goose, a swan. E. मृदु soft, and गमन going.
मृदुचर्मिन्: मृदुचर्म्मिन् m. (-र्म्मी) The Bhojpatra tree. E. मृदु soft, चर्म्म skin or bark, इनि aff.
मृदुचर्म्मिन्: मृदुचर्म्मिन् m. (-र्म्मी) The Bhojpatra tree. E. मृदु soft, चर्म्म skin or bark, इनि aff.
मृदुच्छद: मृदुच्छद m. (-दः) 1 The Bhojpatra or birch tree. 2 A kind of Pīlu, or tree growing in the hills. E. मृदु soft, and च्छद covering or bark.
मृदुता: मृदुता f. (-ता) Softness. E. तल् added to मृदु; also with त्व, मृदुत्वं.
मृदुत्वच: मृदुत्वच m. (-चः) The Bhojpatra or birch tree, the bark of which peels off, and is used in making Hooka- snakes, &c. E. मृदु soft, and त्वच skin; also with a final consonant मृदुत्वच्, (-त्वक्.)
मृदुपर्वन्: मृदुपर्व्वन् n. (-र्व्व) A cane or ratan.
मृदुपर्व्वन्: मृदुपर्व्वन् n. (-र्व्व) A cane or ratan.
मृदुपाणि: मृदुपाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Having a soft and delicate hand. E. मृदु, and पाणि hand.
मृदुपुष्प: मृदुपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) The Sirisha tree, (Mimosa sirisha.) E. मृदु soft, and पुष्प flower.
मृदुल: मृदुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Soft. n. (-लं) Water. E. मृदु soft, and लच् aff.
मृदुरोमवत्: मृदुरोमवत् m. (-वान्) A hare. E. मृदु soft, रोमन् hair, and मतुप् aff.
मृदुलोमक: मृदुलोमक m. (-कः) A hare. E. मृदु soft, लोभ hair, and कन् added.
मृदुवात: मृदुवात m. (-तः) A gentle breeze, zephyr. E. मृदु soft, and वात wind.
मृदूत्पल: मृदूत्पल n. (-लं) The blue lotus, (Nymphæa cærulea) E. मृदु soft, and उत्पल a lotus.
मृद्भाण्ड: मृद्भाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) An earthen vessel. E. मृत्, and भाण्ड vessel.
मृद्वङ्ग: मृद्वङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Of soft or tender frame or body. f. (-ङ्गी) A delicate woman. n. (-ङ्गं) Tin. E. मृदु soft, and अङ्ग body, substance.
मृद्वीका: मृद्वीका f. (-का) A grape. E. मृद to hurt, कीकन् aff., and उक् augment.
मृध: मृध(उ)मृधु r. 1st cl. (मर्द्धति-ते) 1 To be moist or wet. 2 To hurt or kill.
मृध n. (-धं) War, battle. E. मृध to hurt or kill, aff. घ.
मृन्मरु: मृन्मरु m. (-रुः) A stone, a rock. E. मृद् earth, and मरु dry as a desart.
मृल्लोष्ट: मृल्लोष्ट n. (-ष्टं) A clod of earth or clay. E. मृत्, and लोष्ट a lump.
मृश: मृश(औ)मृशौ r. 6th cl. (मृशति) 1 To touch. 2 To see, to perceive. 3 To consult, to consider, to deliberate. With परा, To counsel, to advise. With वि, To consider, to discuss.
मृष: मृष r. 1st and 10th cls. (मर्षति-ते मर्षयति-ते) and 4th cl. (मृष्यति-ते) To bear, to suffer, to endure patiently. (उ) मृषु r. 1st cl. (मर्षति) To sprinkle. With आङ्, To be angry. With वि, To be distressed, to bear hardly.
मृषा: मृषा ind. 1 Falsely. 2 Uselessly, in vain. E. मृष to bear, with का aff.
मृषार्थक: मृषार्थक n. (-कं) An impossibility, an absurdity, (in speech or composition;) the sense of which is evidently false, as कूर्म्मलोमतनुत्राणः, शशशृङ्गधनुर्धरः, his armour is of tortoise wool, and his bow the horn of a hare. E. मृषा falsely, अर्थ meaning, कन् added.
मृषावाद: मृषावाद m. (-दः) 1 Irony, ironical praise. 2 Falsehood. E. मृषा falsely, and वाद speech, praise.
मृषावादिन्: मृषावादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Speaking falsely, lying, a liar. m. (-दी) A false accuser, one who brings forward an unjust or unfounded accusation. E. मृषा falsely, and वादिन् who speaks.
मृषोद्य: मृषोद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Speaking falsely, lying, a liar. n. (-द्यं) Falsehood. E. मृषा falsely, वद to speak, aff. क्यप्.
मृष्ट: मृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Cleaned, cleansed. 2 Touched, rubbed. 3 Sprinkled. E. मृज to clean, or मृष to rub, &c., aff. क्त.
मृष्टि: मृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Touching, contact. 2 Cleaning. 3 Sprinkling. 4 Preparing the food for a meal. E. मृज to clean, or मृष to sprinkle, &c., क्तिन् aff.
मृष्टेरुक: मृष्टेरुक m. (-कः) 1 A liberal man, a donor, a benefactor. 2 A churlish or inhospitable man. 3 An eater of sweetmeats.
मॄ: मॄ r. 9th cl. (मृणाति) To hurt, to injure, to kill.
मे: मे r. 1st cl. (मयते) 1 To barter or exchange. 2 To return, to restore.
मेकलकन्यका: मेकलकन्यका f. (-का) The Narmadā river. E. मेकल or मेखल the name of a Ṛṣi the supposed father, or of a mountain, the source of the stream, and कन्यका daughter; hence also मेखलकन्यका.
मेकलाद्रिजा: मेकलाद्रिजा f. (-जा) The Narmadā or Nerbadda river. E. मेकलाद्रि the Mekala mountain, part of the Vindhya range, and ज born.
मेखला: मेखला f. (-ला) 1 A woman's girdle or zone. 2 A sword knot, a string or chain fastened to the hilt, and in fighting bound round the wrist to secure the weapon. 3 A sword-belt. 4 The edge or swell of a mountain. 5 The Narmadā river. 6 The sacrificial string of a Brahman when made of deer skin. 7 A sort of figure, made on the four sides of the hole in which sacrificial fire is offered. 8 A triple zone or string worn round the loins by the three first classes; the girdle of the Brahman should be of the fibres of the Munja or of Kuśa grass, that of the Kṣatriya of a Mūrvā or bowstring, and that of the Vaiśya of a thread of the Śaṇa, &c. E. मि to scatter, खलच् aff., deriv. irr.
मेखलापद: मेखलापद n. (-दं) The hip and loins. E. मेखला a zone, and पद place.
मेखलिन्: मेखलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Wearing a girdle. m. (-ली) A youth of the Brahman tribe, who previous to his marriage wears a girdle suited to his caste. E. मेखला, and इनि aff.
मेघ: मेघ m. (-घः) 1 A cloud. 2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 3 A demon, a goblin. E. मिह to sprinkle, aff. अच्, and the final changed.
मेघकफ: मेघकफ m. (-फः) Hail. E. मेघ a cloud, and कफ phlegm.
मेघकाल: मेघकाल m. (-लः) The rains, the rainy season. E. मेघ a cloud, and काल time.
मेघगर्जन: मेघगर्ज्जन n. (-नं) Thunder. E. मेघ, and गर्ज्जन noise.
मेघगर्ज्जन: मेघगर्ज्जन n. (-नं) Thunder. E. मेघ, and गर्ज्जन noise.
मेघङ्कर: मेघङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cloud-producing, (rainy season.) E. मेघ, कृ to make, खच् aff.
मेघचिन्तक: मेघचिन्तक m. (-कः) The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucus.) E. मेघ a cloud, चिन्तक who thinks of; being supposed to drink no water but rain, and therefore naturally anxious for cloudy and rainy weather.
मेघज: मेघज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Cloud-born, produced in or from the clouds. m. (-जः) A large pearl. E. मेघ, and ज born.
मेघजाल: मेघजाल n. (-लं) Talc. E. मेघ a cloud, and जाल a net; some copies read मेघनाल.
मेघजीवक: मेघजीवक m. (-कः) The Cātaka. E. मेघ a cloud, and जीवक living: see मेघचिन्तक.
मेघज्योतिस्: मेघज्योतिस् m. (-तिः) A flash of lightning or the fire of it. E. मेघ a cloud, and ज्योतिस् light.
मेघतिमिर: मेघतिमिर n. (-रं) Cloudiness, cloudy or rainy weather. E. मेघ a cloud, and तिमिर darkness.
मेघदीप: मेघदीप m. (-पः) Lightning. E. मेव a cloud, and दीप inflamer.
मेघद्वार: मेघद्वार n. (-रं) Sky, heaven, ether. E. मेघ a cloud, and द्वार the gate.
मेघनाद: मेघनाद m. (-दः) 1 The son of RĀVAṆA. 2 A name of VARUṆA, deity of water. 3 The noise or grumbling of clouds. 4 The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) 5 A sort of amaranth, (Amaranthus polygamus.) E. मेघ a cloud, and नाद sound or noise.
मेघनादजित्: मेघनादजित् m. (-जित्) LAKṢMAṆA, the favourite brother and companion of RĀMA. E. मघनाद the son of RĀVAṆA, and जित् conqueror.
मेघनादानुलासिन्: मेघनादानुलासिन् m. (-सी) A peacock. E. मेघनाद the muttering of clouds, अनुलस to be delighted by, and णिनि aff.; pairing in the rainy season.
मेघनामन्: मेघनामन् m. (-मा) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. मेघ a cloud; and नामन् appellation, or it may apply to every term for a cloud, being a synonym of the grass.
मेघनिर्घोष: मेघनिर्घोष m. (-षः) The muttering or grumbling of clouds, low or distant thunder. E. मेघ a cloud, and निर्घोष sound, noise.
मेघपुष्प: मेघपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) 1 Water. 2 River water. 3 Hail. m. (-ष्पः) One of VIṢṆU'S horses. E. मेघ a cloud, and पुष्प a flower.
मेघप्रसव: मेघप्रसव m. (-वः) Water. E. मेघ a cloud, and प्रसव a parent.
मेघभूति: मेघभूति m. (-तिः) The thunderbolt. E. मेघ a cloud, and भूति being.
मेघमाला: मेघमाला f. (-ला) A gathering or succession of clouds. E. मेघ a cloud, and माला a necklace or garland.
मेघयोनि: मेघयोनि m. (-निः) Smoke. E. मेघ a cloud, and योनि place of birth or production.
मेघराग: मेघराग m. (-गः) One of the six modes of music. E. मेघ a cloud, and राग mode; being supposed capable of bringing down rain from heaven.
मेघवर्णा: मेघवर्णा f. (-र्णा) The indigo plant. E. मेघ a cloud, and वर्ण colour.
मेघवर्त्मन्: मेघवर्त्मन् n. (-र्त्म) Sky, atmosphere. E. मेघ a cloud, and वर्त्मन् road.
मेघवह्नि: मेघवह्नि m. (-ह्निः) The fire of lightning, or electrical coruscations in the clouds. E. मेघ a cloud, and वह्नि fire.
मेघवाहन: मेघवाहन m. (-नः) 1 A name of INDRA. 2 ŚIVA. E. मेघ a cloud, and वाहन vehicle.
मेघविस्फुर्ज्जित: मेघविस्फुर्ज्जित n. (-तं) 1 Thunder. 2 A species of the Atidhṛti metre. E. मेघ, and विस्फुर्ज्जित bursting.
मेघवेश्मन्: मेघवेश्मन् n. (-श्म) Sky, atmosphere. E. मेघ a cloud, and वेश्मन् abode.
मेघसुहृद्: मेघसुहृद् m. (-हृद्) A peacock. E. मेघ a cloud, and सुहृद् a friend.
मेघागम: मेघागम m. (-मः) The rains, the rainy season. E. मेघ a cloud, and आगम arrival.
मेघानन्दिन्: मेघानन्दिन् m. (-न्दी) A peacock. E. मेघ a cloud, and आनन्दिन् delighting.
मेघास्थि: मेघास्थि n. (-स्थि) Hail. E. मेघ a cloud, and अस्थि a bone.
मेघास्पद: मेघास्पद n. (-दं) Heaven, ether, sky, atmosphere. E. मेघ a cloud, and आस्पद place.
मेघोदर: मेघोदर m. (-रः) The father of the fifth Jina or Jaina saint.
मेचक: मेचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Black, dark, of a dark or black colour. m. (-कः) 1 Black or dark-blue, (the colour.) 2 The eye of a peacock's tail. 3 A cloud. 4 Smoke. 5 A plant, (Hyperanthera morunga.) mn. (-कः-कं) Darkness. n. (-कं) Sulphuret of antimony. E. मच to mix, Uṇādi aff. वुन्, and the vowel changed to ए.
मेचकापगा: मेचकापगा f. (-गा) The Yamunā river. E. मेचक dark, and अपगा the river.
मेट: मेट(ऋ)मेदृ r. 1st cl. (मेटति) To be mad.
मेटुला: मेटुला f. (-ला) A tree, (Spondias mangifera.) E. मेट to be mad, उलच् aff.
मेठ: मेठ m. (-ठः) 1 An elephant-keeper or feeder. 2 A ram; also read मेण्ठ and मेण्ठ.
मेडृ: मेडृ(ऋ)मेडृ r. 1st. cl. (मेडति) To be mad.
मेढ्र: मेढ्र m. (-ढ्रः) 1 The penis. 2 A ram. E. मिह to urine, ष्ट्रन aff.
मेढ्रशृङ्गी: मेढ्रशृङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A milky plant, the fruit of which is crooked, and therefore compared to a ram's horn, (Asclepias geminata?) E. मेढ्र a ram, शृङ्ग a horn, ङीष् aff.
मेण्ठ: मेण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) An elephant-keeper; also read मेठ as above.
मेण्ड: मेण्ड m. (-ण्डः) An elephant-keeper or feeder.
मेण्ढ: मेण्ढ m. (-ण्ढः) A ram. E. मिह to urine, घञ् aff., नुम् inserted and the final changed; also with कन् added मेण्ढक.
मेथ: मेथ(ऋ)मेथृ r. 1st cl. (मेथति-ते) 1 To understand, to comprehend. 2 To hurt, to injure. 3 To associate.
मेथि: मेथि m. (-थिः) The part of a threshing floor, round which the cattle turn to tread out the corn. f. (-थी) A sort of grass, (Trigonella foenugræcum.) E. मथ to understand, &c. इन् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्; also with कन् added in the fem. form मेथिका.
मेद: मेद(ऋ)मेदृ r. 1st cl. (मेदति-ते) To understand, to kill or injure.

मेद m. (-दः) 1 Adeps, fat, the supposed proper seat of which is the abdomen. 2 One of the outcast tribes. f. (-दा) A drug, described as a sort of root resembling ginger, brought from the Morung district; it is one of the eight principal medicaments, and is said to be of cooling and emollient properties, and of particular use in fever and consumption. E. मिद to be greasy or unctuous, aff. घञ्; also मेदस्.
मेदक: मेदक m. (-कः) Vinous liquor for distilling. E. मिद to be unctuous, aff. वुन्.
मेदस्: मेदस् n. (-दः) 1 Marrow; applicable not merely to the marrow of the bones, but more properly, to the serous or adipose secretion that spreads amongst the muscular fibres, and which is considered as performing the same functions to the flesh that the marrow of the bones performs to them: in Hindu physiology its proper seat is said to be the abdomen. 2 Morbid or unnatural corpulency. E. मिद to be unctuous, असुन् aff.
मेदस्कृत्: मेदस्कृत् n. (-स्कृत्) Flesh. E. मेदस् adeps, and कृत् made.
मेदस्विन्: मेदस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 1 Robust, stout, strong. 2 Fat, corpulent. E. मेदस्, and विनि aff.
मेदिनी: मेदिनी f. (-नी) The earth. E. मेदस् adeps, इनि and ङीप् affs.; being made, according to the legend, of the adeps of two demons slain by BRAHMĀ.
मेदिनीद्रव: मेदिनीद्रव m. (-वः) Dust. E. मेदिनी the earth, and द्रु to get, aff. अच्.
मेदुर: मेदुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Smooth, soft, bland, unctuous, saponaceous, &c. E. मिद to be unctuous, घुरच् aff.
मेदोग्रन्थि: मेदोग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) A fatty tumor. E. मेदस्, and ग्रन्थि knot.
मेदोज: मेदोज n. (-जं) A bone. E. मेदस् marrow, and ज born.
मेदोधरा: मेदोधरा f. (-रा) A membrane in the abdomen, containing the fat, the omentum. E. मेदस्, and धरा what has.
मेदोर्व्वुद: मेदोऽर्व्वुद n. (-दं) Fatty tumors unattended with pain. E. मेदस्, and अर्व्वुद a tumor.
मेदोवह: मेदोवह n. (-हं) A vessel carrying fat, a lymphatic. E. मेदस्, and वह what bears.
मेदोवृद्धि: मेदोवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Corpulence. 2 Enlargement of the scrotum. E. मेदस्, and वृद्धि increase.
मेध: मेध(ऋ,)मेधृ r. 1st cl. (मेधति-ते) 1 To understand, to comprehend. 2 To associate. 3 To hurt, to injure, to kill.
मेध m. (-धः) Sacrifice, offering, oblation. f. (-धा) Apprehension, conception, understanding. E. मेध to associate, aff. अप्.
मेधाजित्: मेधाजित् m. (-जित्) The name of a saint and grammarian; also KĀTYĀYANA. E. मेधा apprehension, and जित् victor.
मेधाविन्: मेधाविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Intelligent, comprehending, of ready comprehension or conception. m. (-वी) 1 A parrot. 2 A Paṇḍita, a learned man, a sage, a teacher. 3 The inspired writer Vyāḍi. f. (-नी) The wife of BRAHMĀ. E. मेधा apprehension, विनि aff.
मेधि: मेधि m. (-धिः) A post fixed in the centre of a threshing-floor or barn, to which the cattle are attached, as they turn round it to tread out the corn. E. मेध to associate or connect, (the oxen, &c.) and इन् aff.
मेधिर: मेधिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Intelligent, possessing a ready and just apprehension. E. मेधा apprehension, किरच् aff.
मेध्य: मेध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 Pure, purified. 2 Fit for a sacrifice or oblation. f. (-ध्या) A kind of orris root, described as the red sort. 3 A sort of pigment; see रोचना. m. (-ध्यः) 1 Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.) 2 Barley. 3 A goat. E. मेध to associate, aff. ण्यत्, or मेध a sacrifice, and यत् aff.
मेनका: मेनका f. (-का) One of the courtezans of Svarga, and wife to Himālaya. E. मे to me, का any one, न not, (equal or comparable.)
मेनकात्मजा: मेनकात्मजा f. (-जा) DURGĀ or PĀRVATĪ. E. मेनका the wife of the personified Himālaya mountain, and आत्मजा daughter.
मेनकाप्राणेश: मेनकाप्राणेश m. (-शः) The personified Himālaya mountain. E. मेनका the Apsaras so named, and प्राणेश husband.
मेना: मेना f. (-ना) The wife of Himālaya; see मेनका.
मेनाजा: मेनाजा f. (-जा) PĀRVATĪ. E. मेना for मेनका the mother of the goddess, and जा born.
मेनाद: मेनाद m. (-दः) 1 A cat. 2 A goat. 3 A peacock. E. मे imitative cry, mew, and नाद sound.
मेनाधव: मेनाधव m. (-वः) Himālaya, the personified mountain, and father of DURGĀ, as PĀRVATĪ. E. मेना the wife of the mountain, and धव husband.
मेन्धी: मेन्धी f. (-न्धी) A plant, from the leaves of which a reddish dye is prepared, with which the palms of the hands, tips of the fingers, soles of the feet, and finger nails are stained, (Lawsonia inermis;) also मेन्धिका.
मेप: मेप(ऋ)मेपृ r. 1st cl. (मेपते) 1 To go, to move. 2 To serve.
मेय: मेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Measurable, what is to be measured. E. मा to measure, क्यप् aff.
मेरक: मेरक m. (-कः) An Asura, and foe to VIṢṆU.
मेरु: मेरु m. (-रुः) The sacred mountain Meru, in the centre of the seven continents, compared to the cup or seed-vessel of the lotus, the leaves of which are formed by the different Dvīpas: its height is said by the Hindus to be 84,000 Yojanas, sixteen thousand of which are below the surface of the earth: the shape is variously described, as square, conical, columnar, spherical, or spiral; and the four faces of it are of various colours, or white towards the east, yellow to the south, back to the west, and red towards the north: the river Ganges falls from heaven on its summit, and flows thence to the surrounding worlds in four streams; the southern branch is the Ganges of India, the northern running into Tartary is the Bhadrasomā, the eastern is the Sītā, and the western the Cakṣu or Oxus: on the summit of Meru BRAHMĀ resides, attended and worshipped by the Ṛṣis, Gandharbas, &c.; the regents of the points of the compass occupy the corresponding faces of the mountain, the whole of which consists of gold and gems: considered in any but a fabulous light, mount Meru appears to mean the high land of Tārtary, immediately to the north of the Himālaya mountains. E. मि to scatter, (radiance,) Uṇādi aff. रु.
मेरुक: मेरुक m. (-कः) Fragrant resin, incense. E. मेरु mount Meru, and कन् aff.
मेरुयन्त्र: मेरुयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A spindle. E. मेरु, and यन्त्र implement.
मेल: मेल mf. (-लः-ला) Meeting, union, assemblage; in the modern dialects, applied to a large concourse of people collected at stated periods for religious or commercial purposes, as at Haridvār, &c. f. (-ला) 1 Ink. 2 Antimony or any collyrium. E. मिल to mix, to meet, aff. घञ्; also with ल्युट्, aff. मेलन.
मेलक: मेलक m. (-कः) Meeting, union, assemblage. E. मेल the same, कन् added.
मेलन: मेलन n. (-नं) 1 Meeting, assembling. 2 Encounter. 3 Associating with. 4 Mixing with. 5 Adding to. E. मिल to mix, ल्युट् aff.
मेलयत्: मेलयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Mixing, adding, or causing to be mixed with, or added to. E. मिल to mix, causal v., शतृ aff.
मेलानन्द: मेलानन्द mf. (-न्दः-न्दा) An inkstand. E. मेला ink, आनन्द delighting.
मेलान्धु: मेलान्धु f. (-न्धुः) An inkstand. E. मेला ink, अन्धु a well.
मेलाम्बु: मेलाम्बु m. (-म्बुः) An inkstand. E. मेला ink, अम्बु water.
मेव: मेव(ऋ)मेवृ r. 1st cl. (मेवते) To serve, to gratify by service.
मेष: मेष m. (-षः) 1 A ram. 2 The sign Aries. 3 A kind of drug. f. (-षा) A sort of small cardamom, brought from Guzerat. (-षी) An ewe. E. मिष to contend with, aff. अच्.
मेषविषाणिका: मेषविषाणिका f. (-का) A plant: see मेढ्रशुङ्गी. E. मेष a ram, विषाण a horn, कन् aff., fem. form.
मेषशृङ्ग: मेषशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A sort of poison. f. (-ङ्गी) A kind of creeping plant, (Asclepias geminata, &c.;) see मेढ्रशृङ्गी. E. मेष a ram, and शृङ्ग horn.
मेषाक्षिकुसुम: मेषाक्षिकुसुम m. (-मः) A sort of Cassia, (C. tora.) E. मेष a ram, अक्षि the eye, and कुसुम a flower; which is compared to a sheep's eye; also analogous terms, as मेषलोचन, &c.; it is also read मेषाख्य and मेषाह्व, &c. as being named from the Meṣa or ram.
मेषाण्ड: मेषाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) INDRA. E. मेष a ram, and अण्ड the testicle.
मेषालु: मेषालु m. (-लुः) A sort of shrub, commonly Ververa or Berbera, (Ocimum pilosum.) E. मेष a ram, and आलु esculent root.
मेषिका: मेषिका f. (-का) An ewe. E. मेषी an ewe, कन् aff.
मेह: मेह m. (-हः) 1 Urinary disease, especially inflammatory affection of the urethra, including gonorrhoea, &c. 3 A ram. 4 Urine, piss. E. मिह to pass as urine, aff. घञ्.
मेहत्: मेहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) Urining, passing urine. E. मिह to urine, शतृ aff.
मेहन: मेहन n. (-नं) 1 Membrum virile. 2 Urine, piss. 3 Passing urine, pissing. E. मिह to urine, aff. ल्यट्.
मेहिन्: मेहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) 1 Urining. 2 Suffering from urinary affections. E. मेह, and इनि aff.
मैत्र: मैत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) Of or belonging to a friend, friendly, amicable. m. (-त्रः) 1 A Brahman. 2 The anus. nf. (-त्रं-त्री) 1 Friendship. 2 A name of the seventeenth lunar asterism, (see the next.) E. मित्र a friend, or the sun, and अण् aff.
मैत्रभ: मैत्रभ n. (-भं) The seventeenth lunar asterism; also ANURĀDHA. E. मित्र the deity, presiding over the asterism, अण् aff. of relation, मैत्र belonging to Mitra, and भ an asterism.
मैत्रावरुण: मैत्रावरुण m. (-णः) A name of the saint AGASTYA. E. मित्र the sun, and वरुण the deity of water, अण् aff.
मैत्रावरुणि: मैत्रावरुणि m. (-णिः) A name of AGASTYA. E. मित्रवरुण a sage, the father of this saint, and इञ् aff.; or मित्र the sun, and वरुण VARUṆA, alluding to a legend of the birth of the saint from a contest between these deities, for the possession of URVAŚĪ one of the courtezans of INDRA'S heaven.
मैत्रीवल: मैत्रीवल m. (-लः) A Buddha or Bauddha deified saint.
मैत्रेय: मैत्रेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Of or relating to a friend. m. (-यः) 1 A man of a mixed caste, the son of a Vaideha by an Ayogava mother: his business is to announce the hours in verse. 2 The seventh Buddha, or one still to come. 3 The name of a saint or Muni, the disciple of PARĀŚARA, to whom the Viṣṇu Purāṇa is narrated. E. मित्र a proper name, or मित्र a friend, and ढक् aff. of descent or relation.
मैत्रेयक: मैत्रेयक m. (-कः) A crier or chaunter of the hours: see the last. E. मैत्रेय, and कन् added.
मैत्रेयिका: मैत्रेयिका f. (-कां) The contest of friends or allies. E. मैत्रेय relating to friends, वुञ् aff. of animosity.
मैत्र्य: मैत्र्य nf. (-त्र्यं-त्री) Friendship. E. मित्र friend, ष्यञ् aff. of property, fem. aff. ङीष्, and the semivowel of the aff. rejected.
मैथिल: मैथिल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Belonging to, born in, &c. Mithila. f. (-ली) A name of SĪTĀ. E. मिथिला, and अण् aff.
मैथुन: मैथुन n. (-नं) 1 Copulation. 2 Union, association. 3 Marriage. E. मिथुन a couple, and अण् aff.
मैनाक: मैनाक m. (-कः) A mountain, or rock in the sea between the southern end of the Peninsula and Laṅkā. E. मेनका the wife of Himāla, and अण् aff. of descent, being in mythology her son.
मैनाकस्वसृ: मैनाकस्वसृ f. (-सा) The goddess DURGĀ as PĀRVATĪ. E. मैनाक as above, and स्वसृ sister.
मैनिक: मैनिक m. (-कः) A fisherman. E. मीन a fish, and ठन् aff.
मैन्द: मैन्द m. (-न्दः) The name of a demon killed by VIṢṆU.
मैन्दहन्: मैन्दहन् m. (-हा) VIṢṆU. E. मैन्द as above, and हन् destroyer.
मैरेय: मैरेय n. (-यं) A sort of spirituous liquor, from the blossoms of the Lythrum fruticosum, with sugar, &c. E. मिरा said to be the name of a country or drug, and ढक् aff.
मोक्तव्य: मोक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be loosed or let go, to be liberated. E. मुच to let go, तव्य aff.
मोक्ष: मोक्ष r. 1st and 10th cls. (मोक्षति मोक्षयति) To let go, to release, to discharge, to send, to cast or throw.

मोक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 Final and eternal happiness, the liberation of the soul from the body, and its exemption from further transmigration. 2 Death. 3 Liberation, freedom. 4 A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpārali. 5 Acquittance of an obligation, as by a son to his father. E. मोक्ष to let loose or free, aff. अच्.
मोक्षक: मोक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what sets at liberty. m. (-कः) A deliverer, a liberator. E. मोक्ष, and ण्वुल् aff.
मोक्षण: मोक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Letting go or free, liberating. 2 Squandering. E. मोक्ष to let go, ल्युट् aff.
मोक्षणीय: मोक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be, or what may be liberated. E. मोक्ष, and अनीयर् aff.; also मोक्ष्य and मोक्षितव्य.
मोक्षित: मोक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Let go, liberated, at large. E. मोक्ष, and क्त aff.
मोक्षोपाय: मोक्षोपाय mfn. (-यः) A sage, a saint, a devotee. E. मोक्ष emancipation, उपाय means.
मोघ: मोघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) 1 Vain, useless, fruitless. 2 Left, abandoned. f. (-घः) Trumpet-flower, (Bignonia suave olens.) m. (-घः) A fence, a hedge. E. मुह to be foolish, aff. अच्, and the final changed.
मोघकर्मन्: मोघकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Following vain practices, observing useless-ceremonies. E. मोघ, and कर्म्मन् act.
मोघकर्म्मन्: मोघकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Following vain practices, observing useless-ceremonies. E. मोघ, and कर्म्मन् act.
मोघज्ञान: मोघज्ञान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Cultivating vain knowledge or any but religious wisdom. E. मोघ, and ज्ञान knowledge.
मोघाश: मोघाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Indulging vain hopes. E. मोघ, and आशा hope.
मोघोली: मोघोली m. (-ली) A fence, a hedge.
मोच: मोच m. (-चः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.) f. (-चा) 1 The silk-cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) 2 The plantain, (Musa sapientum.) n. (-चं) A plantain, (the fruit.) E. मुच to let loose, aff. घञ्.
मोचक: मोचक m. (-कः) 1 A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.) 2 The silk cotton tree. 3 The plantain tree. 4 A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpārali. 5 A devotee, one who has divested himself of worldly passion and desire. 6 A liberator. E. मुच to be let loose, aff. वुन्, or causal form, aff. अच्, and कन् added.
मोचन: मोचन n. (-नं) Liberating, setting free. E. मुच to be free, ल्युट् aff.
मोचनीय: मोचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be liberated or let loose. 2 To be resigned or given up. E. मुच to be loose, causal v., अनीयर् aff.
मोचरस: मोचरस m. (-सः) The gum of the silk-cotton tree. E. मोच the Bombax, and रस juice; also similar compounds, as माचनिर्य्यास, मोचसार, मोचस्राव, मोचस्रुत्.
मोचाट: मोचाट m. (-टः) 1 A kind of pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.) 2 Sandal. 3 The heart of the plantain tree. 4 A plantain, (the fruit.) E. मोच a plantain, &c., अट to go, (to be used with, to resemble, &c.) aff. अच्.
मोच्य: मोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) 1 To be let loose. 2 To be given up. E. मुच to be free, यत् aff.
मोटकी: मोटकी f. (-की) One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of the musical modes.
मोटन: मोटन m. (-नः) Air, wind. n. (-नं) Rubbing, grinding, pressing. E. मुट to rub, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
मोटनक: मोटनक n. (-कं) 1 Destruction. 2 A species of the Anuṣṭubh metre.
मोट्टायित: मोट्टायित n. (-तं) One of the ten Bhāvas, or properties of women, the silent expression of returned affection.
मोण: मोण m. (-णः) 1 Dried fruit. 2 A sort of water-fly, (the crocodile fly?) 3 A basket for carrying snakes in. E. मुण to vow, aff. घञ्.
मोद: मोद m. (-दः) 1 Joy, delight, happiness. 2 Fragrance E. मुद to rejoice, aff. घञ्.
मोदक: मोदक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Delighting, rejoicing, causing happiness or delight. mn. (-कः-कं) A sort of sweetmeat. E. मुद to be glad, in the causal form, to make glad, and ण्वुल् aff.
मोदयत्: मोदयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Delighting, pleasing. f. (-न्ती) 1 Arabian jasmine. 2 A wild sort of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen.) E. मुद to be pleased, causal form, aff. शतृ.
मोदित: मोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pleased, delighted. n. (-तं) Pleasure, delight. E. मुद to rejoice, aff. क्त, and the vowel changed.
मोरट: मोरट m. (-टः) 1 Root of sugar cane. 2 The blossom of the Alangium hexapetalum. 3 Milk of seven days standing, or when it has lost its milky nature. f. (-टा) A sort of creeper, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) E. मुर to surround, aff. अटन्.
मोषक: मोषक m. (-कः) A thief. E. मुष to steal, ण्वुल् aff.
मोषण: मोषण n. (-णं) Stealing. E. मुष, and ल्युट् aff.
मोषयित्नु: मोषयित्नु m. (-त्नुः) 1 A Brahman. 2 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
मोषा: मोषा f. (-षा) Stealing, theft. E. मुष to steal, अङ् and टाप् affs.
मोष्टृ: मोष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) A thief. E. मुष to rob, aff. तृच्.
मोह: मोह m. (-हः) 1 Fainting, loss of consciousness or sense. 2 Ignorance, folly, foolishness; it is applied especially to that spiritual ignorance which leads men to believe in the reality of worldly objects, and to addict themselves to mundane or sensual enjoyment. 3 Pain, affliction. 4 Error, mistake. 5 Bewilderment, distraction. E. मुह to be ignorant or foolish, aff. घञ्.
मोहन: मोहन mfn. (-नः-ना or -नी-नं) Fascinating, stupefying, depriving of sense or understanding. n. (-नं) 1 Copulation. 2 One of the arrows of KĀMADEVA. 3 Temptation, seduction, the overpowering of reason and reflection by worldly or sensual allurements. m. (-नः) The thorn-apple, (Datura.) f. (-ना) 1 A sort of grass, (Trigonella corniculata.) 2 A kind of jasmine, commonly the Tripura or Tipperah jasmine. E. मुह to be foolish, (causal form,) aff. युच् or ल्युट्.
मोहित: मोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Puzzled, perplexed. 2 Beguiled, deceived. E. मुह to be foolish, causal v., क्त aff.
मोहिन्: मोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Illusive, fallacious, beguiling. E. मोह, and इनि aff.; or मुह to be foolish, causal v., घिनुण् aff.
मोहिनी: मोहिनी f. (-नी) A kind of jasmine, commonly Tripuramāli. E. मोह folly, इनि aff., and ङीष् fem.
मौकुलि: मौकुलि m. (-लिः) A crow; some books have मौकलि.
मौक्तिक: मौक्तिक n. (-कं) A pearl. E. मुक्ता a pearl, ठक् pleonastic aff.
मौक्तिकप्रसवा: मौक्तिकप्रसवा f. (-वा) The pearl oyster. E. मौक्तिक, and प्रसवा a mother; mother of pearl.
मौक्तिकशुक्ति: मौक्तिकशुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) A pearl oyster. E. मौक्तिक a pearl, and शुक्ति an oyster.
मौक्य: मौक्य n. (-क्यं) Dumbness. E. सूक, and ष्यञ् aff.
मौखर्य: मौखर्य्य nf. (-र्य्यं-री) Scurrility, defamation. E. मुखर foul-mouthed, ष्यञ् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.
मौखर्य्य: मौखर्य्य nf. (-र्य्यं-री) Scurrility, defamation. E. मुखर foul-mouthed, ष्यञ् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.
मौख्य: मौख्य n. (-ख्यं) Pre-eminence. E. मुख chief, ष्यञ् aff.
मौग्ध: मौग्ध n. (-ग्धं) 1 Simplicity, silliness. 2 Ignorance. 3 A feminine property: asking a lover to tell what is already known. E. मुग्ध, and ष्यञ् aff.
मौञ्जी: मौञ्जी f. (-ञ्जी) The girdle of a Brahman made of three strings of Munja grass. E. मुञ्जा, and अण् aff.
मौञ्जीबन्धन: मौञ्जीबन्धन n. (-नं) Investiture with the distinguishing cord. E. मौञ्जी the girdle, and बन्धन binding; both being assumed at the same time.
मौढ्य: मौढ्य n. (-ढ्यं) Ignorance, folly, especially spiritual folly: see मोह. E. मूढ a fool, ष्यञ् aff. of property.
मौण्ड्य: मौण्ड्य n. (-ण्ड्यं) Baldness, natural or artificial. E. मुण्ड, and ष्यञ् aff.
मौद्गीन: मौद्गीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fit for, or bearing, &c. (kidney-beans.) E. मुद्ग kidney-bean, and खञ् aff.; also with अण्, aff. मौद्ग.
मौन: मौन n. (-नं) Silence, taciturnity. E. मुनि a sage, (who practices it,) and अण् aff.
मौनिन्: मौनिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Silent, taciturn. m. (-नी) An ascetic, a hermit, a religious sage, one who has overcome his passions and retired from the world E. मीन silence, and इनि aff.
मौरजिक: मौरजिक m. (-कः) A player on a drum. E. मुरज a drum, and ठक् aff.
मौर्ख्य: मौर्ख्य n. (-र्ख्यं) Stupidity, folly, fatuity. E. सूर्ख a fool, ष्यञ् aff.
मौर्वी: मौर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) A bow-string. E. सूर्व्वा the plant, from the fibres of which bow-strings were made, अण् and ङीष् aff.
मौर्व्वी: मौर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) A bow-string. E. सूर्व्वा the plant, from the fibres of which bow-strings were made, अण् and ङीष् aff.
मौल: मौल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Radical, proceeding from a root or origin. 2 Of pure blood, descended from a respectable and primitive family without any improper intermixture. E. मूल a root, and अण् aff.
मौलि: मौलि mf. (-लिः-ली or -ली) 1 A lock of hair on the crown of the head. 2 Hair ornamented and braided round the head. 3 A diadem, a Tiara. 4 The head. f. (-ली) The earth. E. मूल the root or base, aff. इञ् or मूल a name, and इञ् aff. of descent, or मू to bind, लि aff., and the radical vowel changed.
मौष्टा: मौष्टा f. (-ष्टा) Boxing, sparring, playing at fistycuffs. E. मुष्टि the fist, ण aff.
मौहूर्त: मौहूर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) An astrologer. E. मुहूर्त्त an hour, and अण् aff.; also with ठक् aff. मौहूर्त्तिक.
मौहूर्त्त: मौहूर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) An astrologer. E. मुहूर्त्त an hour, and अण् aff.; also with ठक् aff. मौहूर्त्तिक.
म्ना: म्ना r. 1st cl. (मनति) To fix in the memory by frequent practice or repetition, to study, to acquire by study, &c.
म्रक्ष: म्रक्ष r. 1st cl. (म्रक्षति) 1 To accumulate. 2 To smear, to anoint. 10th cl. (म्रक्षयति) 1 To mix. 2 To speak incorrectly.
म्रक्ष m. (-क्षः) Slyness, hypocrisy, concealment of one's vices or defects. E. म्रक्ष to anoint, aff. अच्.
म्रक्षण: म्रक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Oil. 2 Smearing the body with fragrant oils or unguents. E. म्रक्ष to smear or anoint, ल्युट् aff.
म्रच: म्रच r. 1st cl. (म्रचति) To go, to move.
म्रद: म्रद r. 1st cl. (म्रदते) 1 To grind, to pound, to reduce to powder or dust. 2 To tread or trample on.
म्रदिमन्: म्रदिमन् m. (-मा) Softness. E. मृद् soft, and इमनिच् aff.
म्रदिमान्वित: म्रदिमान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Soft. 2 Kind. E. म्रदिमन्, and अन्वित endowed with.
म्रदिष्ठ: म्रदिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very soft, exceedingly soft, softest. E. मृदु soft, and इष्ठन् aff. of the superlative, ऋ changed to र.
म्रदीयस्: म्रदीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Softer, milder. E. मृदु soft, and इयसुन् aff. of the comparative, and the vowel changed to the semivowel.
म्रियमाण: म्रियमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Dying. E. मृ to die, शानच् aff.
म्रुच: म्रुच(उ,)म्रुचु r. 1st cl. (म्रोचति) To go, to move.
म्रुंच: म्रुंच(उ,)म्रुञ्च r. 1st cl. (म्रुञ्चति) To go, to move.
म्रेट: म्रेट(ऋ,)म्रेदृ r. 1st cl. (म्रेटति) To be mad.
म्रेड: म्रेड(ऋ,)मेडृ r. 1st cl. (म्रेडति) To be mad.
म्लक्ष: म्लक्ष r. 10th cl. (म्लक्षयति) 1 To mix, to unite. 2 To speak incorrectly.
म्लान: म्लान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Foul, dirty. 2 Languid, weary. 3 Faded, withered. E. म्लै to be languid, aff. क्त.
म्लानि: म्लानि f. (-निः) 1 Weariness, languor. 2 Foulness, filth. 3 Fading, decay. E. म्लै to be languid, &c., aff. क्तिन्.
म्लिष्ट: म्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Indistinct, (as speech.) 2 Languid. n. (-ष्टं) Indistinct speech. E. म्लेच्छ to speak indistinctly, aff. क्त.
म्लुक्त: म्लुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Mixed, intermixed, inlaid, set. E. म्लुच to go, aff. क्त.
म्लुच: म्लुच(उ,)म्लुचु r. 1st cl. (म्लोचति) To go, to move. With अभि and नि prefixed, To go down, to set as the sun.
म्लुञ्च: म्लुञ्च(उ,)म्लुञ्चु r. 1st cl. (म्लुञ्चति) To go, to move.
म्लेच्छ: म्लेछ r. 1st and 10th cls. (म्लेछति म्लेछयति) 1 To speak inarticulately or incorrectly, to use a provincial or barbarous dialect. 2 To speak.

म्लेच्छ m. (-च्छः) 1 The generic term for a barbarian or foreigner; that is, for one speaking any language but Sanskrit, and not subject to the usual Hindu institutions. 2 A sinner, a criminal. 3 Indistinct or barbarous speech. E. म्लेच्छ to speak inarticulately, aff. घञ्.
म्लेछ: म्लेछ r. 1st and 10th cls. (म्लेछति म्लेछयति) 1 To speak inarticulately or incorrectly, to use a provincial or barbarous dialect. 2 To speak.
म्लेच्छकन्द: म्लेच्छकन्द m. (-न्दः) Garlic. E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, and कन्द root.
म्लेच्छजाति: म्लेच्छजाति m. (-तिः) A Mleccha or barbarian, or a man of an outcast race. The tribes enumerated under this head by MANU, but who are by him said to be properly, degraded Kṣatriyas, appear to be chiefly the inhabitants of the countries bordering immediately upon India, both to the north and south: as far as modern research and similarity of appellation may be trusted, the tribes of Mlecchas are as follows: the Pauṇḍrakas, (the people of provinces bordering on Bengal and Behar, and to the south of the Ganges,) Oḍras, (Urīyas,) Drāviras, (people of the southern part of the Coromandel coast,) Cāmbojas, (Arachosians,) Yavanas, (Greeks or Bactrians,) Śakas, (the people of the Sacha region or Sakai,) Pāravas, (Paropamisans,) Pahlavas, (the ancient Persians,) Cīnas, (Chinese,) Kirātas, (generally mountaineers, here perhaps especially the inhabitants of the Himāla or Imaus,) Daradas, (Daradoe,) and Khasas, (Scūthi or Chasas.) E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, and जाति tribe, class.
म्लेच्छदेश: म्लेच्छदेश m. (-शः) The countries bordering on India, or those inhabited by people of a different faith and language; defined to be any, where the black antelope is not found. E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, an outcast, and देश country.
म्लेच्छभोजन: म्लेच्छभोजन m. (-नः) Wheat. n. (-नं) Half ripe barley. E. म्लेच्छ an outcaste, and भोजन food.
म्लेच्छमण्डल: म्लेच्छमण्डल n. (-लं) The country of the Mlecchas or barbarians. E. म्लेच्छ, and मण्डल region.
म्लेच्छमुख: म्लेच्छमुख n. (-खं) Copper. E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, and मुख countenance.
म्लेच्छवाच्: म्लेच्छवाच् mfn. (-वाक्) Speaking a barbarous dialect. E. म्लेच्छ, and वाच् speech.
म्लेच्छाश: म्लेच्छाश m. (-शः) Wheat. E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, अश to eat, aff. अच.
म्लेच्छास्य: म्लेच्छास्य n. (-स्यं) Copper. E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, and आस्य face, which would seem to allude to the fair complexion of the Greek or Mohammedan invaders of Hindustan.
म्लेच्छित: म्लेच्छित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken incorrectly or barbarously. m. (-तं) 1 Foreign or barbarous language. 2 Ungrammatical speech. E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, इतच् aff., or म्लेच्छ to speak inaccurately, aff. क्त.
म्लेट: म्लेट(ऋ,)म्लेदृ r. 1st cl. (म्लेटति) To be mad.
म्लेड: म्लेड(ऋ,)म्लेडृ r. 1st cl. (म्लेडति) To be mad.
म्लेव: म्लेव(ऋ,)म्लेवृ r. 1st cl. (म्लेवते) To serve, to gratify by service.
म्लै: म्लै r. 1st cl. (म्लायति म्लपयति) 1 To be faint or languid, to yawn with languor or fatigue. 2 To fade, to decay. य
